title: Data Center Program Manager
description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Program Manager (DCPM), you will perform troubleshooting for service incidents, manage assigned projects to meet service delivery objectives as well escalate to appropriate stakeholders to remove obstacles. You will also follow safety policies and procedures and participate in root cause analysis (RCA) of incidents. This job will allow you to build a solid understanding of data center procedures, engage in collaboration across various teams as well as provide knowledge sharing and collaboration across data centers by sharing effective practices.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Business Operations Program Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. By enabling data center capacity through increased Infrastructure Utilization Effectiveness (IUE) and Power Harvesting (PH), you will lead the retrofit efforts to upgrade legacy datacenters and harvest capacity in our existing fleet. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 100 datacenters and 1 million servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!



Responsibilities
  • Support budget objectives by managing costs responsibly and helping maintain spending within approved guidelines; keep costs reasonable and contribute to staying within budget.
  • Follow and adhere to safety and security policies and procedures. Report immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
  • Perform troubleshooting for service incidents and escalates, as appropriate, to meet SLA/OLAs, with minimal disruption to the client/customer and business.
  • Recognize potential customer impact of other events and issues (e.g., customer lockdown), communicate potential impact, and plan for impact accordingly.
  • Proactively review schedules and avoid conflicts when possible. Identify, coordinate, manage expectations, and offer alternatives when defining customer solutions.
  • Manage relationships with clients and suppliers to ensure that all expectations are clarified, understood, documented, and met.
  • Suggest ways for reducing the risk of performing maintenance; work with others to accommodate scheduling needs.
  • In alignment with management priorities, hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service). Support escalation of issues to appropriate owner.


Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

High School Qualification or equivalent AND 3+ years experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or delivering server and network deployment projects in large-scale Data center environments

    OR equivalent experience

Other Requirements

  • Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Additional or preferred qualifications

Bachelor's or Technical College Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field AND 8+ years experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR High School Qualification or equivalent AND 10+ years experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR equivalent experience.

Applicable certifications: APICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA, Microsoft, Network Certifications, CCNA Certifications, ITIL v3 Foundation, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications.

There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $137,500 - $225,800 per year.

title: Singles Mental Health Clinician
description:
WHO WE ARE

The Road Home was founded in 1923 and has been a leader in the endeavor to end homelessness for over 100 years. We provide low-barrier emergency shelters, supportive services, and housing-first-minded rental assistance that helps individuals and families step out of homelessness and back into the community. We are seeking compassionate and empathetic individuals who are interested in making a difference in the lives of others and their community.

The Road Home is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Our mission to help people experiencing homelessness is strengthened by a highly qualified team with a variety of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their unique strengths.

We welcome applicants from all walks of life who share our passion for ending homelessness, collaboration, and compassion. Together, we can create a supportive environment where every voice is heard, and every person has the opportunity to succeed.

BENEFITS SUMMARY

The Road Home is a 501c3 non-profit social services agency whose mission is to help people step out of homelessness and back into our community.

Come be part of the solution.

We have a robust, reasonably priced, and inclusive benefits plan for full and part-time employees (25-40 hours/week)

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • HSA, FSA, HRA (We reimburse part of your deductible!)
  • Retirement Plan (403B with TRH contribution and match)
  • FREE Life Insurance for employees
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & 12 Public Holidays)
  • One Floating Holiday Per Year
  • Free Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Free Training & Development
  • Tuition Assistance for a wide variety of classes!

JOB SUMMARY

The Singles Mental Health Clinician provides behavioral health services to individuals experiencing homelessness who are staying at the Pamela Atkinson Resource Center (PARC). Working as part of a collaborative interdisciplinary team, this role delivers direct behavioral health services to a diverse population, including assessments, time-limited treatment, assertive engagement, and crisis intervention. The Clinician maintains a structured, weighted caseload that balances treatment-seeking individuals, non-seeking individuals in a pre-treatment phase, and protected time for crisis work. The Clinician supports individuals in addressing behavioral health concerns with the goal of achieving housing stability, increasing self-sufficiency, and improving overall quality of life.

Anticipated Weekly Time Allocation

Client-facing responsibilities are allocated across three main areas – clients seeking clinical support, clients that would likely benefit from clinical support but are in a pre-treatment stabilization space, and crisis intervention and management for program participants as needed. These targets are calibrated with periodic time studies and may be adjusted by the Clinical Director; singles clinicians are intentionally weighted toward assertive engagement of non-seeking clients and toward crisis response, reflecting the acuity and engagement demands of the singles population.

*This is an in-person position that requires travel between various resource centers and shelters.
*There may be flexibility for occasional remote work with work plan approval from the Clinical Director.
*Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Positions Available

1

Position Status

Full-Time

Location

Pamela Atkinson Resource Center (PARC)
3380 S 1000 W, South Salt Lake, UT 84119

Schedule
Monday-Friday; 9am-5pm

Reports to
Clinical Director

Grade and starting salary
Grade 12, Starting at $32.28/hour
$2 increase upon full licensure (LCSW or equivalent)

FLSA Status
Exempt

EEO Class
Professionals

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Hold an established, weighted caseload that combines treatment-seeking and non-seeking clients, with protected time reserved for crisis work. Identify individuals in need of clinical support based on mental illness, cognitive impairment, substance use, and high utilization of shelter and community resources, collaborating with other teams to build and maintain the caseload.

  2. Clients seeking services: Deliver a time-limited series of sessions focused on stabilization and assessment. Establish the transition-to-community-provider expectation in the initial session, so clients understand the clinician’s role is time-limited.

  3. Complete warm handoffs to ongoing external providers, assisting clients with consent forms and referral paperwork, followed by a 30-day post-handoff check-in.

  4. Clients not seeking services: Maintain non-seeking/service-averse clients on the caseload with documented, staged engagement goals, using assertive engagement and the LEAP approach (Listen, Empathize, Agree, Partner) to build trust with individuals who may have limited insight into their illness, and to move them toward treatment readiness and/or other appropriate outcomes as identified by the clinical and case management teams.

  5. Maintain regular engagement with clients through weekly check-ins and ongoing supportive contact appropriate to each client’s lane and engagement stage.

  6. Maintain protected weekly capacity for crisis intervention, de-escalation, and other crisis-driven services for all clients in shelter as needed, including facilitating debriefing conversations with staff and clients when appropriate.

  7. Score and monitor client acuity using the department’s central Client Tracker and participate in monthly caseload reviews to track engagement-stage movement, rebalance load, and inform intake decisions.

  8. Complete biopsychosocial assessments and additional mental health and substance use screeners to track client needs and progress.

  9. Support clients in developing goals that help them overcome homelessness and stabilize in the community and assess each client’s barriers to self-sufficiency.

  10. Assess the need for therapeutic groups and implement them as needed.

  11. Maintain accurate records, therapy notes, and statistical data as required; participate in research and special projects as needed.

  12. Attend mandatory agency trainings, including Trauma-Informed Care, Housing Focused, De-escalation, Suicide Prevention, CPR, and more.

  13. Participate in emergency drills and environmental safety activities, as required.

  14. Follow all agency protocols for security, safety, and sanitation to maintain a clean and secure environment for guests and staff.

  15. Maintain regular and reliable attendance as an essential function of this position.

Additional Job Functions - Team Collaboration

  1. Collaborate with members of leadership, case management, advocacy, and housing teams to support coordinated care and consistent lane assignment through the referral/intake workflow.

  2. Manage and maintain partnerships with community behavioral health providers.

  3. Lead the weekly staffing meeting for the case management team alongside the Supportive Services Manager.

  4. Attend weekly staff meetings as assigned with internal and external teams, including security partners, law enforcement, and other community agencies, to provide clinical insight and advocate on behalf of clients.

  5. Refer clients to community partners and coordinate long-term services for guests once they transition into permanent housing.

  6. Assist in providing coaching opportunities and increasing awareness of mental and behavioral health barriers with other teams.

  7. Lead trainings on clinical topics through the TRH Training Academy for new hires every other week as needed.

  8. Join other team members to support clients in hospital settings, during incarceration, and in the community as needed.

Promoting Best Practice & Clinician Wellbeing

  • Actively engage with and honor the unique backgrounds, identities, and experiences of all individuals we serve.

  • Advance the agency’s commitment to honoring diverse ethnic and cultural heritages through daily actions that foster genuine belonging.

  • Implement Housing Focused principles, risk management strategies, and high-access services as foundational to our mission.

  • Maintain healthy boundaries using trauma-informed approaches in all interactions.

  • Participate in structured reflective supervision and peer consultation to sustain wellbeing given the sustained engagement demands and high crisis exposure of the singles population.

  • Engage with load-balancing practices — including caps on concurrent high-acuity cases — designed to protect clinician wellbeing and sustain quality of care.

*Other duties as assigned.
*Must pass a pre-employment background check and drug screening.
*Reasonable accommodations may be considered to enable all individuals to perform these essential functions, so please still apply.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Master's degree in a mental health discipline from an accredited university is required.

  • L.C.S.W. or equivalent licensure is preferred; clinical supervision will be provided for a C.S.W. working toward licensure.

  • Advanced knowledge and experience in the mental health and substance use treatment field is required.

  • Experience working with diverse and/or vulnerable populations, or with individuals experiencing homelessness is preferred.

  • Familiarity with assertive engagement approaches (e.g., LEAP — Listen, Empathize, Agree, Partner) and stepped-care or warm-handoff models is preferred.

SKILLS AND EXPECTATIONS

  1. Act as a proactive and engaged member of a dynamic, cohesive team.

  2. Perform duties with flexibility, openness, and empathy in all interactions.

  3. Work independently and make sound, trauma-informed decisions in complex situations.

  4. Demonstrate excellent organizational skills to manage a structured, weighted caseload, documentation, and multiple responsibilities.

  5. Apply assertive engagement and LEAP techniques with non-seeking clients, and structure time-limited treatment with clear, warm handoffs for seeking clients.

  6. Communicate clearly and compassionately with clients, families, and team members, especially during high-stress situations.

  7. Demonstrate cultural humility and a deep respect for the diverse backgrounds and experiences of those served.

  8. Build and maintain effective working relationships with community partners and external agencies.

  9. Provide thoughtful and attentive customer service by handling difficult situations with professionalism, patience, and empathy.

  10. Use basic computer programs (email, spreadsheets, and clinical tracking tools) and have strong computer skills.

  11. Ability to accept supervision, direction, and feedback with openness.

PHYSICAL AND EQUPMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to lift and move heavy items up to 25 pounds.
  • Ability to sit, stand, and move for at least an hour at a time or more.
  • Must be at least 21 years old, have a valid, unexpired driver’s license, and the ability to drive a vehicle, as needed.

title: Designer - Engineering
description:
Join Our Team at voestalpine Railway Systems Nortrak!


Embark on a rewarding career journey with voestalpine Railway Systems Nortrak, North America's premier designer and manufacturer of special trackwork. With a legacy spanning 160 years, we lead the industry in shaping the future of rail solutions. As part of the voestalpine Railway Systems global network, we are committed to delivering quality products and services, including rails, turnouts, fastening systems, signaling technologies, and monitoring solutions. Operating with a presence across Canada, the US, and Mexico, we prioritize the well-being of our people, global mobility, and sustainability and innovation.


Our people are the foundation of our success. Skilled, motivated, and results-driven individuals shape our culture demonstrating our core values of Respect, Responsibility, Curiosity, Courage, Passion, and Diversity each day. This commitment is more than shared values; it extends to shared responsibilities for safety and quality, showing genuine care for one another's growth and development, a commitment to our customers, and fostering strong relationships within the Nortrak Team and with our customers.

We are currently looking for a Designer – Engineering to join our team in Birmingham, Alabama.

PURPOSE OF POSITION

Reporting Directly to the Engineering Project Lead, the Designer – Engineering is responsible for Performing design work under the supervision of a Sr. Designer, Design Lead and/or Project Lead. Produce manufacturing / customer drawings with accuracy and Bills of Material related to the company’s products as per the latest company design standards/guidelines and industry and customer specifications using the designated CAD/CAM software, currently MicroStation and SolidWorks and NX (CAD/CAM) and SAP (ERP).


TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES

SAFETY:


  • Abides by all customer and Nortrak safety policies and procedures while on customer & Nortrak sites.
  • Ensures design specifications of drawings meet customer and Nortrak safety standards.

QUALITY:

  • Produce practical designs and other design components (BOMs, ITPs, etc) for tooling and Nortrak product.
  • Work with a high degree of accuracy developed through knowledge of the application, manufacture and service requirements, customer and Nortrak standards and industry state of practice.
  • Stay current with company manufacturing processes and product/industry knowledge. Continues to develop their knowledge of Nortrak products, customer and Nortrak standards and industry state of practice. Responsible for being aware of design standards and assigned customers.
  • Works closely with Manufacturing to address design/manufacturability issues.
  • Assists and/or creates Customer Request for Information (RFI) to clarify information needed for projects, by including relevant information, customer specifications, and/or details required.
  • Assists and/or creates customer submittals for projects.
  • Updating and revising drawings and BOM’s as needed and/or directed.
  • Designer checks their own work for accuracy before submitting their designs to other personnel for official checking and approving.


ON-TIME DELIVERY:

  • Maximizes utilization of time to complete projects accurately and meeting department and company commitment dates.
  • Creating project pre-orders and long lead time items in order to meet project delivery dates, and updating throughout the project as needed.
  • Understands and knows the due date of when the assigned task is to be completed.
  • Contributes to milestones.
  • Works within well-established practices and clearly defined scope of work.

COST:

  • Works as a member of a design team, cooperates with Nortrak Management in an effective manner to produce designs efficiently and on budget with a high degree of manufacturability.
  • Understands and knows the budgeted hours per task assigned to him/her.

PEOPLE:

  • Shares information with and encourages other team members.
  • Develops close working relationships between both internal and external customers and suppliers.
  • Assists production with technical questions, support, guidance, and problem solving.
  • Works closely with more senior staff. Works on projects of minimal complexity.
  • Works under close supervision.

ENVIRONMENTAL:

  • Adhere to Nortrak's Environmental Procedures, Practices and Policies.


QUALITIFCATIONS:

EDUCATION:

  • Post-Secondary education with diploma or degree in an appropriate Engineering discipline.

FIELD OF EXPERIENCE:

  • Three to five years experience in the engineering field.
  • Experience working in a manufacturing environment an asset.
  • Knowledge of materials & casting processes related to the company’s manufactured products.
  • Knowledge of Finite Element Analysis experience (NX Simcenter) preferred.
  • Detailed knowledge in CAD, preferably NX and MicroStation.
  • SAP knowledge would be an asset.

title: Bench Lead Technician Supervisor
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

POSITION TITLE

Gaming Machine Bench Lead Technician Supervisor

DEPARTMENT

Gaming Machine

REPORTS TO

Gaming Machine Director

LICENSING LEVEL

Key

SALARY GRADE

NE09

FLSA STATUS

Non-Exempt

POSITION SUMMARY

Oversees and coordinates the daily activities of the technical staff within the Gaming Machine department. Supervises staff and operations to ensure a positive customer service experience. Ensures the successful completion of department functions in accordance with the strategic goals, objectives, and mission of the Shoshone-Bannock Casino Hotel, with established policies and procedures, and with all applicable tribal, state, and federal gaming regulations.

This list of duties and responsibilities is illustrative only of the tasks performed by this position and is not all-inclusive.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Supervises the operation of all gaming machines and daily activities of Bench Technician staff in assigned area; communicates with Manager regarding guest and/or employee concerns.
  • Coordinates daily employee assignments, employee break schedules, and staffing levels.
  • Works with management to implement a strategic plan to deliver services; communicates goals, objectives, policies, and procedures in accordance with the strategic plan.
  • Verifies machine payouts as required per standard operating procedures.
  • Meets revenue goals by ensuring all gaming machines are in working order.
  • Troubleshoots and repairs all types of Gaming Machine machines internal components and employed equipment to the component level.
  • Assists in connecting wires used for data and progressive systems and programming the super-controller to display the correct amounts.
  • Maintains a working library of all technical manuals and customer notices issued by venders to ensure compliance.
  • Maintains a working stock of spare parts to minimize equipment downtime due to equipment failure.
  • Manages the repair, overhaul, and proper preventative maintenance of all Gaming Machine machines to ensure optimal operation.
  • Oversees floor maintenance and repair.
  • Supervises and delegates the initial setup of new Gaming Machine machines.
  • Coordinates the break down, relocation, and re-setup of machines and pedestals to be relocated.
  • Brings disputes and unusual customer activities to the attention of the department operations as necessary and Gaming Machine Department Management.
  • Increases staff effectiveness by recruiting, selecting, orienting, training, coaching, counseling, and disciplining supervisors; communicating values, strategies, and objectives; assigning accountabilities; planning, monitoring, and appraising job results; developing a climate for offering information and opinions; integrating functional objectives; and providing and participating in educational opportunities.
  • Hosts regular staff meetings to ensure communication among personnel regarding departmental activities.
  • Helps to ensure departmental staffing is maintained within budgetary requirements.
  • Assists in achieving the financial objectives of the department by monitoring the departmental budget.
  • Conducts evaluations of departmental services and works with staff to take appropriate steps to improve performance and/or customer service levels.
  • Ensures the efficiency of Gaming Machine operations and maximum level of service is achieved through a culture of teamwork and consistency.
  • Contributes to the organization's effectiveness by offering information and opinion as a member of the management team.
  • Promotes all departmental and property-wide promotions.
  • Complies with all property and department policies and procedures.
  • Maintains a professional, organizational, and community reputation.
  • Contributes to a team effort and accomplishes related results as required.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

Knowledge of:

  • Goals, objectives, functions, policies, and procedures of Shoshone-Bannock Casino Hotel.
  • Applicable federal, state, tribal, and gaming laws, regulations, requirements, and principles.
  • Department organization, functions, objectives, policies and procedures.
  • Basic arithmetic and record keeping procedures.
  • Budget tracking and compliance.
  • Mechanical functions and play aspects of gaming machines, procedures, and casino floor operations.
  • Gaming machines and electronic data system hardware.
  • Basic manual hand tool and repair methods.
  • Electronically mechanical troubleshooting methods and techniques; voltmeter usage and troubleshooting wires as related to slot machines.
  • Modern office functions, procedures, and equipment.
  • Customer service standards.

Skill in:

  • Office software and industry-related applications.
  • Analyzing problems, projecting consequences, identifying solutions, and implementing recommendations.
  • Operating various word-processing, spreadsheets, and database software programs in a Windows environment.
  • Preparing, reviewing, and analyzing operational and financial reports.
  • Supervising, training, and evaluating assigned staff.
  • Making effective decisions in emergency situations.

Ability to:

  • Communicate efficiently and effectively both verbally and in writing, individually and in group settings.
  • Maintain confidentiality.
  • Establish and maintain good working relationships with individuals of varying social and cultural backgrounds.
  • Work independently and meet strict timelines.
  • Analyze situations and adopt appropriate courses of action.
  • Establish and maintain professional relationships with the public and co-workers.
  • Make solid decisions and exercise independent judgment.
  • Demonstrate leadership and professionalism at all times.
  • Demonstrate sensitivity to the needs of guests.
  • Remain calm in emergency or crisis situations.
  • Handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Adapt to varying situations.
  • Prepare comprehensive and concise reports and plans.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.
  • Uphold strong ethics and integrity.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School diploma/GED; Associate’s degree in Electronics preferred.
  • Three (3) years of gaming machine operations or related experience.
  • Two (2) years of supervisory experience in a casino, gaming machine, or related environment.
  • A combination of relevant education and related work experience may be considered.
  • Valid driver’s license is required when driving vehicles for work-related purposes.
  • Must be able to successfully pass a background screening / investigation according to the established requirements below.
  • Tribal and Native American preference shall apply to all positions.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, AND/OR REGISTRATIONS

  • Must be able to submit supporting documentation of education and training to support qualifications.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a gaming license in good standing according to licensing rules and regulations.
  • Must obtain and maintain a valid driver's license and qualify for insurance coverage under the company's fleet management policy, when applicable.


Background Investigation Requirements

  • Pre-employment drug screen.
  • Personal reference check and employment verification.
  • Conducts Federal, State, and tribal criminal history in accordance with the Shoshone-Bannock Tribes Gaming Commission Regulation, Part 400.7, Background Investigations.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee regularly is required to stand; walk use hands to manipulate, touch, or grasp; reach with hands or arms; and talk or hear. The employee occasionally is required to sit; use a computer and cellphone/telephone; and lift up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Incumbent may be exposed to dust, fumes, airborne particles, and / or allergens; infectious disease; and working with hostile, offensive, and / or violent individuals.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

Work is generally performed in an office setting with a moderate and occasionally high noise level. Evening and/or weekend work may be required. Tight time constraints and multiple demands are common. Travel is required for training, meetings, conferences, presentations, and other events.

ABOUT FRX:

At FRX Ohio, exceptional cannabis begins with exceptional cultivation. As one of the largest Certified Kind cannabis cultivators in the United States, we are committed to growing cannabis with integrity, transparency, and an unwavering focus on quality. Because cannabis cannot be certified USDA Organic under current federal law, the Certified Kind program provides an independent, third-party verification modeled after internationally recognized organic standards. Through rigorous inspections and accountability, Certified Kind cultivators demonstrate their commitment to producing cannabis with respect for both people and the planet.

Everything we do starts with our living soil, which is an active ecosystem of beneficial bacteria, fungi, and other microorganisms that naturally cycle nutrients, support vigorous plant growth, and promote resilience. Rather than simply feeding the plant, we cultivate a thriving soil food web that allows each cultivar to fully express its unique cannabinoid and terpene profile while producing healthy, vibrant plants. By working with biological systems instead of relying on synthetic inputs, we produce cannabis that is true to its genetics and rich in the compounds that make every cultivar unique.

We proudly offer flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vaporizers, and edibles through our family of brands, including FRX, Anthos Organics, Common Citizen, Local Edibles, and Cannarocks. Every product reflects the same care, consistency, and attention to detail that goes into every harvest.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

People Management

  • Deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.

Security Delivery

  • Direct team to address identified security strategy, ensuring proper team resources are available to accomplish goals, and coordinate with partner teams to remediate control failures.
  • Drive team to implement and manage new automation for greater efficiency in security operations while ensuring measurable business impact and solutions across the organization.
  • Escalate potential gaps in security policy, provide guidance on current security policies, recommend changes, and drive adoption for new policies.
  • Lead network security operations/engineering across firewalls, IDS/IPS, network infrastructure, cloud security, and identity services, ensuring platform reliability, policy compliance, telemetry coverage, operational readiness, and timely remediation of security risks.
  • Support end to end security breach protocol by guiding team in responding, investigating, communicating with stakeholders, resolving, and running post-mortem analysis for any security breaches. Coordinate with partner teams to secure data and maintain chain of custody.
  • Lead global security operations across Microsoft Sentinel and OT environments, driving 24×7 monitoring, detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, automation, and regional coordination across AMER, EMEA, and APAC while measuring detection coverage, service-level attainment, MTTD, and MTTR.

Other

  • Embody our culture and values.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field AND 4+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat modeling, cyber security, anomaly detection, Security Operations Center (SOC) detection, threat analytics, security incident and event management (SIEM), information technology (IT), or operations incident response.
    • OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field AND 3+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat modeling, cyber security, anomaly detection, Security Operations Center (SOC) detection, threat analytics, security incident and event management (SIEM), information technology (IT), or operations incident response
    • OR Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field
    • OR equivalent experience.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in cyber security, and anomaly detection and response.
    • OR Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years people management.
  • 1+ year(s) leading a security function (e.g., Security Operations Center [SOC], threat and vulnerability management [TVM], authentication and access management).
  • 1+ year(s) leading multi-disciplinary team.
  • Experience owning/managing security service to internal or external customers
  • CISSP, CISA, CISM, SANS, GCIA, GCIH, OSCP, and/or Security+ certification.

There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $160,200 - $261,000 per year.

title: Regional Controller
description:
About Lindgren Landscape
Lindgren Landscape is an award winning, landscape design/build/maintain company serving Northern Colorado since 1995. Although we are known for creating high-end custom landscapes, we design and install landscapes of all scopes and sizes. Our people are the reason for our success. We are looking for people who are dedicated to the landscape industry and have a passion for quality.

Job Summary
The Regional Controller, working with the parent company CFO, is responsible for leading and overseeing the accounting and financial operations of the Company and its affiliated locations and entities. This position is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of financial reporting while providing leadership and oversight of accounting functions across multiple business locations.

This is a hands-on leadership role that oversees the day-to-day accounting cycle while also establishing standardized accounting practices, internal controls, reporting processes, and financial procedures across other locations. The Regional Controller is responsible for ensuring timely and accurate month-end and year-end close processes, financial statement preparation, account reconciliations, budgeting support, cash flow management, and regulatory compliance.

The Regional Controller partners closely with executive leadership, operational leaders, and accounting personnel at each location to ensure financial information is accurate, timely, and consistent. This position provides financial analysis and insight to support strategic decision-making, operational performance, profitability, and the Company's long-term growth.

The ideal candidate is a strong accounting leader who is comfortable operating in a multi-entity environment, managing competing priorities, developing accounting staff, and creating scalable financial processes.

General Responsibilities
Accounting Leadership & Multi-Location Oversight
  • Provide leadership and oversight of accounting operations across the Company's locations and affiliated entities.
  • Oversee and coordinate accounting personnel responsible for local or entity-level accounting functions.
  • Establish consistent accounting processes, procedures, controls, and reporting standards across all locations.
  • Ensure accounting teams are appropriately trained and following established accounting policies and procedures.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and support to accounting personnel at each location.
  • Identify opportunities to centralize, standardize, automate, or improve accounting processes.
  • Promote collaboration and effective communication among accounting personnel and business leaders across all entities.
  • Ensure consistency in financial reporting while recognizing the operational needs and differences of individual locations.
General Accounting & Financial Operations
  • Lead and oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, billing, payroll support, fixed assets, and general ledger activities.
  • Oversee accounting activities performed at individual locations to ensure transactions are properly recorded and supported.
  • Review and approve journal entries, account reconciliations, and other accounting transactions as appropriate.
  • Ensure the accuracy and completeness of the general ledger across all entities.
  • Monitor the accounting cycle to ensure transactions are recorded in the appropriate accounting period.
  • Research and resolve complex accounting discrepancies and unusual transactions.
  • Maintain appropriate supporting documentation for significant accounting transactions.
  • Ensure accounting activities are completed in accordance with Company policies and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
Month-End, Quarter-End & Year-End Close
  • Lead and oversee the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes for multiple entities.
  • Coordinate month-end close responsibilities among accounting personnel across locations.
  • Review completion of account reconciliations and investigate outstanding reconciling items.
  • Review accruals, prepaid expenses, depreciation, fixed assets, and other adjusting entries.
  • Ensure all locations complete assigned close responsibilities within established deadlines.
  • Identify and resolve accounting issues that could delay or impact the financial close.
  • Review entity-level financial results prior to consolidation and executive reporting.
  • Support the preparation of consolidated financial reporting where applicable.
  • Lead year-end accounting activities and coordinate required information for external accountants, tax advisors, and auditors.
Financial Reporting & Analysis
  • Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow reports.
  • Ensure financial reporting is timely, accurate, and consistent across all locations and entities.
  • Review entity-level financial performance and identify significant trends, variances, risks, and opportunities.
  • Prepare consolidated financial reporting and supporting schedules as required.
  • Develop and maintain standardized financial reporting packages for leadership and management.
  • Provide meaningful financial analysis to executive and operational leadership.
  • Analyze actual results compared to budget, forecast, prior periods, and operational expectations.
  • Assist leadership in understanding the financial drivers of profitability and operational performance.
  • Identify unusual financial trends or performance concerns and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Budgeting, Forecasting & Strategic Financial Support
  • Lead or support the annual budgeting and financial forecasting process across multiple locations.
  • Coordinate the collection and review of financial information from individual entities and departments.
  • Monitor budget performance and provide regular variance analysis.
  • Partner with operational leaders to evaluate financial performance and future projections.
  • Support strategic planning by providing financial analysis, modeling, and recommendations.
  • Assist leadership with evaluating business opportunities, capital expenditures, growth initiatives, and operational investments.
  • Develop financial models and reporting tools that support informed decision-making.
  • Provide financial insight regarding pricing, profitability, margins, and business performance.
Internal Controls, Policies & Process Improvement
  • Ensure internal controls are consistently followed across locations.
  • Identify control weaknesses, financial risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Implement corrective actions and process improvements when needed.
  • Maintain appropriate separation of duties and financial approval processes.
  • Develop standardized accounting workflows that support consistency and scalability.
  • Improve accounting systems and reporting processes through automation and technology.
  • Document accounting procedures and ensuring knowledge is appropriately shared among accounting personnel.
Cash Flow & Working Capital Management
  • Monitor Company and entity-level cash flow and working capital needs.
  • Review cash balances and anticipated cash requirements.
  • Monitor Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable trends.
  • Support leadership in managing collections, vendor obligations, and working capital.
  • Monitor credit card reconciliations and other cash-related accounting activities.
  • Provide recommendations to optimize cash flow and financial resources.
  • Assist with cash forecasting and liquidity planning.
Compliance, Tax & Audit Support
  • Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, financial reporting requirements, and Company policies.
  • Oversee sales and use tax reporting and other applicable tax-related accounting activities.
  • Oversee workers' compensation reporting, insurance audits, and other financial compliance activities.
  • Ensure appropriate accounting documentation is maintained to support tax filings and regulatory reporting.
  • Coordinate and support external audits, reviews, and other financial examinations.
  • Prepare and organize schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for external accountants and auditors.
  • Monitor compliance requirements across all locations and ensure required financial reporting is completed timely.
Leadership & Business Partnership
  • Serve as a strategic financial partner to executive and operational leadership.
  • Provide financial insight and recommendations that support business objectives and long-term growth.
  • Partner with department leaders to support operational initiatives, project costing, commissions, pricing, and financial planning.
  • Participate as an active member of the leadership team.
  • Communicate financial information clearly and effectively to leaders who may not have an accounting background.
  • Support leadership in evaluating operational and financial performance.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on financial controls, accounting processes, and financial decision-making.
  • Perform additional financial, operational, and administrative duties as assigned.

Qualifications
Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field required.
  • CPA designation or progress toward CPA certification is preferred.
Experience
  • Minimum of 7–10 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of accounting leadership, supervisory, or management experience.
  • Experience overseeing the full accounting cycle and month-end close process.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing financial statements, budgets, forecasts, and cash flow analysis.
  • Experience managing accounting operations across multiple locations, business units, or legal entities strongly preferred.
  • Experience reviewing or supporting consolidated financial reporting preferred.
  • Experience developing and implementing accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Experience supporting external audits and working with outside accountants and tax advisors.
  • Previous experience in construction, landscaping, manufacturing, private equity, or other project-based or multi-entity industries is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
Accounting & Financial Expertise
  • Thorough knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
  • Strong understanding of the complete accounting cycle and financial close process.
  • Strong understanding of multi-entity accounting and entity-level financial reporting.
  • Experience with general ledger management, account reconciliations, financial reporting, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, cost accounting, and cash flow management.
  • Ability to analyze complex financial information and identify meaningful trends and risks.
  • Understanding of consolidated financial reporting is preferred.
Leadership & Team Management
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop accounting employees.
  • Ability to provide effective oversight of accounting personnel located across multiple offices or locations.
  • Ability to establish accountability while maintaining strong working relationships.
  • Skilled at prioritizing resources and managing competing accounting deadlines.
  • Ability to lead through change and support process improvements.
  • Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills.
Multi-Entity & Operational Collaboration
  • Ability to manage multiple entities, locations, deadlines, and competing priorities.
  • Ability to balance standardized accounting practices with varying operational needs across locations.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with operational leaders.
  • Ability to identify inconsistencies in accounting processes and implement effective solutions.
  • Comfortable working in a hands-on, fast-paced, and evolving business environment.
Technical Skills
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Experience with accounting software and ERP systems; QuickBooks experience is highly preferred.
  • Ability to learn and implement new financial systems and reporting tools.
  • Experience with financial reporting, dashboard, and business intelligence tools is preferred.

Work Schedule
  • This is a full-time position.
  • Travel between Company locations may be required.
  • Occasional evenings or weekends may be required during month-end, year-end, audit periods, or other critical business cycles.

title: 2027 Brazil Junior SAP Logistics and Financial Consultant - Curitiba
description:
Junior SAP Logistics & Finance Consultant

Location: Curitiba, Paraná, Brazil — on-site
Job Type: Full-time employment, with a minimum commitment of 30 hours per week
Start Date: January 2027
Program: Brazilian Junior SAP Consultant Program — Curitiba

Start Your Career in SAP with Lupus Consulting

Are you ready to start your career in one of the most exciting areas of technology and business?

At Lupus Consulting, we are looking for 8 motivated Junior SAP Consultants to join our 2027 Brazilian Junior SAP Consultant Program in Curitiba.

You don’t need to be an SAP expert to apply. What matters most to us is your curiosity, analytical mindset, willingness to learn, and motivation to build a career in international IT consulting.

We are a well-established, medium-sized consultancy with an international team and offices in Budapest, Ulm, Madrid, Curitiba, the Netherlands, and Poland.

Our Curitiba office is an important part of our international organization, giving you the opportunity to work locally while being part of a global team.

This program is designed for students and recent graduates who are ready to take their first step into an international consulting career.

You could be a great fit if you are:

Why Join Us?

Your first professional experience can shape your career for years to come.

At Lupus Consulting, we want our Junior SAP Consultants to learn, grow and build a long-term career with us. You’ll have the opportunity to combine business knowledge, technology and international experience from the very beginning.

If you are finishing university or have recently graduated and are looking for a challenging first step into the world of SAP and international consulting, we’d love to hear from you.

Ready to Start Your SAP Journey?

Send your CV in English to: career@lupusconsulting.com

Please note that this position is on-site in Curitiba, and only candidates currently living in the Curitiba region will be considered for an interview.

We appreciate the interest of everyone who applies. Due to the number of applications, only candidates selected for the next stage of the recruitment process will be contacted.

Come build your SAP career with us.

title: Product Manager
description:
AboutCrunchafi

Crunchafi (formerly LeaseCrunch) is revolutionizing the world of accounting with easy-to-use, cloud-based solutions designed to simplify complex financial data management. Our products empower CPA firms and financial professionals by streamlining lease accounting, data extraction, and cash flow forecasting, helping them deliver strategic value faster and more efficiently. Trusted by over 750 firms and more than 27,000 companies, Crunchafi combines cutting-edge technology with expert support to power the future of accounting.

Our Team

Crunchafi is made up of passionate, forward-thinking professionals committed to transforming the accounting industry. Our team is dedicated to providing innovative solutions that simplify accounting processes and provide actionable financial insights. We value collaboration, creativity, humor, and a shared vision of improving the accounting profession through technology.

Why Join Us?

We are looking for talented individuals to join our growing team and contribute to our mission of empowering CPA firms and financial professionals. At Crunchafi, you’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative environment where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported. We offer a rewarding work/life balance, opportunities for professional development, and a chance to make a real impact in the world of accounting.

Position Overview

Crunchafi is seeking a Product Manager to help grow and evolve our Data Extraction product, which helps accounting professionals quickly retrieve, standardize, and analyze financial data from their clients' accounting systems and ERPs.

Data Extraction eliminates the manual work of requesting, formatting, validating, and preparing financial data for Audit, Financial Due Diligence (FDD/TAS), and other accounting workflows. The product transforms data from different accounting systems into consistent, ready-to-use outputs that help professionals begin their work faster and with greater confidence.

As Product Manager, you'll work closely with customers, Engineering, Design, and go-to-market teams to identify important problems, determine the right solutions, and bring new capabilities to market. You'll help us improve how we collect and standardize financial data while finding new ways to make that data more useful to accounting professionals.

This role is ideal for someone who understands accounting and financial data, enjoys learning how professionals actually work, and can turn complex problems into simple, scalable products.

WhatYou’llDo

  • Own product capabilities from discovery through development, launch, adoption, and iteration.
  • Spend time with Audit, FDD/TAS, and other accounting professionals to understand their workflows, pain points, and opportunities to eliminate manual work.
  • Translate customer and market insights into clear product requirements and priorities.
  • Help improve how Crunchafi retrieves, standardizes, validates, and delivers financial data across different accounting systems and ERPs.
  • Identify opportunities to create more value from the financial data Crunchafi already collects through better analysis, automation, and workflow support.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design to develop solutions that are useful, intuitive, reliable, and scalable.
  • Use data, customer feedback, and product usage to evaluate what is working and where the product should improve.
  • Work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support to successfully launch new capabilities and drive customer adoption.
  • Stay informed about developments in accounting technology, financial data, AI, and automation that could meaningfully improve our customers' workflows.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting required.
  • CPA certification strongly preferred and/or experience in public accounting, Audit/Assurance, Financial Due Diligence, or Transaction Advisory Services is a plus.
  • 3+ years of product management experience, preferably with B2B SaaS, accounting technology, financial technology, data, analytics, or workflow products.
  • Strong understanding of accounting concepts and financial data, including financial statements, trial balances, general ledgers, accounts receivable, and accounts payable.
  • Experience owning product features or areas from customer discovery through delivery and iteration.
  • Comfortable working with data-intensive products and partnering with Engineering on integrations, APIs, data mapping, or related technical concepts.
  • Strong customer discovery and problem-solving skills, with the ability to uncover the underlying need behind a feature request.
  • Able to translate complex workflows into clear requirements and simple product experiences.
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in an environment where not every problem is fully defined and learning new domains as needed.

Competencies

  • Product Ownership – Takes responsibility for delivering meaningful customer outcomes from discovery through adoption.
  • Customer Understanding – Develops a deep understanding of how accounting professionals work and the problems worth solving.
  • Product Judgment – Prioritizes effectively and distinguishes individual customer requests from broader product opportunities.
  • Analytical Thinking – Uses customer evidence, product data, and structured reasoning to make decisions.
  • Execution – Turns problems into clear requirements and works effectively with Engineering and Design to deliver solutions.
  • Collaboration & Communication – Builds alignment across technical, customer-facing, and business teams and communicates decisions clearly.

Benefits

  • Remote work-from-home environment
  • Competitive salary, health, dental and vision insurance plans
  • Flexible time off
  • 401K retirement savings plans for US-based employees, with 3% employer match
  • Incentive Equity Plan
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Dynamic and collaborative work environment with opportunities for growth

title: Client Service Coordinator II
description:
Who We Are & Why You Will LOVE Us!

You are more than just a number; we are more than just a bank. At Tradition Capital Bank, we are partners in business and in life; building dreams and futures on one simple idea: strong one-on-one relationships.


We place our people in the right seats and position our employees to do what they love. Every person and every role matters: when we function together as One Team, we achieve extraordinary results. As each other’s raving fans, we reach across titles and organizational structure to encourage one another.


Here at Tradition, we believe that when people work together with shared values and an open mind, anything is possible.

Tradition is always in the making; join us in celebrating our roots and being a part of what’s next.


What You Will Be Doing


The Client Service Coordinator II is responsible for delivering high touch service to internal and external clients in alignment with the Bank’s Client Service Standards. Supporting client relationships through a variety of deposit administrative duties and in compliance with established policies and procedures. Client Service Coordinator II assists Relationship Officers and clients throughout the client journey. This role focuses on accurate execution, responsive service, and collaboration with internal partners while developing foundational knowledge and skills to support consistent, caring client experiences that reflect the Bank’s purpose to Make Lives Better.

How You Will Get the Job Done

  • Client Support: Independently lead clients through multiple stages of the client journey, serving as a primary point of contact for onboarding and ongoing service needs. Enhance the client experience by demonstrating sound judgment, adaptability and a sense of urgency to support client goals. Troubleshoot and resolve a broad range of deposit and cash management inquiries, coordinating with internal partners as necessary. Effectively manage client inquiries and escalate more complex issues, concerns, or feedback when appropriate to ensure timely resolution and positive outcomes.
  • Collaboration: Develops strong partnerships with Relationship Officers to support identification and pursuit of opportunities through thoughtful assessment of clients’ financial service needs. Collaborate independently with multiple bank departments to execute proposals and client solutions within committed timelines. Execute on identified cross sell opportunities both independently and in partnership with the team. Proactively gather and share client feedback and insights to enhance the client experience.
  • Loan Coordination: Coordinate loan related administrative activities in support of Relationship Officers, Loan Administration, and clients throughout the loan lifecycle. Partner closely with Loan Administration to complete pre closing due diligence, facilitate timely loan closings, and ensure required loan documentation is accurate, complete, and properly retained in accordance with established policies and regulatory requirements. Support client and internal inquiries related to loan processes, escalate issues as appropriate, and maintain a strong sense of urgency to promote timely execution and positive client outcomes.
  • Product and Services: Maintain a strong general knowledge of TCB’s depository products and services and apply that knowledge to assess client needs, suggest appropriate solutions, and guide clients through available financial service options. Confidently support product related discussions and coordinate with internal partners to ensure solutions are executed accurately and timely.
  • Documentation: Independently prepares, reviews and executes internal and external documentation in response to client requests or proposals, including agreements, account forms, and maintenance requests. Ensure all required documents are accurately completed, properly executed, and retained in compliance with applicable banking regulations, policies, and retention requirements. Identify documentation gaps or issues and proactively coordinate resolution with internal partners to support timely and compliant client outcomes.

Other Duties:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time without notice.

title: Social Services Assistant
description:

title: Quality Technician
description:
*****This position requires U.S. citizenship and eligibility for a DoD Secret security clearance under ITAR/EAR.

Job Description
Sagetech Avionics designs and manufactures low SWaP certified avionics — including transponders, IFF systems, and ACAS/DAA modules — for military and commercial aircraft, operating from our facility in Bingen, WA under an AS9100D Quality Management System. Following a major DoD contract award for the APX-128 advanced IFF system, we are growing our quality team. We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Technician to support incoming inspection, in-process inspection, final acceptance, and quality system compliance on the production floor. This is a full-time, on-site role reporting to the Quality Manager.
Objectives of this Role
Inspection & Acceptance
  • Perform incoming inspection of machined parts, PCBAs, COTS, and raw materials against purchase orders, engineering drawings, and applicable specifications; accept, reject, or place on hold per internal receiving procedures.
  • Conduct in-process and final inspections of avionics assemblies (transponders, IFF units, ACAS/DAA modules) using visual inspection criteria, IPC-A-610 workmanship standards, and dimensional measurement tools (calipers, micrometers, go/no-go gauges).
  • Perform counterfeit parts inspection and verification per AS6081; confirm certificate of conformance (CoC) documentation and traceability for suspect or high-risk components.
  • Support first article inspection (FAI) activities; verify dimensional, material, and functional requirements against design documentation.

Nonconformance & Corrective Action
  • Initiate, document, and track nonconformance reports (NCRs) and material review board (MRB) dispositions; ensure nonconforming material is properly identified, segregated, and controlled per internal procedures.
  • Support supplier corrective action requests (SCARs) by gathering objective evidence, documenting findings, and tracking closure in coordination with Supply Chain and Engineering.
  • Participate in root cause and corrective action (RCCA) investigations; apply structured problem-solving methods (5-Why, fishbone) to identify escape mechanisms and prevent recurrence.

Quality System & Documentation
  • Complete inspection travelers to document product acceptance
  • Ensure quality records are complete, accurate, and performed in a timely fashion in compliance with Sagetech’s AS9100D quality system; maintain full product traceability from receiving through shipment.
  • Support internal, customer, and certification body audits; DCMA/customer source inspection activities; assist in preparation of objective evidence packages and corrective action responses.
  • Handle controlled hardware and technical data in accordance with ITAR/EAR requirements; maintain proper custody and control of age-sensitive and shelf-life materials.
Required Qualifications
  • High school diploma or equivalent; 3+ years of quality inspection or quality technician experience in an electronics or electromechanical manufacturing environment.
  • Proficiency with dimensional measurement tools (e.g., calipers, micrometers, go/no-go gauges) and visual inspection to IPC-A-610 workmanship standards.
  • Working knowledge of nonconformance control, MRB disposition, and corrective action processes in an AS9100D or ISO 9001 environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOMs, specifications, and work instructions; meticulous attention to detail and accurate record-keeping.
  • Working knowledge of ESD controls and safe handling of sensitive electronic assemblies; working knowledge of FOD and FOD prevention programs.
  • U.S. citizenship required; ability to obtain a DoD Secret clearance (ITAR/EAR)
​​​​​​​Preferred Qualifications
  • Aerospace or defense electronics manufacturing experience (AS9100D environment).
  • IPC-A-610 CIS or CIT certification; IPC J-STD-001 CIS or CIT a plus.
  • Familiarity with DCMA source inspection processes and government quality oversight.
  • Experience with counterfeit parts detection and avoidance (AS6081 / AS5553).
  • ASQ Certified Quality Inspector (CQI) or Quality Technician (CQT).

Hourly rate: $28.00 – $34.00 based on experience.

Sagetech Avionics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

*****This position requires U.S. citizenship and eligibility for a DoD Secret security clearance under ITAR/EAR.

title: Editor/ Shooter- Beach Happy Company
description:
Job Summary
Beach Happy is seeking a fast, creative, and highly self-directed Shooter/Editor to help drive the day-to-day production of social-first content across Beach Happy locations, road tours, events, activations, partnerships, and brand experiences.
The Shooter/Editor is more than the person behind the camera. This position must be able to recognize a great moment without waiting for someone to point it out, capture it in a real-world environment, make strong editorial decisions, and turn raw footage into finished content quickly.
Beach Happy content is energetic, authentic, and intentionally less polished than traditional commercial production. The ideal candidate understands that speed and instinct matter. They can work independently in the field, collaborate naturally with on-camera personalities, and maintain the organization and production discipline necessary to keep a high-volume content operation moving.
Essential Responsibilities
  • Field Production & Content Capture: Shoot social-first content using mobile and mirrorless cameras across beaches, businesses, venues, events, road trips, interviews, activations, and other Beach Happy experiences. Capture strong visuals and clean, usable audio in busy and uncontrolled environments.
  • Editing & Same-Day Content: Edit short-form vertical content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and other digital platforms using CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or comparable software. Work efficiently within a fast-turn production environment where content may need to move from capture to finished piece the same day.
  • Editorial Instinct & Storytelling: Independently recognize the strongest, funniest, most interesting, or most human moments from a shoot rather than relying entirely on assigned selects or step-by-step direction. Understand when an unexpected moment is more valuable than the originally planned shot.
  • Visual Identity & Content Standards: Help maintain a recognizable Beach Happy visual style across content while preserving the authentic, personality-driven, intentionally unpolished feel of the brand. Understand when content is finished and ready to ship without overproducing it.
  • Road & Field Production: Support Beach Happy road production throughout the Gulf Coast and on periodic multi-day shoots. Work efficiently in changing locations and outdoor environments while managing cameras, audio equipment, batteries, media, file transfers, and other production needs in the field.
  • Events, Activations & Partnerships: Capture Beach Happy events, partner experiences, destination features, live activations, and other company initiatives. Anticipate important moments and ensure the team leaves each production with enough quality material to support immediate and future content.
  • Content Library & Clip Development: Organize, label, archive, and maintain footage and production assets so content can be easily located and reused. Revisit existing footage to identify additional clips, moments, and stories that can extend the value of each shoot and maintain a healthy pipeline of publishable content.
  • Publishing & Distribution Support: Prepare platform-specific versions of finished content and support uploading, publishing, and distribution as needed. Understand the differences between platforms and adjust framing, length, pacing, captions, and other elements accordingly.
  • Host & Team Collaboration: Work closely with Road Hosts and the Executive Producer to execute the production slate. Help Hosts improve framing, audio, self-shooting, and content capture while remaining flexible enough to cover missing angles or production needs as they arise.
  • Production Equipment & Organization: Maintain cameras, audio equipment, production gear, storage, and organized file-transfer workflows. Ensure footage is properly transferred and labeled so production does not slow down because of missing files, disorganized assets, or equipment issues.
  • On-Camera Flexibility: Be willing to occasionally step in front of the camera when a moment or format benefits from it. Beach Happy operates as a lean production team, and every content team member should be comfortable contributing beyond a narrowly defined production lane.

Qualifications
  • 2+ years of professional or demonstrated experience shooting and editing short-form, social-first content.
  • Must be able to independently shoot AND edit. Both capabilities are required for this position.
  • Strong proficiency with CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or comparable fast-turn editing software.
  • Experience independently operating mobile and mirrorless cameras and capturing quality audio in field environments.
  • Strong editorial instincts with the ability to recognize compelling moments and make creative decisions without constant direction.
  • Working knowledge of TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and platform-native content requirements.
  • Ability to work quickly without overproducing content or allowing perfection to interfere with publishing speed.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage large volumes of footage, files, archives, and production assets.
  • Comfortable working outdoors, carrying production equipment, traveling, and working in active event and hospitality environments.
  • Must be available for periodic travel, evenings, weekends, events, and multi-day production schedules.
  • Must live on the Gulf Coast or be willing to relocate.
  • Valid driver's license required.
  • Experience with creator content, podcasts, sports, hospitality, tourism, live events, documentary-style field production, or still photography is preferred.

Speed, editorial instinct, and self-direction are essential. The Shooter/Editor must be able to capture the content, recognize the story, and turn it into a finished piece without waiting for step-by-step direction.

title: Software Engineer II-SIRE
description:
Overview

Microsoft Windows & Devices team is on a journey to deliver iconic end-to-end products across hardware, software, and services that people love and use every day. A fundamental part of our strategy is having desirable and powerful devices that enable the experiences people want. Creating these new experiences and devices involves close partnership between hardware engineers, software engineers, designers, and manufacturing along with the various industry partners that closely collaborate to create industry defining firsts. Our obsession for the right experience with our passion for building products is reflected in the devices that Windows ships.

We are seeking a driven Software Engineer II for the System Integration & Reliability team with a background in Windows development to actively contribute towards the delivery of high quality, compelling Windows experiences on innovating silicon platforms. The candidate will play a key role across multiple phases of silicon development, platform validation, and product enablement. Responsibilities include prototyping and evaluating new hardware and software designs, bringing up new System on Chip (SoCs) and platforms, validating hardware and firmware features, debugging system-level issues, analyzing performance, and developing scalable automation frameworks and regression test suites.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

The candidate will contribute across multiple phases of silicon development, platform validation, and product enablement for Windows-based devices. This role involves bringing new silicon platforms to life, enabling hardware and software features, and delivering high-quality validation solutions that improve product readiness and engineering efficiency.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Design, develop, and validate software solutions that support silicon bring-up, platform enablement, and feature readiness across emerging hardware platforms.
  • Prototype and evaluate new hardware and software capabilities, investigate system behaviors, and drive root-cause analysis for complex issues spanning hardware, firmware, drivers, and operating system components.
  • Develop and maintain automated validation frameworks, regression test suites, and supporting infrastructure to improve test coverage, scalability, and execution efficiency.
  • Analyze performance, reliability, and compatibility issues across the platform stack and partner with engineering teams to drive resolution.
  • Debug and enhance device drivers, platform software, and supporting system components to ensure robust functionality and product quality.
  • Collaborate with architects, hardware engineers, firmware developers, operating system teams, and external silicon partners to define requirements, refine solutions, and deliver capabilities across multiple product generations.
  • Contribute to the design of maintainable, modular, and reusable software components with an emphasis on quality, diagnosability, and long-term supportability.
  • Participate in technical design reviews, code reviews, and validation reviews to improve engineering excellence and product outcomes.
  • Work effectively in an Agile development environment, contributing to planning, implementation, testing, and continuous improvement activities.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, or Python.
    • OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in software and/or product development.
  • Proven C/C++ design, coding, debugging and testing skills.
  • Solid communication skills required, including the ability to clearly express technical concepts in verbal and written forms.
  • SoC bring-up, bootloaders, platform initialization, and hardware enablement.
  • Platform technologies and peripherals including PCIe, NVMe, USB, I2C, SPI, UART, and related interfaces.
  • Device driver development and debugging.
  • Windows Plug and Play architecture and device management.
  • Operating system fundamentals including memory management, scheduling, interrupts, synchronization, and multithreaded programming.
  • Kernel debugging, crash dump analysis, hardware debugging, and JTAG-based bring-up.
  • Performance analysis and system-level troubleshooting.
  • Building scalable automation frameworks and automated test infrastructure.

title: SLP
description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION

Responsible for assisting patients who have illness, injury or disability that affects their ability to communicate effectively in their environment. Addresses issues related to swallowing disorders. Treatment is focused on increasing intelligibility of speech, using alternative or augmentative devices to facilitate better communication of wants and needs, addressing cognitive functions and improving swallowing safety through oral exercises and diet texture modification.

• Develop effective treatment plans and obtain approval for services from referring physician.

• Participate in patient care planning and utilization review meetings.

• Demonstrate the knowledge and skills necessary to provide patient care appropriate in a SNF setting.

• Demonstrate the knowledge and skills with administering standardized speech/language assessments, conduct swallowing evaluations, developing treatment plans and monitoring patient’s progress.

• Perform test and complex treatments individually or with assistance as needed.

• Document patient evaluations, treatment progress notes, and discharge summaries for the patient’s medical records in a timely manner as defined by the department policy manual.

• Providing a full range of speech therapy modalities consistent with previous education and expedience.

• Assist with the clinical affiliations of speech therapy assistants.

• Perform a clinical assessment to identify patient needs and appropriateness of patient. Analyze patient needs and administer appropriate care as ordered by a physician.

• Document, prepare and complete a Plan of Care, progress notes, phone orders and other clinical record documentation on an ongoing basis.

title: Chemical Technician
description:

Logistics & Operational Support

description:

Job Title: Certified Medical Assistant – Clinical Coordinator I

FLSA Status: Non-exempt

About us

Physicians East, P.A.is a team of skilled healthcare professionals united to meet the challenge of delivering quality, cost-efficient, comprehensive healthcare to the people of Eastern North Carolina.

Location & commitments

FT/PT/Temp/PRN role based at Greenville OB/GYN, Monday-Friday, 8a.m. – 5 p.m.
