Weekend work is rare but can occasionally be necessary.

Occasionally lifts and carries items weighing up to 100 pounds. Requires normal visual acuity and hearing. Requires exposure to bodily fluids.


Typical Working Conditions:

Frequent exposure to communicable diseases, toxic substances, ionizing radiation, medicinal preparations, and other conditions common to a clinic environment.


About the role

The Certified Medical Assistant works interdependently with other medical professionals to provide quality health care to a high volume of patients. Medical Assistants provide direct patient care for and treats patients in the office, as directed by Physician, Advanced Practice Provider, Registered Nurse or supervising clinical manager.

Responsibilities: (This list may not include all of the duties assigned.)

  • Under clinical supervision, performs delegated procedures common to the specialty area in a safe, effective manner according to Policy and Procedures.

  • Record all allergies, medications, and pertinent lab work on flow sheets.
  • Orders, stocks, and maintains exam rooms and clinic areas.
  • Disinfect exam rooms in-between patients.
  • Performs related and delegated tasks, taking and relaying messages and directing patient flow.
  • Assist patient to complete health history.
  • Ear lavage
  • Preparing and administering medications under the direction of supervising physicians.
  • Notify patients of normal lab results.
  • Prepping exam rooms for clinical procedures and assisting practitioners with patient care.
  • Assisting physicians during routine checkups and other physical exams as needed.
  • Complete Clorox 360 training
  • Follow standing orders already entered in the patients EMR (UA, Flu, Strep)
  • Update the patients EMR with standing orders for tests if needed. (UA, Flu, Strep)
  • Administer PO medications under direct supervision of the physician.
  • Administer orthostatic blood pressures.
  • The ability to work as a provider’s assistant in the daily clinic.
  • Assist patients by answering phone calls and refilling medications at the direction of the physician.
  • Make referrals to other departments and clinics to coordinate patients care.

Other duties:

Graduate of an accredited associate degree Medical Assistant program and current certification through AAMA, NHA, RMA or similar organization is required. Prior healthcare giver experience required

  • Professional demeanor and recognition of privacy considerations for patients and families.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
Department: Corporate Information Technology (CIT) 
Reports To: Director, IT & Cyber Security

For more than two decades, FoodChain ID has been at the forefront of the New Food industry, providing expertise worldwide to navigate the requirements of an ever-growing demand for higher levels of transparency, accountability, safety, and sustainability. Our technical and business services include serving clean label, food safety, and sustainability claims through offerings of Non-GMO Project verification, USDA Organic certification, BRC and SQF food safety certification, and more. We are looking to grow our team of passionate Software, Data, and Machine Learning Engineers who are excited about using data and software to ensure the safety, transparency, and integrity of the global food chain, one client and product at a time.

The successful candidate combines strong technical expertise with leadership skills, project management capabilities, and a commitment to improving systems, processes, and team effectiveness. This position plays a critical role in maintaining secure, reliable, and scalable technology services while supporting business growth and cybersecurity initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Systems Engineering & Technical Leadership

Stakeholder Engagement
  • Build strong relationships with business stakeholders and technology partners.
  • Translate technical concepts into business-focused recommendations.
  • Collaborate with global teams to support enterprise initiatives and service delivery.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor within the organization.
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or related IT roles.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, endpoint management, and cloud services.
  • Experience with endpoint security platforms.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles and enterprise IT operations.
  • Experience leading technical projects and infrastructure implementations.

  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with monitoring solutions, and automation tools.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and hybrid environments.

Success Measures
  • Successful delivery of strategic IT projects.

title: Motorcycle Technician
description:
About Company:

Join the Iron Steed Harley-Davidson Family

Are you passionate about Harley-Davidson and eager to share that excitement with others? Iron Steed H-D is looking for someone with a great attitude who thrives in a fast-paced, fun, and customer-focused environment.

Buying a Harley-Davidson motorcycle is a life-changing decision that opens the door to an entirely new lifestyle. As a team member, you’ll play a key role in introducing new riders to this world—providing exceptional service, guidance, and a welcoming experience.

We offer extensive training and access to industry-leading tools to help you build your skills and succeed. This is your opportunity to join one of the most dynamic and fastest-growing Harley-Davidson dealerships in California.

About Iron Steed Harley-Davidson

At Iron Steed Harley-Davidson, fulfilling dreams of personal freedom isn’t just a motto—it’s our purpose and passion. Located in Vacaville, CA, we’re committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences that reflect the spirit of the Harley-Davidson lifestyle.

We’re not just a dealership—we’re riders ourselves. We understand our customers because we live the same dream they do. Whether it’s on the sales floor or out on the open road, we take pride in being part of something bigger: a community built on freedom, adventure, and camaraderie.

We are Iron Steed Harley-Davidson.

About the Role:

As a Motorcycle Technician within the retail trade industry, you will play a critical role in ensuring the safety, performance, and reliability of motorcycles for our customers. Your expertise will be essential in diagnosing mechanical and electrical issues, performing routine maintenance, and executing complex repairs to a high standard. You will work closely with the service team to deliver timely and efficient service, enhancing customer satisfaction and loyalty. This role demands a strong commitment to quality workmanship and adherence to safety protocols, contributing directly to the reputation and success of our retail operation. Ultimately, your work will enable riders to enjoy their motorcycles with confidence and peace of mind.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Completion of a recognized motorcycle technician training program or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • Proven experience in motorcycle repair and maintenance.
  • Strong understanding of motorcycle mechanical and electrical systems.
  • Valid driver’s license with M1 endorsement.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification from the Motorcycle Mechanics Institute (MMI) or equivalent.
  • Experience working with Harley-Davidson motorcycle years and models.
  • Familiarity with diagnostic software and computerized repair tools.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced retail environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform detailed inspections and diagnostics on motorcycles to identify mechanical, electrical, and safety issues.
  • Conduct routine maintenance tasks such as oil changes, brake adjustments, tire replacements, and chain lubrication.
  • Repair or replace defective parts including engines, transmissions, brakes, and electrical components.
  • Maintain accurate service records and communicate repair status and recommendations to customers and service advisors.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety standards and manufacturer specifications during all repair and maintenance activities.
  • Collaborate with parts department to order and manage inventory of necessary components.
  • Stay updated on the latest motorcycle technologies, tools, and repair techniques through ongoing training.

Skills:

The required skills enable the technician to accurately diagnose and repair a wide range of motorcycle issues, ensuring safety and performance standards are met. Mechanical aptitude and electrical knowledge are applied daily to troubleshoot complex problems and perform precise repairs. Communication skills are essential for explaining technical information clearly to customers and coordinating with team members. Preferred skills such as certification and familiarity with diagnostic software enhance efficiency and accuracy in service delivery. Together, these skills support a professional, customer-focused approach that drives operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

title: Trusted Tester - Level I (Web Tester)
description:
At Team Carney, we believe that true performance acceleration happens at the intersection of innovative learning and deep strategic expertise. Since 1994, our mission has been to provide top-tier training, learning, and human capital solutions that empower Federal Government agencies to meet their critical mandates. We are seeking a detail-oriented, high-performing Trusted Tester - Level I (Web Tester) to support our federal client.

This position is contingent on contract award.

Work Schedule and Location

  • Employment Status: Part-Time (~30 hours per week)

  • Location: This position is fully remote, based out of Fredericksburg, VA.

Who You Are & What You’ll Do

The Trusted Tester - Level I (Web Tester) will be responsible for evaluating, testing, and validating Section 508 compliance across a wide array of Information and Communications Technology (ICT) deliverables, web-based applications, and digital learning products.

You will utilize the current Department of Homeland Security (DHS) approved assessment methods, test reporting tools, and conformance processes to ensure all digital assets meet Revised Section 508 Standards. You will conduct rigorous web accessibility evaluations, document technical non-conformance defects, and collaborate closely with development and instructional design teams to deliver fully accessible, compliant, and inclusive user experiences.

What You Bring to the Table - Requirements

  • Certification: Active DHS Trusted Tester Version 5.0 (or later) Certification required.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.

  • Technical Experience:

    • 2+ years of experience working with Information and Communications Technology (ICT) environments.

    • 1+ year of dedicated Section 508 accessibility testing experience.

  • Assessment Methodology: Demonstrated experience using the DHS Trusted Tester Version Section 508 Conformance Test Process for Web (v5.0 or later) and official DHS test reporting tools and formats.

  • Core Capabilities:

    • Section 508 Standards Knowledge: Solid working knowledge of the Revised Section 508 Standards and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

    • Web Conformance Testing: Expertise executing standardized manual and automated web accessibility test scripts across various browsers and ICT interfaces.

    • Defect Identification & Reporting: Ability to accurately document compliance failures, generate standardized test reports, and provide clear remediation guidance.

    • Collaboration: Strong communication skills to liaise with project managers, developers, and content creators to integrate accessibility best practices early in the product lifecycle.

Why Join Team Carney?

When you join Team Carney, you join a legacy of excellence. We focus on our people because when we make a positive impact on the lives of our employees, they are able to make a positive impact on our clients. We offer a full suite of competitive benefits, including:

  • Health & Wellness: Multiple medical, dental, and vision insurance options (BCBS CareFirst), health spending accounts (HSA), and flexible spending accounts (FSA).

  • Financial Security: 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plus Carney-paid life and disability insurance.

  • Work-Life Harmony: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), 11 paid holidays, and 6 weeks of paid parental leave.

  • Professional & Personal Growth: Annual tuition assistance (up to $5,000) and student loan repayment.

  • Get Out and Learn: Up to $200 annually to learn almost anything (from pottery to coding!).

  • Get Out and Run: Up to $200 annually to participate in fitness and active lifestyle events.

  • Continuous Development: Ad hoc training and ongoing professional development access.

As our new Technical Program Coordinator, you will work closely with IT teams and business stakeholders to coordinate sprint and delivery activities, maintain the rolling roadmap, administer project information in Azure DevOps, and strengthen the documentation and processes that support consistent delivery. You will help bring structure and clarity across multiple initiatives, keeping priorities, actions, requirements, and documentation current while ensuring the right people have visibility into progress, blockers, and next steps.

This is an existing, full-time role, working 2 days remotely and 3 days on-site at 85 Richmond Street West, with a move to our new headquarters at 120 Bloor Street East in 2027.

What’s in it for you

Career-building exposure. You will gain hands-on experience coordinating technology initiatives across IT, Data, and Automation while building your skills in Agile delivery, Azure DevOps, documentation, roadmap management, and stakeholder communication. You will have exposure to a broad range of initiatives, including enterprise CRM and student information system projects, new program launches, and acquisition-related work.

Ownership and visibility. You will take ownership of the coordination and delivery practices that help the team stay organized and keep work moving forward. Working closely with the Manager, IT Architecture & DevOps and stakeholders across the organization, you will have visibility into priorities, projects, and decisions while becoming a trusted point of connection between technical teams and the business.

Growth and breadth. This is a newly created role with the opportunity to build a strong foundation in technical program and project coordination. You will learn how technology initiatives move from intake and planning through delivery and documentation, gaining broad experience across projects, systems, teams, and stakeholders that can support your continued growth in IT and technology delivery.

How you will make an impact

  • Coordinate delivery. You will support intake, sprint planning, and delivery scheduling across IT initiatives, helping teams stay aligned on priorities, timelines, ownership, and next steps. You will prepare recurring sprint alignment sessions, capture actions and decisions, and follow up on outstanding items to keep work moving forward.
  • Maintain visibility. You will maintain the rolling roadmap and keep delivery information accurate and current as priorities evolve. You will use Azure DevOps to administer work items, iterations, dates, statuses, and timelines, helping teams and stakeholders maintain a clear view of progress, upcoming work, and blockers.
  • Strengthen documentation. You will help establish consistent documentation practices across the team, reviewing runbooks and technical documentation for completeness, clarity, and readiness for handoff. You will maintain the Product Library and knowledge base, flag outdated information, follow up with owners, and help ensure projects are properly documented before they are closed.
  • Connect teams and stakeholders. You will work across IT teams and business units to support clear communication around priorities, requirements, project status, and delivery. You will coordinate cross-functional meetings, document decisions and actions, and help make it easier for stakeholders to understand how work moves through the intake and delivery process.
  • Keep priorities moving. You will track open vendor activities, support tickets, escalations, requirements, and follow-up items through to resolution. You will surface aging items and blockers, maintain accurate records, and proactively follow up with the right people to keep commitments and deliverables on track.

What you bring

  • The project coordination experience. You have experience supporting technology projects, delivery teams, or related initiatives where you have coordinated priorities, tracked actions and requirements, maintained project information, and followed work through to completion. You understand the fundamentals of Agile delivery, including sprints, epics, stories, backlogs, and the practices that keep project information organized and current.
  • The technical aptitude. You are comfortable working with technology teams and using project or work management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or a similar platform. You can quickly learn new systems and processes, and you are confident working within the Microsoft ecosystem, including tools such as SharePoint, OneDrive, Power BI, Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate
  • The attention to detail. You understand the value of accurate, accessible documentation and consistent project practices. You can maintain runbooks, trackers, knowledge repositories, action items, and other project documentation, identifying gaps and following up with others to ensure information is complete and up to date.
  • The communication skills. You can build relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders, ask thoughtful questions, and translate project information into clear updates and next steps. You are comfortable connecting with new people, facilitating conversations, and following up when you need information or action from others.
  • The initiative and organization. You can manage multiple priorities without losing sight of the details or waiting to be prompted on every next step. You take ownership of follow-through, recognize when something needs attention, and know when to resolve an issue independently and when to bring it forward for support or a decision.

Why work at Yorkville University?

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we are united by a shared purpose: placing the student experience at the heart of everything we do. Whether you are teaching, designing curriculum, advising students, advancing technology, or supporting operations, your work directly fuels learning potential, strengthens inclusive communities, and fosters purposeful curiosity.

Here, professional growth is part of our culture. In your role, you will have opportunities to help the launch of career-relevant programs, expand your expertise, and access tuition-free courses across our institutions - from certificates to master’s degrees. Curiosity, initiative, and innovation are encouraged, and your ideas can move from vision to reality.

Our scale offers the best of both worlds: the reach and stability of a national institution combined with the agility of a mid-sized organization, where contributions are visible and valued. You will be part of a diverse and inclusive community where authenticity is celebrated, collaboration is expected, and impact is shared - on students, colleagues, and your own professional journey.

At Yorkville and Toronto Film School, your work does more than make a difference. It empowers others to achieve their potential, while allowing you to realize yours.

Compensation philosophy

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe compensation should be fair, transparent, and supportive of long-term growth.

This position offers a minimum annual salary of $70,000, a midpoint of $75,000, and a maximum of $80,000. Established hires typically start near the midpoint, while the upper range is reserved for those with deep expertise and sustained contributions. Offers below the midpoint recognize strong potential with room to grow. Our compensation approach is designed to be equitable and consistent.

We welcome open and transparent conversations about compensation throughout the hiring process.

Join us

We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we seek, express your interest.

What you can expect from our hiring process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining Yorkville University and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A virtual interview with the Manager, IT Architecture & DevOps and the Director, IT Architecture. You will discuss your experience, the day-to-day responsibilities of the role, and your understanding of technical and Agile delivery concepts.
  • A final in-person interview with the Manager, IT Architecture & DevOps, the Director, IT Architecture, and the Manager, IT Enterprise Applications. This conversation will focus on situational and scenario-based questions to understand how you approach problems, organize priorities, and work through real-world situations.

Diversity, equity, and inclusion are critical components of life at Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, and we are committed to making these values an integral part of our culture. We encourage applications from all qualified applicants, including women, persons with disabilities, Black, Indigenous and People of Colour (BIPOC), people from the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Transsexual, Queer, Questioning, Two-Spirit, Intersex, Asexual + (LGBTQ2SIA+) community and other equity-seeking groups.

Yorkville University is committed to providing accessible employment practices that comply with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation for disability, please notify Human Resources at 1-877-429-4029.

title: Revenue Cycle & Authorizations Specialist - Podiatry Clinic
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented, high-performing Revenue Cycle & Authorizations Specialist to manage patient eligibility, obtain prior authorizations, and drive accounts receivable (AR) recovery.

This role manages a core volume of approximately 200 claims per week, with a primary focus on navigating and resolving complex claim denials, prior authorization hurdles, and payer issues associated with two major HMO plans. The ideal candidate thrives on problem-solving, possesses strong payer navigation skills, and excels at keeping practice revenues steady and predictable.

Requirements

Primary Responsibilities

Accounts Receivable & Denials Management

  • Manage end-to-end follow-ups on unpaid, underpaid, and denied claims across accounts receivable (AR) aging reports.
  • Serve as the dedicated specialist for two high-priority HMO plans—actively researching rejection reasons, resubmitting corrected claims, filing appeals, and escalating administrative roadblocks.
  • Process routine Medicare and PPO denials swiftly to ensure low aging across simpler payer types.
  • Process, track, and reconcile approximately 200 claims per week.

Authorizations & Insurance Verification

  • Perform insurance eligibility and coverage verifications prior to patient appointments.
  • Submit, track, and secure prior authorizations from commercial and managed care payers to prevent coverage gaps and claim rejections.
  • Maintain clear communication with clinical staff regarding authorization statuses, limitations, and approval updates.

Payer & Patient Communication

  • Place high-volume follow-up calls to HMO representatives, medical groups, and clearinghouses to clear claim holds.
  • Communicate politely and clearly with patients regarding insurance coverage rules, outstanding balances, or required authorization steps.

Qualifications & Key Requirements

  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in medical billing, accounts receivable management, and insurance prior authorizations.
  • HMO Expertise: Strong working knowledge of HMO medical group referrals, capitation/FFS structures, and HMO-specific appeal pathways.
  • Coding & Billing Knowledge: Working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS codes, modifiers, and CMS-1500 claim formats.
  • Volume Capability: Proven ability to manage a consistent workload of ~200 claims per week without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Reliability: High level of punctuality and commitment to maintaining the established 38-hour weekly work schedule.

title: Senior OT Security Specialist
description:
Within our Operational Technology (OT) division in Project Delivery & Engineering, we deliver and integrate digital solutions that support renewable energy production and ensure reliable operations. As the primary provider of digital solutions for Business Unit Offshore Wind, and of Business Unit Onshore and Solar and Batteries, we manage the entire value chain, from bid acquisition to asset construction and operation, focusing on Operational Technology (OT) and IT. Cybersecurity and compliance are critical pillars in this mission.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior OT Security Specialist - with proven track record in helping teams to implement security controls - to join our Security & Compliance team. Being part of first line of defence, we are strengthening and maintaining the implementation of preventive and reactive security measures related to ISO 27001, ISO 27019, and directives such as NIS2 and CER, all steered through our internal ISMS. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring continuous improvement and adaptation to evolving regulations, translating complex requirements into practical solutions that create business value. The Security & Compliance team is a business enabler and your service- and collaborative mindset will ensure your success in this role.

Your Responsibilities

  • Drive the implementation and ongoing maturity of the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and related compliance frameworks, including NIS2, across the organization.
  • Translate ISMS requirements and best practices into clear, actionable procedures and work instructions for leadership and technical specialists such as network and server engineers.
  • Plan and facilitate risk assessments, advise on synergies between identified risks, and connect findings to planned projects.
  • Interface with colleagues in 1st line, internal stakeholders, and 2nd line of defence - supporting internal activities leading up to audits, during audits, and afterwards, by consulting on mitigative actions to close non-compliances findings.
  • Support the organization in fulfilling compliance responsibilities to maintain a high level of compliance risk coverage.

Your work will span strategic planning, hands-on implementation, and facilitating procedures and documentation work, ensuring robust security and compliance practices.

Key Tasks

  • Lead the internal adaptation and continues maturity of compliance with Vattenfall ISMS, protecting our spinning assets and ensuring compliance with ISO 27001, ISO 27019, NIS2, and CER directives.
  • Coordination & Follow-up: Drive the compliance aspect of project ensuring progress, monitor deliverables, and contribute with data, presentations, and reporting.
  • Documentation & Quality Assurance: Review and develop processes, guidelines, and standards to ensure accuracy, relevance, and accessibility.
  • Audit support & Compliance: Participate in internal and external audits, manage deviations, and ensure systems and procedures meet directive requirements.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: guide and enable technical specialists in crafting fit-for-purpose security solutions and foster a strong, cooperative work environment.

You have experience in translating security requirements into useful and descriptive best-practices for technical experts, enabling easy adaptation. Preferably from an utility, industrial, or production environment. You are structured, analytical, and thrive in roles where you create clarity and make things happen - even in areas lacking structure. You communicate clearly at all organizational levels and enjoy being a key player in identifying, solving, and implementing solutions. You foster collaboration and enjoy enabling others making them knowledgably and capable in engineering and maturing engineering solutions.

Additionally, you bring:

  • Experience with compliance, digital security, or quality systems across requirement scoping, reviewing, and assessing solutions.
  • Ability to balance regulatory requirements with business feasible solutions.
  • Experience with ISO 27001 and preferably NIS2, ISO 27019, or IEC 62443.
  • Strong skills in conveying complex topics in a clear, practical manner.
  • Experience in planning and coordinating activities in large organizations.
  • Excellent written communication skills and command of the English language.
  • Personal qualities: proactive, independent, structured, and collaborative.
  • We welcome candidates from a wide range of educational backgrounds; and experience from the energy sector or an engineering degree is considered an advantage.

Our offer
Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information
We welcome your application in English, no later than 27/09/2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Adam Hammond via adam.hammond@vattenfall.com

Commitment to Diversity

Vattenfall is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed on merit. We offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, staff engagement forums and services to support all our employees.

We are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Lead Technical Writer (Remote, US)
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Lumen is seeking a strategic, detail-oriented Senior Lead Technical Writer to support the Managed & Professional Services organization. This role owns the development and governance of clear, accurate, and customer-centered content that enables the full product lifecycle, from strategy and product development through launch, sales enablement, implementation, operations, and continuous improvement.

The Senior Lead Technical Writer partners with product management, engineering, operations, security, architecture, legal, marketing, sales, and customer success to translate complex service capabilities into consistent, usable documentation. The role has responsibility for content supporting Managed Network Services and Managed Security Services, while also establishing standards and scalable practices across the broader Managed & Professional Services portfolio.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the strategy, planning, creation, editing, governance, and maintenance of technical and product documentation across the Managed & Professional Services portfolio.
  • Create product definitions, service descriptions, technical overviews, solution briefs, implementation and configuration guides, operating procedures, release notes, knowledge articles, FAQs, process flows, and training materials.
  • Translate complex network, security, operational, and service concepts into concise content for customer, sales, delivery, executive, operational, and technical audiences.
  • Partner with product managers and subject-matter experts to document capabilities, requirements, dependencies, use cases, customer outcomes, service boundaries, assumptions, and lifecycle changes.
  • Establish documentation standards, templates, terminology, metadata, taxonomy, review workflows, structured-authoring practices, and reusable content components.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for managed network services, including architecture, connectivity, monitoring, service levels, supported configurations, implementation, migration, operational handoffs, and lifecycle changes.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for managed security services, including monitoring, detection and response, vulnerability management, incident handling, shared-responsibility models, data flows, integrations, escalation paths, and service boundaries.
  • Conduct content audits and gap assessments, mentor writers and contributors, communicate documentation risks to leadership, and ensure content meets applicable accessibility, brand, legal, regulatory, privacy, security, and records-management requirements.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Communications, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in technical writing, product documentation, or content strategy, including experience leading complex documentation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to write for cloud-based, network, security, telecommunications, managed services, or enterprise technology offerings.
  • Strong understanding of product development, product lifecycle management, service delivery, and operational readiness practices.
  • Ability to synthesize input from diverse subject matter experts and translate highly technical information into clear, concise, accurate, and usable content.
  • Excellent writing, editing, interviewing, facilitation, information architecture, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Experience establishing documentation standards, governance, review processes, content reuse, and lifecycle controls.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools and experience with modern content management, knowledge management, collaboration, diagramming, and work-management platforms.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently, exercise sound judgment, and deliver high-quality work in a complex, matrixed environment.
  • Portfolio or writing samples demonstrating technical depth, audience adaptation, structured content, and editorial quality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience documenting Managed Network Services, Managed Security Services, professional services, telecom, network operations, security operations, observability, automation, or IT service management.
  • Familiarity with networking and security concepts such as SD-WAN, routing, switching, cloud connectivity, firewalls, secure access, threat monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and security operations.
  • Experience with structured authoring, docs-as-code, component content management, content analytics, AI-assisted authoring, or multi-channel publishing.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL practices, Agile product development, accessibility standards, and information security or compliance frameworks.
  • Relevant certifications such as CPTC, ITIL 4, Security+, CISSP, CCNA, or comparable technical writing, networking, security, or service-management credentials.

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

Location Based Pay Ranges

$105,786 - $141,047 in these states: AL AR AZ FL GA IA ID IN KS KY LA ME MO MS MT ND NE NM OH OK PA SC SD TN UT VT WI WV WY
$111,074 - $148,099 in these states: CO HI MI MN NC NH NV OR RI
$116,364 - $155,152 in these states: AK CA CT DC DE IL MA MD NJ NY TX VA WA

title: Director, Software Engineering
description:
Who We Are

ZOLEO is redefining what it means to keep people safe beyond traditional coverage. What began as a hardware-led connectivity solution is evolving into a trusted safety and monitoring platform – one that delivers peace of mind, everywhere. Today, we are building a service-driven, duty-of-care platform that goes beyond messaging – ensuring that when it matters most, help is not just reachable, but already in motion.

Our platform is designed for both the person in the field, and the people connected to their safety – because peace of mind travels both ways. By combining advanced intelligence, automation, and a global safety ecosystem, we deliver outcomes – not just connectivity – creating reassurance, accountability, and certainty under stress. At ZOLEO, we’re not just building technology; we’re defining the future of safety. Our impact is real — just ask the people whose lives have been saved thanks to ZOLEO rescue alerts (read their stories).

Why This Role Matters

ZOLEO is building the safety platform people trust when nothing else works — no cell signal, no Wi-Fi, no room for error. Delivering on that promise takes engineering teams that turn clear priorities into dependable, high-quality products, consistently and at scale.

As Director, Software Engineering, you'll own delivery across our product engineering teams — leading Team Leads and engineers, and shaping how the function plans, executes, and delivers. You'll partner directly with the CTO, Product leadership, and senior technical leaders, turning strategy into predictable execution while building the next generation of engineering leaders.

This is an AI-first engineering environment — Cursor, Claude Code, and agentic workflows are already part of how the team builds. You'll be the one who turns that edge into measurable gains: faster delivery, higher quality, and a team that keeps getting sharper.

What’s In It for You

  • Function-Level Impact. Own the delivery performance of an engineering organization whose work keeps people safe and connected around the world — what you build here matters, literally.
  • Build Strong Teams and Leaders. Develop Team Leads, deepen the leadership bench, and build the conditions where engineers do their best work — and want to stay.
  • An AI-First Engineering Culture. Shape how the team puts Cursor, Claude Code, and agentic workflows to work — real speed and quality gains, used responsibly.
  • Operational Excellence at Scale. Build the delivery rhythms, measures, and quality practices that make predictable execution the default, not the exception.
  • A Highly Collaborative Mandate. Sit at the table with Technology, Product, and senior engineering partners — shaping priorities, architecture, team design, and where the function goes next.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Engineering Delivery. Lead commitments, sequencing, capacity, and cross-team dependencies across the product engineering teams — surfacing risks early and keeping a delivery plan the business can count on.
  • Lead and Develop the Function. Manage and develop Team Leads, and drive people leadership across the engineering organization — performance, growth, compensation input, succession planning, and team health.
  • Build and Scale the Team. Own engineering hiring, selection, and onboarding while strengthening the leadership bench as the organization grows and evolves.
  • Drive Operational Excellence. Build planning and delivery rhythms, and use meaningful measures to improve throughput, predictability, and outcomes. Strengthen service ownership, incident learning, testing, automation, observability, and release discipline behind every release.
  • Scale AI-Assisted Engineering. Set the bar for practical, secure, and measurable use of AI tools across planning, implementation, testing, and review — and keep pushing engineering effectiveness forward.
  • Partner Across Product and Technology. Work with Product leadership on priorities and capacity, and with senior technical leaders on architecture, standards, and the support required to put them into practice.
  • Govern Tooling and Vendors. Manage engineering tooling, cloud and model consumption, contractor spend, and relevant vendor relationships. Ensure appropriate access controls, reviews, offboarding, training completion, and adherence to security requirements.

What You Bring

  • Relevant Background. Deep software engineering experience, including leadership of multiple teams and direct management of Engineering Managers, Team Leads, or other engineering leaders.
  • Delivery Leadership. A track record of turning strategy and priorities into credible plans — managing capacity and dependencies, surfacing risk early, and steadily improving delivery predictability.
  • People Leadership. A track record of hiring, coaching, evaluating, and developing engineers and leaders — and building accountable, inclusive, high-performing teams along the way.
  • Technical Judgment. The technical depth to challenge estimates, ask incisive questions about design and architecture, understand meaningful trade-offs, and identify execution risks.
  • Operational Excellence. Experience improving engineering practices such as planning, service ownership, incident review, testing, CI/CD, observability, backlog health, or delivery metrics.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering Mindset. Practical experience using or leading the adoption of AI coding tools and agentic workflows, with a focus on measurable value, responsible use, and sound review practices.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership. The ability to collaborate effectively with Product and Technology leaders, communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders, and balance customer, business, technical, and team needs.
  • Resource Stewardship. Experience managing budgets, vendors, contractors, cloud costs, or engineering tooling with sound judgment and clear accountability.
  • Relevant Product and Organizational Experience. Experience with mobile, cloud, connected-device, or safety-focused products, leading teams through growth or organizational change, or building management capability within a Team Lead model is an asset.

What We Offer

  • Salary Range. $200,000 - $220,000 CAD annual base salary.
  • Flexible Work. A hybrid model; balancing collaboration and lifestyle flexibility.
  • Comprehensive Benefits. Health, dental, and flexible spending accounts tailored to your needs.
  • Time to Recharge. Vacation and sick days to help you rest, recharge, and stay well.
  • Growth Investment. A continuous learning environment backed by a professional development budget.
  • Inclusive by Nature. A values-driven workplace where diverse perspectives are celebrated.

Apply Now

Our recruitment process may use artificial intelligence tools, alongside human review, to assist with the screening or assessment of candidates.

We are currently hiring for this role and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible workplace. If you meet around 70% of the qualifications, we still encourage you to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

We’re happy to provide reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process; if you require support, please let us know when you apply, and we’ll work with you to meet your needs.

title: Bilingual Packaging Utility Operator
description:
Packaging Utility Operator

Purpose of the Position

This position is responsible for supporting and backing up operators in the packaging process in accordance with operational manuals and quality criteria.

Responsibilities & Essential Functions

  • Produces the required quantity of batched recipes within established specifications and tolerances and according to production plan.
  • Inspects dry ingredient materials and other raw materials, as well as in process materials as necessary ensuring compliance with function, quality, and recipe specifications.
  • Maintains logs and records of units produced including a record of errors resulting in rejected/discarded materials.
  • Perform pre-operational equipment, preventative maintenance tasks, and process inspections.
  • Perform quality and sanitation functions per Quality Program and Master Sanitation Schedule.
  • Report maintenance and quality opportunities with shift supervisors and/or managers.
  • Interface with plant ERP system to assure inventory control, lot traceability, and tracking.
  • Maintains a clean, safe, orderly work area.

Packaging Utility Operator Specific Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Supports Packaging Operator, learning their role and providing a variety of tasks both mechanical and manual in nature.
  • Back-up Packaging Operator and perform Packaging Operator tasks.
  • Responsible for case filling, manual palletization, packaging, bagging, case labeling, bag lot coding, case check weighing, sanitation and supporting operators.
  • Operate all equipment both manual and automatic associated with packaging, including palletization, case filling, packaging, conveyors/scales, etc.
  • Responsible for housekeeping of the packaging machine(s), and plant area. (e.g., sweeping, removing trash, cleaning the machine at the end of the shift, preparing for next shift's production).
  • Check for the cleanliness of equipment.
  • Finalize any paperwork during shift in an accurate, clear, and concise manner.
  • Utilize ERP System for moving in-process materials and products into and out of inventory.
  • Follow all quality guidelines, Master Sanitation Schedules, and maintain a food-safe, sanitary environment.
  • Support other lines, as necessary.
  • Dispose of waste materials and other items as required.
  • Operate forklift as necessary.
  • Support other process functions as necessary during the day to maximize efficiency of plant.

Other

  • Execute the North Freeze Dry Vision, Mission, and Values (VMV’s) at all times.
  • Promote a positive, proactive environment where input from team members is valued and encouraged.
  • Provide back-up support for other roles, as necessary.
  • Available for overtime on a scheduled or call-in/call-back basis, as necessary.
  • Help Translate as needed for communication and training.
  • Other duties as assigned by the manager/supervisor.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess the following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent.
  • Must be Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • (6) months working experience in a manufacturing/production facility preferred.
  • Ability to follow proper food safety, quality and workplace safety procedures and requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to follow oral and written instruction.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships in a team environment.
  • Ability to lift to 50 pounds and stand for extended periods of time.
  • Forklift certification preferred, or willing to obtain.
  • Work well in a team environment.
  • Mechanically inclined, drive yourself to continually grow and develop your role.
  • Ability to adapt and accommodate change.

North Freeze Dry Offers a Comprehensive Benefits Package to Include:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance including employees, child(ren), spouse and family coverage.
  • Ancillary benefits include Life Insurance, Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D), Critical Illness, Accident Insurance, and Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage.
  • 401(K) Program available with a company match up to 4%.
  • Paid Time Off accruing on your first day and Paid Personal Days.
  • 7 Company Paid Holidays.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

The work environment characteristics and physical demands described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This job operates within a plant manufacturing environment. While performing the duties of this job inside the plant, the employee is frequently exposed to normal working conditions for a food manufacturing plant with a noise level that is moderate to loud noise. The role routinely uses machinery equipment, forklifts, computers, as well as laboratory instrumentation and equipment.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee may be required to stand for extended periods of time as well as use hands or fingers to reach or handle, and to reach with hands and arms. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee will frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. All vision abilities are required to encompass close-up work. On occasion, employees must be able to tolerate and endure extended seasonal hours and maintain alertness to meet deadlines.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be exposed to machinery and moving parts, airborne particles including grain dust and hazardous materials or fumes, which may require the use of PPE. The employee may be exposed to adverse weather conditions, extreme temperature changes in the plant from normal temperatures to negative temperatures, extended seasonal hours, high precarious places, and confined spaces. The noise level in some of the work environments may require the use of hearing protection.

About the Company

North Freeze Dry, LLC headquartered in Fargo, ND, is a U.S.-based co-manufacturer that produces freeze-dried companion animal food and treats. The Company’s freeze-drying facility in Little Falls, MN is one of the industry’s largest and most fully integrated freeze-drying co-manufacturing facilities. North Freeze Dry, LLC is a joint venture between Anchor Ingredients Co., LLC, a leading supplier of premium ingredients for the food and pet food industries, and Barrett Petfood Innovations, a rapidly expanding co-manufacturer of premium pet foods.

title: Executive Producer- Beach Happy Company
description:
Job Summary
Beach Happy is seeking a highly creative, hands-on Executive Producer / Head of Content to lead the strategy, production, and execution of all Beach Happy content. This is the senior-most content position within the company and is responsible for turning the Beach Happy brand into a consistent, recognizable content platform across social media, Beach Happy Radio, podcasts, events, partnerships, road experiences, and emerging channels.
This role requires much more than managing a content team. The Executive Producer is a working producer who can develop the idea, cast the right personality, organize the production, capture the content, identify the moment, and get it published. The position leads a lean production team of Road Hosts and Shooter/Editors and is responsible for maintaining a fast, consistent content operation without sacrificing the authenticity and personality that define the Beach Happy brand.
The ideal candidate combines creative vision, strong editorial instincts, production expertise, operational discipline, and an understanding of what makes personality-driven content perform. This person should be equally comfortable developing a new content series, directing talent, planning a multi-city shoot, reviewing audience performance, managing a production budget, or picking up a camera and editing a piece themselves.
Essential Responsibilities
  • Content Strategy & Daily Production: Own the overall Beach Happy content strategy, weekly production slate, shooting routes, production calendar, and publishing cadence across all platforms. Maintain a consistent flow of approximately 2–4 publishable pieces per day while ensuring there are no unnecessary gaps in content production or distribution.
  • Creative & Format Development: Develop repeatable content formats, recurring series, beach and destination features, interviews, event coverage, personality-driven concepts, partner content, and other programming that can grow with the brand. Continuously identify new people, places, trends, and moments that can become compelling Beach Happy content.
  • Editorial Direction & Brand Voice: Own the editorial direction of Beach Happy content, including storytelling, captions, tone, pacing, visual approach, and publishing standards. Ensure content remains authentic, entertaining, positive, family-friendly, and consistent with the Beach Happy brand while avoiding content that feels overly scripted or overproduced.
  • Hands-On Production: Personally shoot and edit content using mobile and mirrorless cameras and fast-turn editing platforms such as CapCut or Adobe Premiere. Capture clean audio in uncontrolled public environments, recognize strong moments in real time, and produce same-day content when needed. This position must remain capable of stepping into any stage of production rather than relying entirely on the team.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development: Lead, cast, coach, schedule, and develop Road Hosts and Shooter/Editors. Establish clear expectations for production quality, speed, ownership, and output while helping on-camera talent strengthen their interviewing, storytelling, self-shooting, and content instincts.
  • Road & Field Production: Plan and oversee Beach Happy road production throughout the Gulf Coast and on multi-day regional or destination shoots. Coordinate routes, schedules, locations, travel, lodging, transportation, equipment, production access, and other logistics required to keep the crew operating efficiently in the field.
  • Events, Activations & Partnerships: Lead content planning and coverage for Beach Happy events, venue activations, partnerships, tourism opportunities, and other brand experiences. Ensure important events have clear production ownership and that content opportunities are identified before, during, and after each activation.
  • Beach Happy Radio: Oversee Beach Happy Radio programming from concept through execution, including programming strategy, recurring segments, rotation, voice breaks, station IDs, sponsor integrations, and other original audio content. Create opportunities for radio programming and personalities to generate additional social and digital content.
  • Podcast & Long-Form Content: Oversee Beach Happy podcast and recurring long-form programming, including format development, cadence, guest planning, recording, post-production, publishing, and distribution. Build each long-form production with social distribution in mind and identify multiple short-form pieces that can extend the life and reach of each episode.
  • Publishing & Distribution: Oversee the complete content workflow from capture through final publication. Ensure finished content is properly formatted and distributed for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and other relevant platforms while maintaining an organized pipeline of upcoming and reusable content.
  • Content Performance & Audience Growth: Monitor audience growth, engagement, content performance, and platform trends to determine what is working and where the team should adjust. Use performance data alongside strong creative judgment to improve formats, publishing decisions, and future production priorities.
  • Budget, Vendors & Production Resources: Manage content-related production expenses and resources, including equipment, software, licensing, travel, freelance support, vendors, paid amplification, and other production needs. Maintain appropriate oversight of spending and provide regular reporting on content investments and performance.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with Beach Happy leadership and internal teams to identify business priorities, partnerships, events, personalities, and stories that should become content. Balance planned production with the flexibility to respond quickly when an unexpected opportunity or culturally relevant moment arises.
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience producing personality-driven, social-first, digital, entertainment, lifestyle, travel, hospitality, or comparable content with a daily or near-daily publishing cadence.
  • Proven ability to personally shoot AND edit short-form content and deliver finished work on a fast or same-day timeline.
  • Strong proficiency with CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or comparable editing software, along with experience shooting on both mobile and mirrorless cameras.
  • Advanced understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and how content should be adapted for different platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience developing successful recurring content formats and identifying stories and moments that connect with an audience.
  • Experience casting, managing, coaching, and directing on-camera personalities and production team members.
  • Proven experience growing digital audiences and using analytics and performance data to guide future content decisions.
  • Strong editorial judgment, storytelling instincts, copywriting skills, and ability to maintain a consistent brand voice across multiple content formats.
  • Experience planning and executing multi-day or multi-city production travel, including schedules, locations, equipment, transportation, and other field-production logistics.
  • Experience managing production budgets, vendors, resources, and recurring financial reporting.
  • Experience with radio, streaming audio, podcasting, music programming, or other recurring audio/long-form programming is strongly preferred.
  • Experience producing within a small, fast-moving team where individuals are expected to work across traditional production.
  • Gulf Coast, hospitality, tourism, entertainment, live event, travel, music, or creator-brand experience is preferred.
  • Must live on the Gulf Coast or be willing to relocate.
  • Valid driver's license and current passport required.
  • Must be available for frequent regional travel, multi-day production trips, evenings, weekends, events, and seasonal production demands.

This is a hands-on leadership position. The Executive Producer must be able to lead the entire content operation while remaining personally capable of shooting, editing, producing, and publishing. Candidates who have moved entirely away from hands-on production will not be the right fit for this role.

title: Director of Applications Management ( Extrusion)
description:

JOB SUMMARY The Director of Application Management – Extrusion is responsible for leading the technical strategy and execution for the Century Extrusion business, with a strong focus on technical applications, customer solutions, and market development. This role requires deep knowledge of extrusion processes, equipment, and applications, with the ability to understand complex customer requirements and translate them into technically sound and commercially viable solutions.
The Director works directly with customers and strategic accounts to identify application needs, develop solutions, support complex opportunities, and drive profitable growth. Working closely with Engineering, Applications, Aftermarket, Marketing, Operations, and executive leadership, this position connects customer and market needs with Century Extrusion’s technical capabilities and commercial strategy.
The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical expertise in extrusion applications and engineered capital equipment.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
· Develop and execute the technical strategy for the Extrusion business to achieve sales, growth, market share, and profitability objectives.
· Serve as a key technical leader for complex extrusion applications and customer opportunities.
· Work directly with customers to understand their materials, processes, production objectives, technical specifications, and application requirements.
· Evaluate customer applications and partner with Engineering and Applications resources to develop appropriate extrusion equipment configurations, process concepts, and technical solutions.
· Provide technical leadership throughout the sales process, including application reviews, equipment recommendations, technical proposals, customer presentations, and complex technical discussions.
· Apply strong knowledge of extrusion processes and equipment to support customer process development, optimization, troubleshooting, and equipment selection.
· Support and participate in customer trials, testing, demonstrations, and other application-development activities required to validate proposed solutions.
· Identify new applications and market opportunities where Century Extrusion's technology and process capabilities can provide customer value.
· Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, partners, and industry stakeholders.
· Lead and support major capital equipment opportunities from initial application development through commercial negotiation and order.
· Develop and execute strategies for strategic and global accounts.
· Ensure customer technical requirements are clearly defined and effectively transferred to Engineering and Operations during project development and execution.
· Support commissioning, startup, and process optimization activities for strategic projects when additional technical or customer support is required.
· Bring the Voice of the Customer into product development, engineering, innovation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
· Identify recurring application and customer requirements and translate those needs into opportunities for product development, differentiation, and standardization.
· Monitor industry trends, emerging applications, competitive technologies, customer investment, and market conditions to identify opportunities for growth.
· Partner with Aftermarket to identify opportunities for equipment upgrades, rebuilds, process improvements, wear components, replacement parts, and other lifecycle solutions.
· Ensure accurate pipeline management, forecasting, opportunity tracking, and reporting utilizing Salesforce.
· Support pricing strategies that balance customer value, market competitiveness, and company profitability.
· Partner with Marketing on technical content, market positioning, industry events, promotional activities, and lead-generation initiatives.
· Represent Century Extrusion at customer visits, technical conferences, trade shows, industry organizations, and other relevant events.
· Collaborate across Engineering, Applications, Aftermarket, Operations, and other functions to support customers throughout the sales and project lifecycle.
· Lead, coach, mentor, and develop the technical extrusion team, providing the commercial and technical guidance necessary to successfully pursue complex opportunities.
· Lead and influence direct and matrixed resources to execute commercial and customer objectives.
· Travel domestically and internationally up to 50%.

MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
· Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field.
· 10+ years of relevant industrial experience, including technical and direct capital equipment sales experience.
· Minimum of 5 years of sales, commercial, or business leadership experience.
· Strong technical experience with twin screw extrusion equipment, processes, and applications.
· Demonstrated experience with polymer processing, plastics compounding, engineered materials, or related extrusion applications.
· Strong understanding of customer materials, process requirements, production objectives, and equipment specifications.
· Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical applications and translate customer requirements into equipment and process solutions.
· Experience supporting application development, customer trials, process optimization, commissioning, and/or troubleshooting.
· Experience managing complex engineered capital equipment opportunities and strategic customer relationships.
· Proven success developing commercial growth and market development strategies.
· Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Applications, Manufacturing, Operations, and Aftermarket.
· Strong financial and business acumen, including pricing, margins, forecasting, budgets, and profitability.
· Strong technical problem-solving and decision-making skills.
· Excellent presentation, negotiation, communication, leadership, and influencing skills.
· Ability to work independently and lead effectively within a global and matrixed organization.

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
· Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field.
· Strong experience with co-rotating twin-screw extrusion equipment and processes.
· Experience within polymer, plastics, battery materials, rubber, petrochemical compounding, and/or engineered materials applications.
· Experience with extrusion process development, optimization, commissioning, and troubleshooting.
· Experience conducting or supporting customer trials and technical demonstrations.
· Knowledge of Engineering and Manufacturing processes.
· Experience supporting global customers and international markets.

title: Data Center Technician
description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues. This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time.

Microsoft is unable to sponsor a work visa for this role due to the nature of the role’s job duties.



Responsibilities

Datacenter Operations

  • Receives guidance and supervision to develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning IT datacenter technology(ies) and equipment. Develops and acquires a fundamental understanding of the functions of, and interactions between cabling infrastructure, network, server, and storage equipment.
  • Complies with Data Center business unit policies, procedures, and deadlines with guidance from experienced technicians and/or direct-line management. Escalates issues related to compliance or operational assurance activities to direct-line management.
  • Completes assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) per task type with guidance from experienced technicians. Seeks guidance from more experienced technicians on challenging or complex tickets.
  • Reviews Process Change Notifications (PCNs) and develops an understanding of the impact to work execution and awareness to changes within their area of work and/or the work of others. Asks questions when they do not have required information and may provide feedback on changes to processes to experienced technicians and/or direct-line management.

Datacenter Work Environment

  • Participates in daily safety briefings. Completes required Environmental & Health Safety (EHS) training, complies with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use), completes required Task Hazard Analysis (THAs), and uses appropriate equipment and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for assigned tasks. Adheres to and promotes a culture of safety, taking proactive action to alert others of safety concerns, near-misses, and/or incidents. Participates in the regular cadence of proactive safety observation reporting processes and systems.
  • Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with other shifts or technician teams, contributing in regular team meetings, asking questions, and partnering with other shifts of technician teams to complete smooth transition and effective handover of ticketed work. Encourages providing and responding to feedback received on ways to work more effectively or enhance efficiency within their team and adopts best practices shared within-and-across shifts or technician teams
  • Completes required security and data management training while complying with security and data management procedures/policies with guidance from other technicians. May escort third party vendors or IT support on-premises at data centers or network sites. Appropriately takes action and reports physical security access concerns and/or incidents to direct-line management or via established reporting methods.
  • As indicated, above, this role has a travel requirement of up to 25% which means you may be required to travel, from time to time, as part of this role.

Managing Service

  • Maintains an awareness of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) through reporting dashboards, systems, for personal monthly performance discussions as needed.
  • Escalates and/or seeks guidance from experienced technicians or direct-line management regarding client interactions.
  • Develops an understanding of cross-functional Data Center processes to support partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Completes required training aligned to job focus areas and workloads (i.e., Break fix, Deployment, Simple Change, Decommission, IT Critical Environment) in a timely manner per direct-line management assignment(s). Observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training (OJT). May complete additional or supplemental training to obtain or maintain relevant industry or technical certifications.

Physical Requirements

  • Applies to but is not limited to US-based Data Center roles: Occasional climbing of ladders. Frequent climbing of stairs and/or ramps. Prolonged standing. Occasional lifting 50lbs / 22.5kg. Occasional push or pull 50-75 lbs / 22.5-34kg. with assistive device. Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction), defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria. Normal color vision for electrical work, defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria.

Service Delivery

  • Follows procedures to immediately communicate, report, and escalate data center technical or safety related incidents to direct-line management. May participate in bridge calls to provide details on incident status and executes on-site follow-up actions as directed if necessary.
  • Performs basic diagnostics and troubleshooting with guidance from experienced technicians and/or via standard procedures to identify the cause(s) of technical issues and replace faulty components in network, storage, or server equipment with zero-to-minimal customer and/or business disruption. title: Senior Software Developer
description:
Senior Software Developer
Remote role

Push the boundaries of tech. In your sweatpants.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior macOS Swift Software Developer to help us change the way the world works, with Parallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity. Here, you’ll develop cutting edge graphics virtualization technology with our Parallels team.

The top creative and technical minds could work anywhere.So why are so many of them choosing Corel? Here are three reasons:

  1. This is the moment.It’s an exciting time at Corel, with new leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.
  1. We want you to be you.Too often, companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Our culture is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe to be who you are, take risks, and show us what you’ve got.

Cool with us. We believe that happy employees mean happy customers. That’s why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let’s talk more about this role and see if we’re destined to be together.

The Role

You

  • Strong commercial experience with Swift and SwiftUI

  • Deep understanding of Swift concurrency - async/await, actors, structured concurrency

  • Ability to design maintainable code and make sound architectural decisions
  • Confident in debugging, troubleshooting, and improving complex production systems
  • Experienced in delivering new features and raising overall code quality
  • Good understanding of modern Objective-C
  • Clear communication, effective collaboration, and ownership of what you build
  • Proactive, self-driven, result-oriented, and eager to share knowledge with the team
  • B.Sc. or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field

Nice to Have

  • Experience with C++ or Objective-C++, particularly Swift↔C++ interop

US:
