title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
Quality Control Inspector – 2nd Shift
Midsouth Steel | College Park, GA
Schedule: Monday–Thursday, 3:00 PM–1:30 AM (with mandatory OT as needed)

Position Summary

Midsouth Steel is seeking a detail-oriented Quality Control Inspector to join our fabrication team on second shift. The Quality Control Inspector will work directly in the fabrication shop, overseeing the quality of work performed by our welding and fabrication teams and ensuring finished products meet Midsouth Steel's quality standards, project specifications, and applicable requirements.
This is a hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of structural steel fabrication and welding processes. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working independently in a busy shop environment, reading blueprints and welding symbols, performing dimensional and visual inspections, and maintaining accurate quality documentation.

Key Responsibilities
  • Inspect structural steel and miscellaneous steel fabrication throughout the production process.
  • Monitor welding and fabrication activities to ensure work is performed according to approved drawings, specifications, and Midsouth Steel quality standards.
  • Perform visual inspections of welds and fabricated components and identify defects, deficiencies, or workmanship issues.
  • Verify dimensions, fit-up, orientation, and other fabrication requirements using tape measures and appropriate inspection tools.
  • Read and interpret structural steel fabrication drawings, shop drawings, details, and welding symbols.
  • Work closely with welders, fabricators, foremen, and production management to identify and resolve quality issues.
  • Document inspection results, nonconformances, corrections, and other quality-related information accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Maintain quality control records and assist with documentation control to ensure inspection records are complete and properly maintained.
  • Verify that required inspections and quality checkpoints are completed throughout the fabrication process.
  • Identify recurring quality issues and communicate them to the Quality Manager and appropriate production personnel.
  • Assist with maintaining compliance with applicable project specifications, welding requirements, and Midsouth Steel quality procedures.
  • Support final inspections of completed fabricated components prior to painting, shipping, or delivery.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area while performing inspections.
  • Perform other quality-related duties as assigned by the Quality Manager.
Required Qualifications
  • Ability and willingness to work second shift: Monday–Thursday, 3:00 PM–1:30 AM.
  • Previous experience in structural steel fabrication, welding, or a related manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to accurately read a tape measure and perform dimensional inspections.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, shop drawings, and fabrication details.
  • Familiarity with welding processes, welding terminology, and welding symbols.
  • Strong understanding of structural steel fabrication practices and quality expectations.
  • Strong documentation control and recordkeeping skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies or workmanship issues.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with welders, fabricators, supervisors, and management.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions regarding quality issues.
  • Ability to work safely in a fast-paced steel fabrication shop environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Previous experience as a Quality Control Inspector in structural steel fabrication.
  • Experience inspecting structural steel welds and fabricated components.
  • Familiarity with AISC quality requirements and structural steel inspection practices.
  • AWS or other welding/quality certifications.
  • Experience with inspection documentation, nonconformance reports, and corrective actions.

title: Investments Analyst
description:

title: Principal Clerk

Safety
  • Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR)
  • Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR)
  • Completion and effectiveness of corrective actions
Quality
  • Customer PPM / Defect Rates
  • Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)

Delivery & Productivity
  • On-Time Delivery (OTD)
  • Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)

Financial
  • Manufacturing cost per unit

People
  • Leadership turnover and succession readiness

Leadership & Technical Competencies
  • Visible, decisive, and action-oriented leader

title: Acquisition Specialist - Construction, A&E

title: Trusted Tester - Level II (Web Tester & Document Remediation)
description:
At Team Carney, we believe that true performance acceleration happens at the intersection of innovative learning and deep strategic expertise. Since 1994, our mission has been to provide top-tier training, learning, and human capital solutions that empower Federal Government agencies to meet their critical mandates. We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented Trusted Tester - Level II (Web Tester & Document Remediation) to support our federal client.

This position is contingent on contract award.

Work Schedule and Location

  • Employment Status: Full-Time

  • Location: This position is fully remote, based out of Fredericksburg, VA.

Who You Are & What You’ll Do

The Trusted Tester - Level II (Web Tester & Document Remediation) will serve as a technical authority for Section 508 accessibility testing, document remediation, and accessibility consulting across Information and Communications Technology (ICT) environments.

In this full-time role, you will perform standardized web accessibility evaluations using the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Trusted Tester v5.0 (or later) process, as well as hands-on remediation of electronic documents and forms across Microsoft Office and Adobe PDF formats. Beyond web and document testing, you will evaluate Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs) and Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs), develop accessibility test plans, advise project teams on remediating complex Section 508 defects, and provide technical guidance for candidates completing accessibility training and DHS Trusted Tester certification examinations.

What You Bring to the Table - Requirements

  • Certification: Active DHS Trusted Tester Version 5.0 (or later) Certification required.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.

  • Technical Experience:

    • 4+ years of overall experience working in Information and Communications Technology (ICT) environments.

    • 2+ years of dedicated web accessibility testing experience using the DHS Trusted Tester process.

    • 2+ years of dedicated experience testing and remediating electronic documents and forms (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe PDF) to Section 508 standards.

  • Assessment & Remediation Methodology:

title: Finance Director
description:
Moladin is seeking an execution-driven Finance Director to oversee total financial governance, regulatory operations, and capital strategy across our automotive fintech and multi-finance platform.

This role requires a hands-on executive leader who combines strategic fiscal management with direct operational involvement in treasury management, external bank financing, regulatory affairs, and audit governance. Moving beyond high-level oversight, the Finance Director will directly manage core financial workflows, secure and manage credit facilities with external financial institutions, maintain tight internal controls, and serve as the primary executive liaison for external auditors, lenders, and banking partners.

Responsibilities
  • Work closely with Management to establish and support strong strategic relationships with 3rd-party commercial banks, multi-finance partners, and institutional debt lenders in Indonesia.
  • Serve as the central executive owner for all statutory, interim, and specialized external audits. Lead direct engagement with Big 4 or major accounting firms, ensuring full audit readiness, timely statement sign-offs, and swift resolution of audit findings.
  • Maintain direct oversight of daily accounting operations, general ledger integrity, and end-to-end month-end/year-end closing processes.
  • Ensure strict compliance with PSAK (Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards) and IFRS, taking ultimate accountability for statutory financial statement accuracy.
  • Establish, enforce, and audit robust internal financial control frameworks to mitigate operational risk and maintain compliance across all group entities.
  • Oversee full compliance with regulatory frameworks, capital adequacy mandates, and reporting requirements established by the Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) and Bank Indonesia.
  • Direct corporate tax planning and operational tax compliance (Corporate Income Tax, VAT/PPN, Withholding Taxes) in adherence to Directorate General of Taxes (DGT) regulations.
  • Conduct granular financial planning and analysis (FP&A) to evaluate product-level unit economics, net interest margins, and yield optimization across core lending and marketplace verticals.
  • Provide direct technical direction, operational coaching, and mentorship to internal Finance, Accounting, Tax, and Treasury teams.
Requirements
  • 10+ years of progressive financial leadership experience, with proven performance as a Financial Controller, Head of Finance.
  • Direct operational experience within Fintech, Multi-Finance (Perusahaan Pembiayaan), SME/Commercial Banking, or High-Growth Tech in Indonesia.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline (Master’s/MBA is advantageous).
  • Active professional certification is strongly preferred (CA, CPA, CFA, or Brevet A/B/C).
  • Expertise in PSAK, Indonesian corporate tax law, and OJK regulatory frameworks.
  • Execution-oriented mindset with high bandwidth for both strategic planning and field-level operational details.
  • Uncompromising professional integrity and strict commitment to governance standards.
  • Professional fluency in both English and Bahasa Indonesia (written and verbal) required for formal regulatory interface, banking negotiations, and investor management.


About Moladin

Moladin is Indonesia’s leading mobility fintech platform with end to end financing solutions for all players in the used car and EV ecosystem. Moladin empowers its rapidly growing network of more than 26,000 active used car agents and dealer MSMEs, and provides used car consumers with better financing access through digitized loan underwriting. This is supported by its strong used car capabilities with branches and warehouses covering more than 100 cities, industry-leading AI / IoT and partnerships with all top auto financing companies across Indonesia, and also through its OJK-regulated multi-finance company PT Moladin Finance Indonesia. Moladin’s vision is to be a positive driving force in the physical and social mobility of all the people it touches (“Mobility for all”).

For further information about Moladin, please visit https://moladin.com

title: Operations Planner Coordinator
description:
Fruitways is a leading agri-business in South Africa. We specialise in the growing, packing and marketing of apples and pears to retailers, traders and wholesalers around the globe.

OPERATIONS PLANNER COORDINATOR

We have an exciting career opportunity for and individual supporting our Planning team based at our Somerset West office. We are looking for a self-motivated, deadline-driven, and detail-oriented individual with a willingness to learn. The main purpose of the role is to coordinate fruit handling operations, update and execute supply plans, and ensure seamless communication among stakeholders to meet the required demand.

Responsibilities:
  • Coordinate and monitor harvest delivery schedules to support optimal fruit availability and ensure deliveries are aligned with technical and operational requirements.
  • Create and coordinate weekly presort and production plans, considering RA/CA allocations, rebin requirements, fruit availability, and operational priorities across sites.
  • Plan and monitor storage requirements and stock movements, including RA/CA loading, CA room utilisation, stock age and fruit availability, to support efficient capacity management and timely product flow, in line with the planning framework and guidance provided by the Operations Planner.
  • Support the alignment of fruit supply, production, and operational capacity with demand by monitoring changes, identifying deviations, and communicating required adjustments.
  • Coordinate internal fruit and bin movements between packhouses, including the loading and opening of CA rooms for presorting and packing.
  • Plan and coordinate empty-bin movements between packhouses, growers and external parties to support harvest and operational requirements.
  • Monitor actuals against the production and supply plans, investigate variances, and provide accurate feedback for follow-up and corrective action.
  • Maintain accurate planning information, schedules and operational updates to support effective day-to-day decision-making and execution.
  • Communicate planning priorities, changes and potential constraints to growers, packhouses, Commercial, Logistics and Operations teams.
  • Follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure agreed planning actions, movements and operational requirements are completed within the required timeframes.
  • Support the Operations Planning function with reporting, coordination and continuous improvement of planning processes and operational flow.

Requirements:
  • Tertiary qualification in Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience, preferably within a fruit packaging environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to handle data-driven decisions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Excel and experience with operational planning tools.
  • Willingness to work over weekends during peak season as needed.
  • Own vehicle and a valid driver’s license are required due to travel requirements between operational units.

Our Mission

The Norman Rockwell Museum illuminates the power of American illustration art to reflect and shape society, and advances the enduring values of kindness, respect, and social equity portrayed by Norman Rockwell.

As a center devoted to the art of illustration, the Museum also exhibits the works of contemporary and past masters in an ongoing series of compelling artist showcases. Set on a picturesque 36-acre estate in the hometown of America’s favorite artist, the Norman Rockwell Museum is one of the crown jewels of the Berkshires.


Equity Goals

NRM embraces the values of diversity, equity, access, and inclusion to create a successful workplace and a more equitable society. Our mission embodies these values. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of identities, experiences, backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the more successful the organization, its employees, and our work in the world will be. Norman Rockwell Museum is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to equity and inclusion. We take affirmative action to ensure equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Norman Rockwell Museum is a drug-free workplace.


Position
On-Call Museum Associates work in Visitor Services and Museum Store and enjoy a variety of opportunities to interact with visitors in a welcoming environment. They are an integral part of making sure our visitors have an engaging and positive experience while visiting the museum. A desire to help people have great experiences, whether they are a visitor or a fellow staff member, is the most important qualification.

The On-Call position is year-round, without guaranteed hours and not to exceed 30 hours in a week. This is an "as-needed" arrangement where employee will be offered Museum Associate shifts on a day-to-day basis.

  • High need dates will be discussed and assigned in advance. Once scheduled, an On-Call shift is then considered mandatory.
  • Unplanned opportunities for additional shifts may also occur, potentially with minimal notice. These dates will function as a request only, subject to the On-Call employee's availability and interest.

title: Remote Appointment Setter / Phone Booker | Recruiting & Scheduling
description:
Remote Appointment Setter / Phone Booker | Recruiting & Scheduling

100% Remote | Work From Home | Entry Level Welcome | Warm Candidate Leads | Training Provided

Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Work From Home
Location: U.S.-Based Applicants
Experience: Entry Level | No Recruiting Experience Required
Schedule: Flexible | Consistent Calling Availability Required
Primary Focus: Candidate Outreach | Interview Scheduling | Recruiting Support
Training: Comprehensive Onboarding | Call Guidance | Ongoing Coaching

📞 Turn Candidate Interest Into Scheduled Interviews — From Home

Are you confident on the phone, highly organized, dependable, and good at keeping people engaged?

We’re expanding our virtual recruiting team and looking for motivated professionals to join us as Remote Appointment Setters / Phone Bookers.

In this role, you’ll connect with prospective candidates who have already applied or expressed interest in learning more about our career opportunities, confirm their interest, schedule the appropriate next step, and provide consistent follow-up throughout the interview process.

Your role is simple, but your impact is significant:

Connect → Engage → Schedule → Confirm → Follow Up → Help Candidates Show Up

You’ll help turn online applications into real conversations and scheduled interviews while creating a positive first impression for our recruiting team.

No previous recruiting or appointment-setting experience is required. Training and ongoing coaching are provided.

✓ 100% Remote / Work From Home
✓ Entry Level Welcome
✓ Warm Candidate Leads
✓ No Random Cold Calling
✓ Flexible Scheduling Opportunities
✓ Training & Ongoing Coaching
✓ Recruiting & Scheduling Experience
✓ Goal-Oriented Remote Environment
✓ Career Growth Opportunities

🎯 Your Main Objective: Keep the Interview Calendar Full

As a Remote Appointment Setter / Phone Booker, your primary responsibility is helping interested applicants successfully reach the next stage of the recruiting process.

That may include:

  • Contacting newly interested applicants

  • Confirming they still want to learn more

  • Helping them understand the next step

  • Scheduling interviews and career overviews

  • Confirming appointment details

  • Reminding candidates about upcoming appointments

  • Following up with candidates who have not yet scheduled

  • Reconnecting with applicants who missed an appointment

  • Helping interested candidates reschedule

  • Keeping candidate records and calendars organized

Your work directly supports candidate engagement, interview attendance, and recruiting results.

☎️ Candidate Outreach

You’ll be one of the first people prospective candidates speak with after expressing interest.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Make outbound calls to candidates who have already applied or responded to a recruiting opportunity

  • Introduce yourself professionally

  • Confirm candidate interest

  • Create a positive and helpful first impression

  • Explain basic recruiting and scheduling steps

  • Encourage qualified interested candidates to complete the next step

  • Answer general process and scheduling questions

  • Follow up consistently

  • Help candidates navigate scheduling links

  • Redirect detailed job-specific questions to the appropriate recruiter or hiring manager

You are not responsible for conducting the full interview.

Your role is to make the process clear, easy, and organized for the candidate.

📅 Interview Scheduling & Calendar Management

Strong scheduling is at the heart of this position.

You may be responsible for:

  • Scheduling virtual interviews

  • Scheduling career overviews

  • Helping applicants select available times

  • Confirming appointment dates

  • Confirming appointment times

  • Sending or coordinating scheduling links

  • Providing basic virtual-attendance instructions

  • Sending reminders when appropriate

  • Monitoring upcoming appointments

  • Rescheduling missed candidates

  • Keeping interview calendars organized

  • Identifying candidates who still need to take action

  • Helping reduce missed interviews

Your goal is not simply to book appointments—it’s to help booked candidates successfully reach their appointment.

🔥 Warm Candidate Leads — No Random Cold Calling

This is an outbound phone-based position, so applicants should be comfortable making frequent calls.

However, you’re not randomly dialing consumers who have never heard from the organization.

You’ll primarily contact candidates who have already:

  • Submitted a job application

  • Responded to a recruiting advertisement

  • Requested information

  • Expressed interest in an available opportunity

  • Begun the recruiting process

  • Scheduled previously and need a new appointment

  • Completed an earlier recruiting step

  • Requested assistance continuing through the process

Your conversations begin with existing candidate interest.

That means you can focus on moving applicants from:

Application → Contact → Career Overview → Interview → Next Step

💻 Recruiting & Administrative Support

Appointment setters also help keep the recruiting pipeline organized behind the scenes.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Maintain accurate candidate notes

  • Record call outcomes

  • Update candidate statuses

  • Track outreach attempts

  • Maintain scheduling records

  • Identify candidates requiring follow-up

  • Maintain organized callback lists

  • Update applicant contact information when needed

  • Track scheduled, confirmed, missed, and rescheduled appointments

  • Communicate through phone, email, and text when appropriate

  • Collaborate with recruiters

  • Coordinate with hiring managers

  • Maintain accurate digital candidate records

Strong documentation is just as important as strong communication.

📲 A Typical Candidate Conversation

A call might be as simple as:

You reach out to an applicant who recently expressed interest, introduce yourself, confirm they’re still interested, and help them select an available appointment time.

You may also:

  • Explain what the next appointment is

  • Confirm how the candidate will attend virtually

  • Help locate a scheduling link

  • Answer basic questions

  • Confirm upcoming appointments

  • Assist with rescheduling

  • Direct more detailed questions to the hiring team

The objective is to make the process easy, professional, and clear.

📊 A Results-Focused Position

This role involves measurable recruiting and appointment-setting activity.

Depending on team needs, performance may be evaluated through areas such as:

  • Outbound calls

  • Candidate contacts

  • Completed conversations

  • Appointments scheduled

  • Appointment confirmations

  • Candidate follow-up

  • Reschedules

  • Interview attendance

  • Candidate engagement

  • Accuracy of records

  • Reliability

  • Consistency

Successful appointment setters understand that results often come from:

Activity + Communication + Organization + Persistence + Follow-Through

☎️ Comfortable With High-Volume Calling?

You should be comfortable making frequent outbound calls throughout your work period.

That may include:

  • Speaking with many candidates each day

  • Moving quickly between calls

  • Leaving professional voicemails

  • Handling unanswered calls

  • Making follow-up attempts

  • Receiving occasional candidate declines

  • Maintaining a positive tone

  • Repeating similar information throughout the day

  • Working toward activity and booking goals

You don’t have to be pushy. You do have to be consistent.

🌟 What Makes a Great Phone Booker?

The strongest Phone Bookers aren’t necessarily the loudest or most aggressive.

They tend to be:

  • Friendly

  • Confident

  • Clear

  • Organized

  • Helpful

  • Persistent

  • Positive

  • Professional

  • Dependable

  • Comfortable speaking with new people

Candidates should feel like they’re speaking with someone who knows what to do next and is happy to help them get there.

🏠 100% Remote / Work From Home

This position is performed entirely remotely.

Your workday may include:

  • Outbound candidate calls

  • Appointment scheduling

  • Candidate confirmations

  • Follow-up

  • Email communication

  • Text communication

  • Recruiting-system updates

  • Calendar management

  • Virtual team meetings

  • Coaching and development

Technology may include:

  • Online scheduling platforms

  • Calendly

  • Zoom

  • Email

  • Phone

  • Text communication

  • Online calendars

  • Applicant tracking systems

  • Recruiting platforms

  • Candidate-management systems

Training is provided on the systems and processes used by the team.

💻 What You’ll Need

Applicants should have:

  • Reliable computer or laptop

  • Reliable high-speed internet

  • Dependable phone capability

  • Working microphone or headset

  • Webcam capability when required

  • Quiet environment for professional phone calls

  • Basic computer skills

  • Comfort using web-based tools

  • Ability to navigate multiple systems

Your work environment should allow you to speak with candidates without excessive background noise or interruptions.

⏰ Flexible Scheduling With Consistent Activity

Remote work offers flexibility, but recruiting outreach still depends on reliable calling activity and timely follow-up.

Successful team members maintain a schedule that allows them to consistently:

  • Reach candidates

  • Respond to interest

  • Follow up

  • Confirm appointments

  • Keep candidate records current

This role can be a strong fit for someone who enjoys:

Flexible Work + Clear Goals + Phone Communication + Independent Productivity + Measurable Results

📚 No Experience? We’ll Train You.

Previous recruiting, scheduling, call-center, or appointment-setting experience can be helpful—but is not required.

Training may include:

  • Call scripts

  • Conversation frameworks

  • Candidate outreach procedures

  • Appointment-setting techniques

  • Scheduling systems

  • Calendar management

  • Professional phone communication

  • Candidate engagement

  • Follow-up strategies

  • Appointment confirmations

  • Missed-interview follow-up

  • Rescheduling

  • Recruiting-system procedures

  • Candidate documentation

  • Email and text communication

  • Productivity strategies

  • Time management

We provide the process and coaching. You bring the communication skills, consistency, and willingness to learn.

💼 Experience That Transfers Well

Previous experience in these areas may transfer especially well:

Appointment Setting • Recruiting • Talent Acquisition • Customer Service • Scheduling • Call Centers • Administrative Support • Reception • Customer Care • Inside Sales • Telemarketing • Lead Follow-Up • Client Relations • Staffing • Healthcare Scheduling • Hospitality • Retail • Sales Support

Entry-level applicants and career changers are encouraged to apply.

We value communication, organization, dependability, professionalism, coachability, and work ethic as much as previous experience.

🌎 Who We’re Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you’re:

  • Friendly and confident on the phone

  • Comfortable making frequent outbound calls

  • An excellent verbal communicator

  • Professional and personable

  • Comfortable speaking with different personalities

  • Organized and detail-oriented

  • Reliable with follow-up

  • Self-motivated

  • Able to work independently

  • Comfortable working toward daily goals

  • Productive in a remote environment

  • Comfortable learning technology

  • Positive when calls go unanswered

  • Persistent without being overly aggressive

  • Accurate with notes and records

  • Comfortable managing multiple follow-ups

  • Coachable and receptive to feedback

🔄 Career Changers Welcome

This opportunity may also appeal to people who are:

  • Returning to the workforce

  • Transitioning from hospitality

  • Moving out of retail

  • Interested in entering recruiting

  • Looking for remote administrative experience

  • Coming from a customer-service background

  • Experienced in healthcare scheduling

  • Interested in talent acquisition

  • Looking for a phone-based remote opportunity

Skills such as communication, scheduling, organization, follow-up, and customer service transfer extremely well into recruiting support.

📈 Career Growth Opportunities

For strong performers interested in increasing their responsibilities, this role can provide valuable exposure to multiple areas of recruiting.

Potential development may include:

Appointment Setter → Candidate Coordinator → Recruiting Assistant → Recruiter → Interview Coordination → Training → Team Leadership

Additional experience may include:

  • Candidate pipeline management

  • Recruiting coordination

  • Candidate engagement

  • Interview scheduling

  • Applicant screening support

  • Recruiting operations

  • New-team-member training

  • Recruiting analytics

  • Team development

  • Leadership

Growth opportunities depend on performance, reliability, professional development, business needs, and available positions.

🌟 Why This Role Matters

Candidates often apply because they’re interested—but many still need help navigating the next step.

They may:

  • Miss a scheduling email

  • Forget to select an appointment time

  • Have trouble using a scheduling link

  • Need to reschedule

  • Miss a previous appointment

  • Have a basic question

  • Need a reminder

  • Simply need a person to help guide them forward

That’s where your work matters.

Every appointment you schedule can help:

  • Increase candidate engagement

  • Improve interview attendance

  • Reduce missed appointments

  • Create a better applicant experience

  • Keep the recruiting pipeline organized

  • Support recruiters and hiring managers

  • Connect interested candidates with career opportunities

You help turn online interest into real conversations.

Minimum Requirements

Applicants must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age

  • Be physically located within the United States

  • Be legally authorized to work in the United States

  • Have reliable high-speed internet

  • Have access to a reliable computer or laptop

  • Have dependable phone capability

  • Have a working microphone or headset

  • Maintain a quiet and professional calling environment

  • Be comfortable making frequent outbound calls

  • Be comfortable using online scheduling systems

  • Communicate clearly through phone, email, and text

  • Maintain accurate candidate records

  • Be reliable with follow-up

  • Be comfortable working toward appointment and activity goals

🚀 Ready to Turn Candidate Interest Into Interviews?

If you’re friendly, dependable, organized, confident on the phone, and enjoy helping people take the next step, we’d like to hear from you.

No previous recruiting experience is required.

Bring your communication skills, consistency, positive attitude, and willingness to learn—we’ll provide the training and support.

Apply today with your updated resume to be considered for our Remote Appointment Setter / Phone Booker – Recruiting & Scheduling opportunity.

Connect Candidates. Book Interviews. Keep the Pipeline Moving. Build Your Recruiting Career From Home. 📞💻🚀

title: Bakery Associate - FT (Langley)
description:
Otter Co-op is now hiring for a Full-Time Bakery Associate for our Retail Centre located in Langley, BC.

Who we are:

Otter Co-op is a diverse and growing organization, serving the Lower Mainland, Fraser Valley and BC Interior since 1922. With over 103 years in business and over 600 in our team, we are proud to be a locally owned and community minded member of the neighbourhoods we live, work and play in. We operate three food and pharmacy stores (including one with a fashion and hardware department), thirty Angry Otter liquor stores, one feed mill, two bulk petroleum facilities, the Highwayman Pub in Abbotsford, and multiple gas station/convenience stores. To learn more about who we are and how you can help bring our brand to life, visit us at .

What you’ll do:

Reporting to the Bakery Manager, responsibilities for this position include the following:

  • Decorating and displaying finished products and features
  • Add a quality finish to baked items and packed products
  • Maintain proper storage, labelling and rotation of food products
  • Greeting customers, answering questions, making recommendations, accepting orders, and providing exceptional customer service
  • Keeping records relating to inventory, and production levels
  • Taking client information and ensuring that orders are fulfilled accurately and on time
  • Cleaning and restocking workstations and ensuring that all equipment is sanitized and prepared for the next shift
  • Follow opening and closing procedures
  • Contribute to the team in living the corporate Values of Integrity, Community and Excellence
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Why it matters:

Our team provides a range of products and services to support our member-owners. Through the work that we do, we help to build, fuel, feed and grow Western Canadian communities together.

Who you are:

You are looking for a career in Retail Store Operations and:

  • Previous Baking experience preferred
  • Previous Retail / Customer Service an asset
  • Previous experience handling food along with a food safe certification is an asset
  • Must have excellent communication skills, be able to work efficiently in a team setting as well as independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Must have a strong work ethic
  • This is a physical job requiring the ability to stand for long periods of time and lift, push, pull up to 50 pounds on occasion
  • Must be committed to a SAFE working environment
  • The ideal candidate will have open availability 7 days a week to work a variety of shifts, that include early mornings, afternoons and late evenings.
  • This position is based at the Retail Centre, though it may require on some occasions to travel and work at other locations as business needs arise

What’s in it for you:

  • Competitive Wages
  • Wage increases based on hours worked & meeting expectations in the position
  • Annual bonus program for all eligible team members
  • For eligible positions: comprehensive benefits package and an employer matched pension plan
  • Team discount on Gas, Liquor, Food, Fashion, Hardware, Feed & Restaurant purchases
  • Co-op Membership with an annual dividend payment on qualified purchases
  • Education Assistance Program
  • Learning opportunities, to grow and develop and to foster a culture of teamwork and innovation

Otter Co-op is committed to a diverse and supportive working environment based on our Core Company Values of Integrity, Community and Excellence. We embrace diversity and inclusion, and we’re working to create a workplace that is as diverse as the communities we serve. We support and provide an environment that allows all to bring their whole selves to work.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected to continue in the recruitment process will be contacted.

Posting date: September 4, 2026
Wage range at time of posting: $18.25- $21.15

title: GOTV Canvasser- Partisan
description:
Jolt Action is a 501c4 non-profit organization that increases the civic participation of Latinos in Texas to build a stronger democracy and ensure that everyone’s voice is heard. Jolt Initiative is a 501c3 non-profit organization that believes young Latinos will transform Texas through the power of their vote. The Contractor will mobilize Latino voters by the November 2026 election. To meet this goal, the organization is hiring a team of seasonal, full-time canvassers to mobilize voters in the Houston area. Jolt seeks dynamic, outgoing, and hard-working individuals ready to create change in Texas..

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Essential duties and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Work with Field Manager to identify turf in assigned areas to canvass specifically in East, Eastend, Jacinto City, and South East Houston
  • Assist with phone/text banking for all pledged voters in the last election cycle.
  • Canvass neighborhood doors to drop off important election materials and reminders.
  • Enter and track data via Impactive, MiniVan, EveryAction (or similar software) and/or spreadsheet on a daily basis
  • Check-in weekly with your supervisor about your progress and team GOTV goals.
  • Communicate with your supervisor daily about your shifts and availability.
  • Represent the organization professionally and effectively to the public.
  • Other duties as assigned.

The contractor will work no more than 6 hours per day and no more than 30 hours per week. A week is defined as Sunday through Saturday. Hours designated for this project are between 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.

Timetable: The term of this agreement will commence on June 9, 2026 and will terminate on November 4, 2026.

Compensation: The Contractor will be paid Twenty Three Dollars ($23) an hour provided that in no event will the aggregate fee exceed Six Hundred Sixty Dollars ($690) per week, payable on a semi-monthly basis on the 3rd and 18th of each month via Gusto.

title: QA Inspector
description:
Join Our Team at voestalpine Railway Systems Nortrak!


Embark on a rewarding career journey with voestalpine Railway Systems Nortrak, North America's premier designer and manufacturer of special trackwork. With a legacy spanning 160 years, we lead the industry in shaping the future of rail solutions. As part of the voestalpine Railway Systems global network, we are committed to delivering quality products and services, including rails, turnouts, fastening systems, signaling technologies, and monitoring solutions. Operating with a presence across Canada, the US, and Mexico, we prioritize the well-being of our people, global mobility, and sustainability and innovation.

Our people are the foundation of our success. Skilled, motivated, and results-driven individuals shape our culture demonstrating our core values of Respect, Responsibility, Curiosity, Courage, Passion, and Diversity each day. This commitment is more than shared values; it extends to shared responsibilities for safety and quality, showing genuine care for one another's growth and development, a commitment to our customers, and fostering strong relationships within the Nortrak Team and with our customers.

We are currently looking for a Quality Assurance Inspector to join our team in Knoxville, Tennessee.

Purpose of this position:

Reporting directly to the Q. A. Manager the Quality Assurance Inspector is responsible to ensure implementation and execution of the QMS (Quality Management System) and to verify products are produced in accordance with the product realization design.

Task and Responsibilities:

Safety:

  • Sets an example for all plant employees by performing all quality functions in a safe manner and encourages safety as a staff member on the plant floor.
  • Ensure outside visitors are aware of, and, comply with Nortrak safety practices and requirements.

Quality:

  • To perform appropriate inspections, to ensure that product realization processes meet all applicable specifications and standards.
  • Performs internal process audits to verify QMS effectiveness.
  • Maintains and controls quality records associated to product verification, measuring equipment calibration and material certification.
  • Inspects, tests, and measures all the finishing materials.
  • Ensure the operations and productions are following the company’s standards.
  • Actively ensures compliance with the Nortrak’s QMS.

On-Time Delivery:

  • Performs duties as required to ensure that customer delivery commitments can be met and files quality records in a timely manner.

Costs:

  • Implements the Non-conformance and Gauge Control Programs. Reviews plant processes and pro-actively recommends material and process improvements.

People:

  • Acts as a resource to management and plant employees by promoting quality product and helping to train employees to avoid production of non-conforming product.
  • Effectively liaises with customer inspectors.
  • The QA inspector reports directly to the Manager, QA.

Environmental:

  • Adhere to Nortrak's Environmental Procedures, Practices and Policies.

Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Education:

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or other suitable discipline.
  • Vocational technical training in quality assurance related field is preferred.

Field of Experience:

  • 1 to 3 years’ related experience in inspection, or
  • At least 2 years’ experience within Nortrak employment.
  • Knowledge in using variety of industry tools for calibration purposes.
  • Inspection, testing, or measuring materials or products being produced.
  • Knowledge of reading blueprints and specifications.
  • Monitoring operations to ensure production standards.
  • Assembly or production processes.
  • Sound knowledge of MS Office standard, MS Projects and special programs (i.e.: MS Vision, MS SharePoint).

Physical Demands:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Occasional standing, walking, stooping, kneeling, crouching or climbing.
  • Must be able to lift or handle up to 25 pounds at times.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
  • Occasional travel may be required which includes walking, standing, sitting and driving from short to long periods of time.

Working Location:

  • Knoxville, Tennessee

Benefits

  • A supportive, family oriented Nortrak Blue culture
  • We provide an environment where Health and Safety is our #1 priority
  • Career development opportunities and competitive pay progression
  • Competitive medical, dental & vision benefits
  • Company paid life and disability insurance
  • Paid holidays and vacation
  • Retirement plan with matching contributions
  • Tuition Assistance Program
  • Wellness Program
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee Recognition Programs

If you think you have the necessary qualifications and drive to excel in our team, we invite you to apply now and join us at voestalpine Railway Systems Nortrak. Apply today!

voestalpine Railway Systems Nortrak (“Nortrak”) is a subsidiary of voestalpine AG () one of Europe’s premier steel producers with over 50,000 employees worldwide. Nortrak is closely affiliated with voestalpine’s Railway Systems group which operates in 21 countries across the globe to provide cutting edge system-based solutions to railroads and transits. title: Web Developer
description:
About Miva

Since 1996, Miva has helped online sellers increase their revenue, drive sales, and decrease their overhead costs. That work has powered over $100 billion in online sales and put countless merchants in control of their own destiny. With the launch of Vexture, our new AI-powered search tool, we're building search that understands what shoppers mean, not just what they type.

What started as a small office in San Diego has since grown into a fully remote team, with team members across the United States. Miva has been consistently named one of the Best and Brightest Companies to Work For in San Diego and in the Nation, year after year.

About the role

We are looking for a full-stack Web Developer to join Miva's Professional Services team.

This is a client-facing delivery role: you will sit in on client conversations, translate their business needs into technical requirements, and explain tradeoffs in plain language when a client isn't technical themselves.

You will build and maintain eCommerce storefronts using MVT (Miva's server-side templating language), HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript, and connect client stores to the rest of their business systems through integrations that range from modern REST APIs to legacy XML-based systems. The work spans large-scale builds, ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and project discovery across multiple client accounts. You will work closely with Project Managers and collaborate cross-functionally across Miva to turn those requirements into solutions that hit scope and timeline.

You will:

  • Scope, estimate, and execute development tasks based on approved client requirements, signed SOWs, and predefined service offerings
  • Develop, customize, and maintain eCommerce storefronts using HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript (ES6+) within Miva's template and configuration layers
  • Maintain deep platform knowledge to apply optimal store configurations within the Miva admin
  • Build and support integrations between Miva stores and external systems (ERPs, CRMs, payment providers, shipping systems, analytics platforms, marketing tools) using REST and SOAP APIs and legacy XML-based services, without relying on third-party libraries, including data mapping, authentication, rate limits, and error handling
  • Troubleshoot and resolve frontend, backend, and configuration issues across the platform and connected systems
  • Optimize storefront performance and conversion: Core Web Vitals, SEO (schema markup, product metadata, faceted navigation, crawlability), WCAG accessibility, and cross-browser/cross-device compatibility with a mobile-first approach
  • Configure full-funnel eCommerce analytics and GA4 tracking using GTM
  • Implement merchandising solutions such as cross-selling, dynamic product listings, personalization, and rule-based promotions and discounts
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-documented code, and participate in code reviews, QA validation, and client acceptance testing
  • Follow established deployment procedures and release schedules across multiple client environments
  • Track time against approved client work and communicate status, blockers, and scope risks as they come up
  • Perform other duties as assigned

You have:

  • 5+ years of professional web development experience, including at least 1 year in eCommerce
  • Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3 (including preprocessors like Sass/LESS), and vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), with a firm grasp of the DOM
  • Working experience with PHP in a web development context
  • Experience with SQL-based databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL
  • Proficiency with version control systems and Git-based workflows
  • Ability to work within defined scope, timelines, and platform constraints in a client-facing delivery environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote, asynchronous team

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience implementing eCommerce storefronts on platforms such as Miva, Shopify, BigCommerce, or Magento
  • Experience integrating with external systems such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ERPs and CRMs
  • Experience with build tools such as Webpack or similar tooling
  • Advanced knowledge of Modern PHP and Laravel, with a focus on MVC design patterns, RESTful API development, and scalable backend architecture
  • Experience using containerization or local development tooling such as Docker
  • Prior experience working in an agency or Professional Services delivery environment
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve delivery efficiency and code quality
  • Familiarity with Agile or structured project delivery methodologies

Benefits & Compensation

  • 100% remote (U.S. based)
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 10 paid holidays
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • 401(k) with a company match, vested immediately
  • Paid parental leave

title: Specification Writer
description:
TVS is an award-winning architecture and interior design firm headquartered in Atlanta, GA with global project expertise. Our team of experts listen intently, solve creatively and deliver reliably to make remarkable design easy.

The firm’s roundtable operating approach engages honed perspectives across workplace interiors and corporate office, hospitality, convention center, mixed-use, sports, education, retail, healthcare and multifamily residential to deliver design solutions that meet the complex challenges of the 21st century. This multi-disciplinary, multi-market diversity equips our architects, designers and strategists with a unique ecosystem of ideas and resources that best support our client’s vision.

With offices in Atlanta and Tampa, the 100% employee-owned firm was founded in 1968. Our pursuit of excellence was acknowledged by our peers in 2002 when we received the National AIA Firm of the Year award, the 39th recipient of the annual award and the first architectural firm in the South to be so honored.

At TVS, we're united around one purpose: designing environments that spark connection and drive impact. That purpose shapes how we work every day. We operate with a "we, not I" mindset where trust, accountability, and shared results matter.

We're building a team of people who bring a solutions-oriented mindset, hold themselves and their work to high standards, and are motivated to grow - both professionally and personally. Our teams lean into complexity with curiosity and creativity, pushing beyond the expected to uncover thoughtful, innovative design solutions.

The people who thrive at TVS are energized by collaboration, inspired by solving complex design challenges, and driven to create purposeful places with powerful outcomes - together.

We're looking for a talented and experienced Specification Writer to serve as a firmwide resource across our convention center, sports, cultural arts, hospitality, mixed-use, office workplace, and interiors practices. This is a multi-faceted role with equal weight placed on specification production and program-building: with time spent developing, maintaining, and expanding the TVS specifications library; working with teams to produce specifications and project manuals; and building and delivering a structured training program in partnership with the SVP of Talent.

The right candidate brings deep technical knowledge, strong communication skills, and a genuine investment in elevating the quality and consistency of documentation across the firm. They will work within TVS's existing pre-edit specification framework and play a key role in expanding that library to reflect the nuances of each market we serve.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Specification Production & Library Management:

  • Produce, edit, and maintain project specifications across all phases of delivery — schematic design through construction administration — in Master Spec format
  • Work within TVS established pre-edit specification templates and uphold firmwide standards for format, language, and structure
  • Expand the firm’s library of specification sections, including the development of market-specific variations tailored to Convention Centers, Sports & Entertainment, and Interiors & Hospitality project types, among others
  • Ensure specifications accurately reflect building system decisions, material selections, and project-specific requirements provided by the design team
  • Maintain version control and organization of the specification library to support consistent firmwide access

Training Program Development & Delivery:

  • Partner with the SVP of Talent to design, develop, and deliver a structured training program that builds firmwide literacy in building systems and the decisions that drive specification requirements
  • Create curriculum that helps project teams understand the “why” behind specifications — not just the format, but the building system logic that informs them
  • Develop and refine project-specific questionnaires that guide design teams through the information-gathering process for each specification section, ensuring teams make and document key building system decisions at the appropriate phase
  • Build accountability into the process: the questionnaire framework should function as both a decision-making tool and a quality control checkpoint for project teams
  • Tailor training content and reference materials to reflect the distinct requirements of each market type the firm serves

Coordination & Collaboration:

  • Work closely with project architects and designers to gather project-specific information required for specification customization
  • Coordinate within the Quality Review Team to align specification standards with broader quality control processes
  • Support project teams in understanding market-to-market differences in building systems, regulatory requirements, material standards, and owner expectations.
  • Any other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 15 or more years of experience in architectural specifications, with demonstrated involvement across all phases of project delivery
  • Experience on a minimum of three projects carried from early design phases through construction administration, demonstrating full-cycle specification responsibility
  • Significant experience with large-scale or complex building types; familiarity with a mix of Convention Center, Sports, Cultural Arts, Hospitality, Mixed Use, Office Workplace and Interiors projects strongly preferred
  • Proficiency with Master Spec format is required; working knowledge of the CSI MasterFormat organizational structure.
  • Strong understanding of building systems — structural, envelope, mechanical, plumbing, electrical — and the decisions that shape specification content, even when scope is limited to architectural specs
  • Demonstrated ability to read and work within an existing firm pre-edit specification system and contribute meaningfully to its expansion
  • Familiarity with how specification requirements differ across market types, including procurement environments, owner standards, and code considerations
  • Proven ability — and genuine enthusiasm — for translating technical specification knowledge into accessible training content for architects and designers at varying experience levels
  • Experience developing questionnaires, checklists, or structured intake tools to gather project-specific technical information from design teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to build credibility across practice areas and with senior leadership
  • CSI credentials (CDT or CCS) preferred. Candidates without credentials but with equivalent experience and demonstrated expertise will be considered.
  • Architecture degree or equivalent technical education preferred

If interested, qualified candidates should submit a resume and work samples or portfolio (no larger than 6 MB) through our careers website.

TVS offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, as well as 401(k) Plan and ESOP program. TVS also offers resources and benefits to assist our employees with pursuit of professional licensure and certification.

title: Partnerships Lead - Healthcare
description:
Partnerships Lead — Healthcare

Business Development · Dubai, UAE · Full-time

You’ll open the doors that bring trusted healthcare into more people’s homes across the GCC. Every corporate account, affiliate, and wellness partner you sign is another family that gets quality care where they need it most. This is a build-it role: new channels, new partnerships, real ownership of growth in one of Justlife’s most important — and most human — verticals.

Justlife is the region’s leading super-app for home services, scaling fast across the UAE and KSA. We’re looking for a commercially driven Senior Account Manager who loves the hunt — someone who builds relationships from scratch, closes deals, and grows a healthcare partnerships book at regional scale.

What you’ll own

This is an outbound, sales-oriented role focused on new channels and partnerships — not maintaining an existing book. You’ll:

  • Open new channels: Identify, pursue, and close new B2B partnerships across corporate accounts, affiliates, and wellness providers — building the pipeline and owning deals end-to-end.
  • Build relationships: Build trusted, long-term relationships with partners and decision-makers, positioning Justlife’s healthcare-at-home offering as the partner of choice.
  • Close & grow: Negotiate and structure commercial agreements that grow revenue while protecting service quality and partner trust.
  • Shape the vertical: Bring market insight back to the business — spotting new channel opportunities and shaping how we expand the healthcare vertical across the GCC.

You’ll report partnership growth, pipeline, and market trends to senior management with clear, actionable insight.

What good looks like

In your first year, success means a strong pipeline of new partnerships, signed corporate, affiliate, and wellness deals that drive measurable revenue, and a growing, high-trust healthcare partner network that lifts the whole vertical.

What we’re looking for (must-have)

  • 5–7 years in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development, with a proven track record of building relationships and closing deals — not just managing accounts
  • Healthcare background preferred — and a genuine feel for a regulated, trust-critical space where care quality and compliance come first
  • Commercially driven and partnership-minded, with strong negotiation skills and the hunger to open new channels
  • A data-driven mindset and sound commercial judgment — comfortable turning metrics into decisions
  • A bachelor’s degree from an accredited university

Nice to have

  • Established relationships across the Dubai / UAE market — corporates, insurers, clinics, pharmacies, or wellness and fitness providers
  • Familiarity with UAE/GCC healthcare licensing and regulatory bodies (e.g. DHA, DoH, MOH)
  • Comfort using AI and automation tools to work smarter and move faster

Why Justlife

You’ll join a people-first company scaling fast across 10 cities — 200+ full-time team members, 6K+ service professionals, and a real culture of ownership and care. We invest in your growth with mentorship, coaching, internal and external training, fast-track career paths, and a fair, objective performance system. We also take care of the everyday — flexible, hybrid working, an extra day off on your birthday, free Justlife credits to enjoy our own services, recognition through our JustHeroes program, and a referral bonus when you bring in great people.

How we hire

We respect your time and keep our process clear: a first conversation with our People & Culture team, an interview with BD/healthcare leadership, a case or deal-scenario discussion, and a final conversation. We move quickly and keep you informed at every step.

Everyone’s welcome

Justlife is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on the strength of your skills and potential, and welcome applicants of every background and nationality. If you’re excited about this role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Join the tribe and let’s become #everydaybetter, together.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Windows Solutions FDE
location: United States, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations
description:
Overview

The Windows Commercial Acceleration Engine (WCAE) team is building a forward-deployed engineering capability that works directly with strategic enterprise customers to solve their most consequential Windows technical challenges.

Be part of a culture that pursues and celebrates excellence and drives innovation where success is a shared journey from a One Microsoft approach.

As a Senior Software Engineer - Windows Solutions FDE, you will join the Windows Commercial Acceleration Engine (WCAE) Team as part of the Windows Ecosystem and Commercial Engagement (WECE) organization in Windows + Devices. In this hands-on engineering role, you will work directly with strategic enterprise customers to identify, diagnose, and resolve their most complex Windows challenges to improve their install base health. You will apply broad technical expertise across device provisioning, deployment, device management, OS and update management, application management, performance, reliability, and security. You will leverage telemetry, logs, code, scripts, configurations, policies, and engineering systems to investigate and move complex issues from discovery to measurable resolution.

Success in this role will be defined by remediating the customer as well as turning successful solutions into re-usable packaged solutions, diagnostic tools, product improvements, and implementation guidance that will benefit many more customers and strengthen Windows at scale. You will collaborate closely with customers, field teams, and Windows product engineering. Your technical depth, customer empathy, and ability to operate across disciplines will be key to delivering measurable customer and business outcomes. This work will be pivotal to the success of the Windows Commercial business.

At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.



Responsibilities

Lead forward-deployed customer engagements to improve the install-base health of strategic Windows commercial customers with hands-on technical engagement

  • Discover: Embed with strategic enterprise customers to rapidly understand their business priorities, complex environments, operational constraints, and diagnose Windows deployment, management, update, application, performance, reliability, and security issues, and develop customer-specific strategies. Establish a clear technical problem statement, baseline, success measures, and remediation plan for each engagement.

  • Build and implement technical resolution: devise, design and implement solutions with customers. Develop technical prototypes, automation, tools, scripts, utilities, configuration changes, and implementation approaches. Apply strong engineering fundamentals including security, privacy, maintainability and supportability. Validate solution in customer environments to demonstrate measurable improvements.

Partner with engineering for complex cross-product issues

  • Collaborate with Windows, Intune, and other product engineering teams to investigate complex cross-product issues and drive product fixes, supportability changes, and telemetry enhancements supported by actionable customer evidence including detailed reproduction information, logs, etc and business impact.

  • FDE will maintain accountability for the customer outcome.

Scale successful approaches for broad impact.

  • Identify patterns and convert customer solutions and lessons learned into reusable playbooks, patterns, tools, and technical guidance that can benefit a broader set of enterprise customers.

  • Transfer expertise to other FDEs, partners, field, support teams, and product groups so each engagement increases the capability of the broader ecosystem.

Deliver measurable customer and business outcomes

  • Demonstrate improvement in customers install base health through customer evidence, telemetry, validation results, or agreed success measures.

  • Help restore customer confidence in Windows and strengthen the role of Windows in customers’ future endpoint, security, management, and AI-platform strategies.

  • Build trusted relationships with customer technical leaders, Microsoft field teams, and product engineering teams.

  • Communicate technical findings, tradeoffs, risks, decisions, and progress clearly to customer engineers, IT leaders, Microsoft field teams, product engineers, and executives.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a Forward Deployed Engineering, customer-facing software engineering, field engineering, technical consulting such as Microsoft Consulting Services, escalation engineering, support engineering or solutions architecture role, where you work directly with enterprise customers to understand complex technical environments, diagnose problems, and implement or validate solutions.
  • Technical knowledge of enterprise Windows environments, including several of the following areas: device provisioning and deployment, Intune, Autopilot, device management, OS and update management, application management, performance, reliability, and security.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues in a structured problem-solving method using data, logs, diagnostic tools, and leveraging PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Windows Performance Analyzer, Windows diagnostic tooling, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with engineering and automation technologies, building or modifying scripts, automation, diagnostic tools, prototypes, reference implementations, or production-quality technical solutions, leveraging Azure DevOps, GitHub or similar technologies.
  • Ability to synthesize information from multiple sources, identify systemic patterns and root causes, and translate findings into practical customer solutions and actionable product feedback. And communicate complex technical findings, risks and recommendations clearly to technical and executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn solutions developed for an individual customer into repeatable approaches that benefit a broader customer population.
  • Experience representing customer needs in product planning and influencing engineering priorities through technical evidence and business impact.

title: Embedded Hardware Engineer
description:
Company background

Swarmbotics AI is a low-cost, swarm robotics company for industry and defense. We see a world of ubiquitous low-cost robots transforming almost all aspects of society, but we see an urgent need in the defense industry. We focus on building swarms of robots that incorporate a low-cost BOM, an autonomous stack optimized for off the shelf components, and a global planner that enables swarm capabilities for groups of robots to accomplish sophisticated tasks.

Our first product is a defense application building Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs), collectively termed - Attritable, Networked, Tactical Swarm (ANTS). Each UGV in ANTS is an independently-tasked, attritable robot designed for on-demand and autonomous mobility. When operating as a swarm, ANTS is capable of executing more advanced and coordinated, high-level capabilities across a battlespace. ANTS will help solve some of the DoD’s biggest problems that will save lives and increase defense capabilities.

Stephen Houghton and Drew Watson are the Founders and have decades of experience in self-driving cars and trucks, humanoids, and UAVs with experience from NASA, JPL, Cruise, Embark, McKinsey, Amazon, and the CIA.

Job Description

Swarmbotics is on the forefront of deploying unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) swarms for defense applications and is seeking a highly skilled Embedded Hardware Engineer to join our dynamic team. This role is crucial in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining the electronic systems and components that power our unmanned ground vehicles. The engineer in this role will be responsible for design of the FireAnt's main board — the robot's single main PCBA, spanning power conversion and distribution, the high-current motor bus, an embedded microcontroller subsystem, Ethernet switching and PoE, CAN networking, and sensor and payload I/O — across its full lifecycle: requirements and architecture, circuit design and PCB layout, power management, embedded firmware, board bring-up, and support of fielded robots. The selected candidate will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects, contributing to the development of advanced robotics systems from the ground up.

Required Qualifications

  • Circuit Design: Proficiency in designing mixed-signal and power circuits for battery-powered systems — battery input and precharge, high-side MOSFET switching with gate-drive design, DC-DC conversion (buck/boost, PoE), and protection circuits (TVS, signal isolation, keyed connectors, fusing) for a motor bus.
  • PCB Layout: Experience with schematic capture and multi-layer PCB layout in Altium Designer — multi-layer boards with high-current copper planning per IPC-2221/2152, IPC Class 3 manufacturing targets, high-speed routing (RGMII Ethernet, differential pairs, length matching), and design for manufacturing: releasing fab packages, writing ECOs, and managing quotes and batch quality with contract manufacturers. Experience working alongside Mechanical design teams for PCBA mechanical integration – negotiating restrictions on component placement, mounting, thermal interfaces, and designing around shock/vibe requirements.
  • Power Management: Knowledge of power distribution and management for battery-powered vehicles — per-load switching and fusing, hardware-enforced power sequencing, thermal design and margin analysis.
  • Embedded Systems: Experience developing the embedded firmware that runs the board — STM32 (ARM Cortex-M) in C with FreeRTOS, CAN/FDCAN, and Ethernet (lwIP), including driver-level work such as hardware PTP timestamping, plus firmware release and fleet update management.
  • System Integration: Ability to integrate the board with the rest of the robot — defining CAN interfaces with the software team, designing connectors and wiring harnesses with vendors, and interfacing to compute, ESCs, GNSS, IMU, satcom, radios, and payload ports.
  • Testing and Validation: Skills in board bring-up and validation — oscilloscope-level debug, bench power testing at full load, thermal testing, SMD rework, and environmental design informed by MIL-STD-810H thermal, shock, and vibration methods.
  • Experience working alongside Mechanical design teams for PCBA mechanical integration. Negotiating restrictions on component placement, mounting, thermal interfaces, and designing around shock/vibe requirements.
  • Fault Management: Experience designing fault detection and health telemetry (latching fault flags, temperature and current sensing reported over CAN) and root-causing field failures back to definitive design fixes.
  • Comfortable working in the high-paced, fluid environment of a tech startup.
  • Excited to contribute to the defense of the United States and its allies.
  • Able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.
  • Ability to work onsite in the Phoenix, AZ area.

Preferred Qualifications

  • UGV Experience: Prior work on unmanned vehicles.
  • High-Reliability Electronics: Background in high-reliability electronics for military or industrial applications in harsh environments.
  • Re-work: Manual board-level rework skills. Experience replacing ICs and passive components, as well as point-to-point wiring for prototype PCB rework.
  • Embedded Software: Strong embedded C/C++ skills and experience with hardware-software interfacing.
  • Simulation Tools: Familiarity with simulation tools such as SPICE or MATLAB.
  • Time Synchronization: Experience with precision network time sync — PTP grandmaster operation, PPS/NMEA distribution, embedded Ethernet switch integration.
  • Supply Chain Compliance: NDAA and country-of-origin-aware component selection, alternates sourcing, and cost-conscious BOM management.
  • Harness Design: Wiring-harness design and vendor management — drawings, BOMs, ampacity requirements, first-article inspection.
  • Track Record: Proven track record of designing and shipping electronics for robotics or similar products through multiple production revisions.

The preceding description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities required for the position. Swarmbotics is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, caste, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law.
