title: Director, Protein Science
description:
Role Location: Waltham, MA

The Company
We are Alloy Therapeutics — a biotechnology ecosystem and Product Development Organization (PDO) empowering the global scientific community to make better medicines together. Through a community of partners, we democratize access to pre-competitive tools, technologies, services, and company creation capabilities that are foundational for discovering and developing therapeutic biologics. The company facilitates affordable, non-exclusive access to the entire drug discovery community from academic scientists, small and medium biotech, to the largest biopharma. At Alloy, we believe our industry should compete on getting the best drugs to patients as quickly as possible, not exclusive access to the best platforms. As a reflection of our relentless commitment to the scientific community, we reinvest 100% of our revenue in innovation and access to innovation. May the Best Drug Win.

Alloy has evolved from a startup into a global product development organization operating 11 divisions across 5 research sites in 4 countries on 3 continents. Our model - Integrated Independence - combines centralized capabilities with entrepreneurial operating divisions. Successful members thrive in our shared culture of accountability, deliberate trust, and open communication. As a team we aspire to work together to exceed expectations and collectively contribute across the global organization to always maintain our nimble, startup culture.

At Alloy, we have an ethos of "Mentorship-By-Apprenticeship" in all of our positions. We strive to have workers in the office when needed to interact organically and face-to-face. Of course, as a lab-based operation, our cells and animals grow 7 days a week, 365 days per year. We respect and value our colleagues for their hard work that requires them to be in the lab every day. We ask our people who have more flexible accommodations to appreciate their colleagues who have less flexibility. We are all one team!

About the Role at Alloy Therapeutics
As Director of Protein Science, you will lead a team responsible for high-throughput mammalian protein production and mg-scale expression in support of therapeutic programs. In this role you will leverage antibody building blocks to create multi-specific antibody formats that custom fit the needs of our mechanistically-diverse partner base, from large pharma companies to emerging biotech companies and academic collaborators.

You will work closely with the discovery, analytics and pharmacology teams to review data in real time and make the necessary scientific adjustments to ensure a successful campaign. In addition, you will serve as a project leader overseeing the on-time completion of project activities, accomplishing shared objectives, and meeting rigorous partner timelines.

Strong communication skills are essential for this role, as you will interact with a diverse group of stakeholders both within and outside the company. You will also be accountable for high-quality partner communication throughout the project life cycles, including drafting research proposals, updating project status and timelines, and presenting final deliveries. In parallel, you will provide regular project updates and presentations to internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with project goals and timelines and addressing any potential issues or concerns promptly.

This role will report directly to the site head Antibody-Powered Division Waltham, MA, with autonomy owning various stakeholders, projects, and tasks in a dynamic start-up environment while keeping up the pace of Alloy.

How You’ll Drive Impact
  • Drive: Scientific direction and execution of monoclonal discovery and multispecific engineering campaigns.
  • Innovate: Ensure the application of cutting-edge technologies and methodologies in protein expression.
  • Collaborate: Integrate protein engineering and cutting-edge efforts efficiently into product offerings and engage with external collaborators in discovery of biologics.
  • Deliver: Efficient execution of partner projects balancing quality, timelines, and costs, while ensuring successful completion of therapeutic discovery that meet our partners’ objectives.
  • Lead: Marshal, inspire, and mentor a cross-functional team of scientists. Lead by example by going the extra mile to ensure we are successful delivering on projects.
  • Communicate: Communicate effectively with key stakeholders externally and internally, fostering productive interactions both upward and downward, and across teams at different sites.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and grow a team of protein scientists
  • Own molecular biology, antibody expression, purification, and quality control workflows
  • Engage prospective customers to articulate multispecific antibody production strategies
  • Deliver high-throughput and mg-scale antibody production runs successfully and on time
  • Drive major decisions, balance tradeoffs and resolve technical issues with projects
  • Lead process improvement initiatives across the antibody-powered division
  • Ensure rigorous data capture in ELN/LIMS systems
  • Bring innovative scientific and technological solutions to increase business competitiveness of bispecific service offerings

Qualifications
  • You have a PhD in a relevant scientific field (e.g. Biochemistry, Biophysics, Molecular Biology, etc) with a minimum of 8 years of industry experience in antibody or protein engineering, or a master’s degree with 12+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • You have a track record leading protein expression, purification, and characterization functions supporting drug discovery
  • You have hands-on depth in recombinant mammalian protein expression systems
  • You have broad and deep experience with complex purification techniques and process/method development for bi- and multi-specific antibodies.
  • You have a proven track record of successful execution and delivery of projects within scope, budget, and timeline.
  • You have demonstrated the ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
  • You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
  • You have excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and mentor team members.
  • Ability to work across various US and international time zones.
  • Accommodate occasional travel as needed (10%).

Taking Care of Our People
We support the individuality of what people need to do outside of work to empower them to do their best at work. While you focus on making better medicine together, we focus on programs and benefits that support a diverse and growing team. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, Alloy offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits starting from day one.

Compensation
  • Competitive base and equity compensation commensurate with level of experience and independence
  • 401(k) company match
Health & Family
  • Generous personal and family medical, dental and vision benefits with 100% of premiums and deductibles covered
  • Company-paid disability (STD, LTD) and life insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • Family planning support up to $45,000 (e.g., IVF/PGT, adoption, surrogacy, egg retrieval)
Unique Perks
  • Unlimited PTO (paid time off) and flexible schedules
  • Annual stipend for continuing education with commitment to your career through individualized professional development plan
  • Wellness and Extensive Employee Assistance Program (EAP) including resources for mental wellness

Pay Transparency
At Alloy Therapeutics, we believe in fostering trust and open communication. For this role, the estimated range is $170,000 - $200,000, with the final offer based on factors like your experience, skills, and alignment with our needs.

Additionally, this role is eligible for equity compensation, reflecting our commitment to shared success as we work together to make better medicines.

We are proud to offer competitive compensation and benefits, aiming to support our team’s professional and personal well-being. If you have any questions about pay or benefits, we’re here to help.

Alloy Therapeutics is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at recruiting@alloytx.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for disability assistance as soon as possible.

title: VP, Strategy Consulting
description:
About Us
CMB is a full-service AI-enabled insights and strategy firm based in Boston. As a Top 25 Insights & Analytics company, we help leading Global brands engage, innovate, and grow by combining market research, advanced analytics, consumer psychology, AI+HI solutions, and strategic consulting. Our people are our power, and our employee-owned culture values curiosity, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

What about our culture? Simply put, our people are our power. At CMB, we’re proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work, a recognition that reflects the diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment our team creates every day. We bring together bright perspectives and curious minds who challenge assumptions, share ideas, and push one another to be better.

Innovation is deeply embedded in how we work. That commitment has earned us recognition as one of the GRIT Top 50 Most Innovative Companies, and it shows up daily in how we approach research, insights, and client impact. At CMB, you’ll have meaningful opportunities to achieve your full potential — from learning new skills and expanding your expertise to advancing your career in an environment where you are supported, valued, and encouraged to innovate.

Our benefits say a lot about how much we value our employees: we offer a fully paid sabbatical, an annual wellness day, paid time off to volunteer, generous medical plans, a 401k match, and more. Every employee also gets to enjoy an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

ESOP? Yes, we are 100% employee owned! An ESOP is a qualified retirement plan, similar to a 401k, but you don’t have to make any financial contributions to participate in the rewards. When we each work hard to provide exceptional service and deliverables to our clients, the positive performance of the company increases the value of our stock and enables the accumulation of wealth for all our employee-owners.

About the Position
The VP, Strategy Consulting is a client-facing executive responsible for leading CMB's insights-powered and growth-focused consulting practice, expanding the firm's role beyond serving Insights leaders to advising senior marketing, strategy, innovation, and business leaders. This person will build and lead a consulting team to address complex growth, customer, marketing, innovation, and competitive challenges. This position reports to the SVP of Growth Strategy.
The primary responsibility is building and leading a consulting practice of cross-disciplinary strategists who transform our strategic insights and activation work along with our AI+HI solutions into integrated decision guidance and implementation advisory services. This role partners closely with Growth, Research, Analytics, and Industry Practice Leaders to shape opportunities from the earliest business conversations through implementation. The VP also serves as visible external leader for CMB by building relationships with senior executives, leading strategic pursuits, and establishing CMB as a distinctive insights-powered growth consultancy. This role can be hybrid in Boston or remote in the US.

About You
You are a strategy consultant and practice builder who has a reputation for establishing trust with senior leaders at large global companies. You thrive in ambiguity as a strategic systems thinker who naturally connects customer, market, competitive, and organizational insights into practical business growth strategies. Clients and colleagues seek your perspective because you simplify complexity, facilitate executive conversations, and turn evidence into practical strategies that organizations can act upon.
You are equally comfortable advising senior growth leaders, leading a strategy consulting team, and partnering with Business Development on client engagement. You are energized by the opportunity to build and grow an integrated strategy consulting practice.

About Your Background
You bring 15+ years of experience in strategy and growth consulting for Fortune 500 companies
You have:
  • Built or scaled a consulting practice, capability, solution portfolio, or multidisciplinary team.
  • Developed enduring executive client relationships and generated significant consulting revenue.
  • Integrated consumer and market insight, analytics, and other evidence into business and growth strategy.
  • Led multidisciplinary teams spanning strategy, research, analytics, innovation, and activation.
  • Demonstrated the ability to move from insights activation to growth strategy and implementation.
Responsibilities and Expectations
Here's what you'll be accountable for as CMB's VP, Strategy Consulting:
Lead CMB's Strategy & Decision Enablement Practice
  • Define the vision, operating model, consulting frameworks, quality standards, and talent strategy for the Strategy Consulting function.
  • Build and grow a strategy team within a highly collaborative culture.
  • Introduce and institutionalize new strategy and decision-enablement capabilities across CMB, equipping internal teams to understand the value of these consulting services.
  • Ensure our multi-disciplinary growth strategy consultants enable decisions and deliver client impacts.
  • Create a clear bridge from CMB's research, analytics, and AI capabilities to higher-value integrated strategic advisory engagements.
Serve as CMB's Executive Strategic Advisor
  • Advise executive clients on growth, customer, innovation, competitive, and organizational decisions.
  • Work with Activation team members to build decision frameworks that simplify ambiguity and align stakeholders.
  • Coach your team to translate complex evidence into highly impactful executive-ready recommendations and strategic implementation guidance.
  • Help our account leaders identify broader business challenges where our capabilities can create greater impact.
Drive Growth & Market Presence
  • Expand executive relationships beyond traditional Insights organizations.
  • Develop scalable advisory offerings and serve as a thought leader.
  • Represent CMB in executive presentations, conferences, and strategic discussions.
  • Recruit and mentor diverse, cross-disciplinary consulting talent and external experts.
Measures of Success
  • Establish CMB as a credible and differentiated insights-powered growth consultancy.
  • Establish a differentiated Strategy Consulting practice.
  • Expand executive-level client relationships and strategic advisory engagements.
  • Increase pipeline, revenue, and account growth through integrated consulting solutions.
  • Build scalable AI enabled consulting frameworks that strengthen CMB's market position.
  • Develop a high-performing team recognized for strategic impact and client value.
Qualifications
  • Graduate degree in Business, Strategy, Economics, Organizational Leadership, Design, Public Policy, or related field preferred.
  • 15+ years of consulting and executive advisory experience for enterprise growth clients.
  • Experience building consulting practices, solutions, or multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience integrating research, analytics, AI-enabled capabilities, activation, implementation, and strategy.
  • Experience in Travel & Hospitality, Technology & Platforms, Media & Entertainment, Financial Services, Retail and/or Healthcare is valuable but not required
  • Strong executive facilitation, communication, commercial, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Solid understanding of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies.
  • Experience coaching, mentoring, and developing colleagues while leading through influence in a collaborative environment.
  • Curiosity about markets, consumer behavior, business strategy, and emerging technologies, including AI, with a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.
Travel
  • up to 20%

*No agency assistance needed*
*No visa/work authorization available*

What to Expect as a Candidate
At Chadwick Martin Bailey, Inc. (CMB), we’re committed to creating a positive, transparent, and secure candidate experience. As part of that commitment, we want to make job seekers aware of fraudulent recruiting activity that can occur online. Please keep the following in mind during your job search:
CMB job opportunities are only posted through official channels, including our careers page, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other trusted recruiting platforms. Be cautious of listings or outreach from unofficial sources claiming to represent CMB.

Official communications from CMB will only come from verified company email addresses and JazzHR and authorized recruiters. If you receive unexpected messages, interview requests, or offers that seem suspicious, we encourage you to verify their legitimacy before responding.
We encourage all candidates to confirm open positions directly through our official careers page to ensure the opportunity is legitimate and current.

CMB will never request sensitive personal or financial information early in the hiring process, including banking details, payment information, or requests to purchase equipment. Please protect your personal information and be cautious of fraudulent requests.
If you believe you have encountered a scam or suspicious activity involving CMB, please contact our recruiting team immediately. Your vigilance helps us maintain a safe and trustworthy hiring experience for all candidates.

We appreciate your interest in joining CMB and encourage all applicants to remain informed and scam-aware throughout their job search. Employment with Chadwick Martin Bailey, Inc. is contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Chadwick Martin Bailey (CMB) is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process, during employment, and in accessing employment benefits and privileges. title: Project Manager, Supply Chain Design
description:
About GAINS

GAINS is on a mission to make supply chains smarter, faster, and self-improving, powered by AI. Our Decision Engineering & Orchestration (DEO) platform does not just support decisions, it drives them by aligning strategy, planning, and execution across every level of the supply chain. We serve inventory-intensive industries where the stakes are high and the complexity is real, helping customers move from reactive, spreadsheet-driven planning to continuously learning, AI-led operations that deliver measurable results fast. At GAINS, we call it Moving Forward Faster, and it is not a tagline, it is how we are redefining what is possible in supply chain decision-making.

Summary

As a Project Manager, Supply Chain Design, you will lead the day-to-day execution of supply chain optimization projects for our clients. You will build the model structure in Supply Chain Architect, translate client network and historical data into model inputs, and manage the project from kickoff through delivery. This role requires hands-on supply chain project experience, strong analytical skills, and the ability to communicate outputs and cost/benefit impacts directly to client leadership.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Project Leadership
  • Lead and manage supply chain optimization projects from initiation to completion, ensuring on-time delivery and alignment with client expectations.
  • Own the day-to-day project plan, milestones, risks, and issue resolution.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to keep workstreams on schedule and dependencies visible.
Model Building in Supply Chain Architect
  • Build and maintain the model structure in Supply Chain Architect for each engagement.
  • Translate client network and historical data into validated model inputs.
  • Run scenarios and simulations across network design, inventory, and distribution strategies.
  • Test model assumptions with the client and document how inputs map to outputs.
Data Analysis
  • Analyze existing supply chain processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.
  • Validate data quality and resolve gaps or inconsistencies in client-provided data sets.
  • Quantify cost and service impacts of proposed changes.
Supply Chain Mapping
  • Work with clients to understand their existing supply chain structure.
  • Develop supply chain maps that identify key touchpoints and potential bottlenecks.
Client Collaboration
  • Work directly with clients as the primary day-to-day project contact.
  • Communicate recommendations, model outputs, and cost/benefit impacts to client leadership.
  • Explain complex modeling concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Build strong client relationships and manage expectations throughout the engagement.
Documentation and Reporting
  • Prepare reports documenting analysis, recommendations, and implementation plans.
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and accessible project documentation.
  • Deliver status updates and readouts on a consistent cadence.
Continuous Improvement
  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in supply chain design.
  • Contribute to the improvement of project methodologies, tools, and delivery processes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Approximately 5 years of hands-on supply chain project experience, including running supply chain optimization projects.
  • Proficiency with supply chain modeling tools, simulation software, and data analytics.
  • Strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, and risk management.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience presenting to leadership.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team and independently when required.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with supply chain software and technology solutions.
  • Experience building network optimization or simulation models in a commercial modeling tool.
  • Knowledge of sustainability practices in supply chain design.
  • Certification in supply chain management, logistics, or project management (for example, CSCMP, APICS, PMP).
  • Consulting or client-facing delivery experience across diverse industries.

Job Description:

GliaCell is seeking a AI Engineer on one of our subcontracts. This is a full-time position offering the opportunity to support a U.S. Government customer. The mission is to provide technical expertise that assists in sustaining critical mission-related software and systems to a large government contract.

title: Community Inclusion Worker
description:

title: IDIQ Program Manager
description:
Based in the Washington, D.C. Metro area, Pivot Path Solutions, LLC is a government contracting and business solutions firm that offers enterprise IT solutions, strategic and acquisition planning, organizational development, and medical research and analytics services to help customers adapt and thrive in changing market conditions.


Position Summary

Pivot Path Solutions is seeking a highly qualified Senior Program Manager to serve as the IDIQ Program Manager and principal management lead for a program within the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) agency. This is an on-site position in Gaithersburg, MD.

The Senior Program Manager will serve as the primary management interface with NIST and provide oversight of multiple concurrent firm-fixed-price task orders. This position is responsible for ensuring high-quality technical performance, effective staffing, timely deliverables, cost and schedule control, risk management, and customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate has successfully managed complex federal technology or scientific programs involving multidisciplinary technical teams, multiple task orders, and Government-funded computer science or physical science initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary program-management point of contact for NIST, Pivot Path leadership, subcontractors, and task-order teams.
  • Provide centralized oversight of all task orders issued under the IDIQ contract.
  • Manage technical performance, quality, staffing, schedules, deliverables, risks, and costs across concurrent firm-fixed-price task orders.
  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities, reporting relationships, communication procedures, and escalation paths.
  • Coordinate task-order planning, staffing, technical execution, quality assurance, and performance reporting.
  • Maintain accurate program and task-order records.
  • Track task-order deliverables using the Government-provided Redmine application and update status at least monthly or as required.
  • Conduct recurring program reviews covering progress, risks, staffing, quality, corrective actions, and upcoming milestones.
  • Ensure deliverables receive appropriate technical, quality, and contractual reviews before submission.
  • Monitor performance metrics and implement corrective actions when cost, schedule, quality, or technical risks arise.
  • Lead the recruitment, onboarding, retention, assignment, and replacement of qualified personnel.
  • Confirm that assigned personnel meet applicable education, experience, technical, and security requirements.
  • Manage subcontractor performance, workshare, communications, deliverables, and compliance.
  • Coordinate personnel security processing, system and facility access, and other NIST onboarding requirements.
  • Support NIST Associates Information System and authorized foreign-national processing when applicable.
  • Maintain productive relationships with Government program, contracting, and technical stakeholders.
  • Provide executive-level reporting to Pivot Path leadership regarding contract performance, staffing, financial status, risks, and customer satisfaction.
  • Oversee technical work involving information technology, database applications, scientific data, software engineering, standards, testing tools, reference implementations, analytics, and related services.

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet one of the following education and experience combinations:

  • Ph.D. in Physical Sciences or Computer Science with at least eight years of experience in IT-related studies, technical management, or a combination of both; or
  • Master’s degree in Physical Sciences or Computer Science with at least 11 years of experience in IT-related studies, technical management, or a combination of both.

Candidates must also possess:

  • At least three years of experience managing Government-funded computer science or physical science-based programs.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi-task contracts or programs of comparable technical complexity, contractual complexity, and magnitude.
  • Experience managing quality, cost, schedule, staffing, deliverables, risks, and customer relationships.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and coordinating multiple concurrent projects or task orders.
  • Strong written, verbal, organizational, analytical, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to satisfy applicable federal background, security, facility-access, and system-access requirements.

What We Offer:
Pivot Path Solutions strives to attract, motivate, and retain the best people in the industry. Our benefits package reflects our continued commitment to our employees by prioritizing the health and well-being of each member. The Company offers a comprehensive compensation package that includes:

  • Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Safe Harbor 401(K) Plan

U.S. Citizenship is required, and all selected applicants will be subject to a government security investigation. This includes meeting the eligibility requirements for access to classified information and the ability to obtain government-granted security clearance. Individuals may also be subject to background investigation including criminal history, employment verification, education verification, drug testing, and creditworthiness.

title: Community Education Facilitator
description:
Job Title: Community Education Facilitator
FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt
Reports To: Pro Bono Coordinator (Attorney)/Managing Attorney
Supervises: N/A
Compensation: $23.00 – $39.00 Hourly (DOE)

Inland Counties Legal Services (ICLS) is seeking a Community Education Facilitator to join its Pro Bono Team. This role will lead community outreach and engagement for ICLS's Disaster Preparation & Response Program, which aims to help individuals and community partners throughout Inland Southern California prepare for, respond to, and recover from disasters, including wildfires, floods, earthquakes, and other natural or human-caused emergencies.

ICLS is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization providing free legal services to people of limited means residing in Riverside and San Bernardino counties. ICLS targets services for seniors and those in the greatest social and economic need. ICLS provides legal assistance in eight practice groups: Elder, Family Law, Consumer, Housing, Immigration, Systemic & Impact Litigation, Health Law, and Public Benefits & Education; and a Pro Bono Program, operating volunteer-enhanced client programs, including Small Business & Nonprofit, Expungement, LGBTQ+ Services, HIV Services, Guardianship, Disaster Preparation & Response, and Student Programs, among others. Visit our website at for more information.

Overview of Position & Responsibilities:

The Community Education Facilitator is responsible for building ICLS's disaster preparedness presence in the community across Riverside and San Bernardino counties. The role delivers general disaster preparedness, response, and recovery education with a legal readiness component; represents ICLS with emergency management and nonprofit partners; produces printed and digital outreach materials; and tracks and reports grant deliverables for ICLS and its partner organizations.

Specific Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Community engagements: Deliver disaster preparedness, response, and recovery presentations to community groups across Riverside and San Bernardino counties, incorporating legal readiness topics appropriate to each phase. Coordinate with emergency management and nonprofit partners to co-present where possible.

  • VOAD engagements: Attend Riverside and San Bernardino Voluntary Organizations Active in Disaster (VOAD) meetings and build referral relationships with member organizations.

  • Community resource fairs: Represent ICLS at community fairs and maintain an inventory of disaster preparedness materials in English and Spanish.

  • Digital engagements: Develop and maintain disaster preparedness content for the ICLS and Disaster Legal Assistance Collaborative (DLAC) websites, newsletter, and social media.

  • Deliverables tracking and reporting: Track engagements and materials in the program's deliverables tracker, gather data from partner organizations, and prepare quarterly grant reports.

Desired Education, Skills, and Experience:

  • Four (4) year college degree or equivalent experience in community outreach, emergency management, communications, or a related field.

  • 1–2 years of experience in community outreach, public education, emergency management, or nonprofit program coordination preferred.

  • Familiarity with disaster preparedness education, VOAD, or emergency management partnerships preferred.

title: Offshore HLO / Platform Clerk – Deepwater 14/14
description:
QUALITY PROCESS SERVICES (QPS)
HLO / Offshore Clerk
Deepwater Offshore Production Platform
Location: Crew Change Houma
Schedule: 14 days on / 14 days off
Job Type: Full-Time

About QPS

Quality Process Services (QPS) provides skilled personnel and specialized support services to the oil and gas industry. We are committed to safe operations, dependable service, and building strong working relationships with our employees and customers.

Position Summary

QPS is seeking an experienced Helicopter Landing Officer (HLO) / Offshore Clerk to support operations aboard a deepwater production platform. This position combines helideck and passenger-movement responsibilities with administrative, logistical, and clerical support. The successful candidate will have offshore experience, strong organizational and communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced production environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate helicopter arrivals, departures, passenger movements, and helideck activities.
  • Maintain clear communication with helicopter crews, platform leadership, shorebase personnel, and other appropriate parties.
  • Verify passenger manifests, baggage, cargo, weights, and required documentation before each flight.

  • Inspect the helideck and surrounding areas before helicopter operations and confirm that required firefighting, rescue, communication, and emergency-response equipment is ready for use.
  • Direct and coordinate the helideck team during normal and emergency operations.
  • Monitor weather and platform conditions that could affect helicopter operations.
  • Coordinate the safe loading and unloading of passengers, baggage, freight, and approved hazardous materials.
  • Maintain helicopter logs, flight records, manifests, and related documentation.
  • Maintain accurate personnel-on-board records and track crew arrivals and departures.
  • Prepare and distribute daily reports, personnel lists, room assignments, muster assignments, and crew-change information.
  • Assist with coordinating helicopters, marine vessels, shorebase activities, and personnel movements.
  • Maintain employee timesheets, work schedules, training records, certifications, and other required documentation.
  • Support platform leadership with administrative duties, reports, correspondence, meeting materials, and safety documentation.
  • Enter and update information in company and customer databases or management systems.
  • Assist with inventory records, supply requests, purchase orders, shipping documents, and material tracking.
  • Maintain confidentiality when handling employee, operational, and customer information.
  • Participate in helicopter emergency-response drills, platform safety meetings, and other required training.
  • Perform additional clerical, logistical, and operational-support duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Previous offshore experience is required; deepwater production experience is strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience as an HLO, offshore dispatcher, logistics coordinator, POB coordinator, or platform clerk is preferred.
  • Current HLO training or certification is preferred and may be required by the customer.
  • Working knowledge of offshore helicopter operations, passenger movement, manifests, weight control, and helideck safety procedures.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and electronic recordkeeping systems.
  • Experience with SAP, Heli-Pass, or a similar personnel/logistics management system is preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills, close attention to detail, and effective written, verbal, and radio communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize responsibilities, work with limited supervision, and interact professionally with employees, contractors, aviation personnel, and shorebase teams.
  • Must pass all required background checks, drug screenings, physical examinations, and customer onboarding requirements.
  • Must possess or be able to obtain required offshore credentials and training, which may include TWIC, SafeGulf or RigPass, HUET/BOSIET, water-survival training, and CA-EBS.

Physical and Work Requirements

  • Ability to work a rotational offshore schedule, including 12-hour shifts, nights, weekends, and holidays as required.
  • Ability to travel by helicopter and marine vessel.
  • Ability to climb stairs and ladders and move safely throughout an offshore production facility.
  • Ability to work outdoors in changing weather conditions and around production equipment.
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment and respond appropriately during drills and emergency situations.

Safety Expectations

The HLO / Offshore Clerk must demonstrate a strong commitment to safety, follow all company and customer procedures, identify and report unsafe conditions, participate in safety meetings and drills, and support a safe and professional offshore work environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Quality Process Services is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. QPS does not discriminate on the basis of any status protected by applicable law.

title: Highway Lighting Installer
description:
About the Role:

The Highway Lighting Installer plays a critical role in enhancing road safety and visibility by installing, maintaining, and repairing lighting systems along highways and major roadways. This position requires working closely with construction teams and electrical engineers to ensure that lighting installations meet all regulatory standards and project specifications. The installer is responsible for interpreting technical drawings and electrical schematics to accurately position and connect lighting fixtures and control systems. Attention to detail and adherence to safety protocols are paramount, as the work often occurs in active traffic environments and requires coordination with traffic management teams. Ultimately, the role contributes to safer nighttime driving conditions and improved infrastructure reliability across transportation networks.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.
  • Proven experience in electrical installation or maintenance, preferably in outdoor or roadway environments.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical systems, wiring, and safety protocols.
  • Ability to work at heights and in various weather conditions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience specifically with highway or street lighting systems.
  • Training in traffic control and work zone safety.
  • Ability to operate heavy machinery such as bucket trucks or cranes.

Responsibilities:

  • Install highway lighting fixtures, poles, and associated electrical components according to project plans and safety standards.
  • Perform routine inspections and maintenance on existing lighting systems to ensure optimal functionality and compliance with regulations.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, blueprints, and technical manuals to guide installation and troubleshooting activities.
  • Coordinate with construction crews, traffic control personnel, and project managers to safely execute work in active roadway environments.
  • Utilize specialized tools and equipment to connect wiring, test circuits, and verify the operational status of lighting installations.
  • Document work performed, including installation details, maintenance activities, and any issues encountered for project records.
  • Adhere strictly to occupational health and safety guidelines to minimize risks to self, team members, and the public.

Skills:

The Highway Lighting Installer uses technical skills daily to interpret electrical schematics and install complex lighting systems accurately. Strong problem-solving abilities are essential when diagnosing and repairing electrical faults or adapting installations to site-specific challenges. Communication skills facilitate effective coordination with team members and other stakeholders to ensure safety and project efficiency. Physical dexterity and stamina are required to handle tools, climb poles, and work outdoors under varying weather conditions. Additionally, knowledge of safety standards and regulations is applied continuously to maintain a secure work environment for all personnel and the public.

title: Phone Representative / Appointment Scheduler – REMOTE
description:
Phone Booker / Appointment Scheduler – REMOTE

100% Remote | Work From Home | Appointment Setting | Recruiting Support | Entry Level Welcome | Training Provided

Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Work From Home
Location: U.S.-Based Applicants
Experience: Entry Level | No Recruiting Experience Required
Schedule: Flexible | Consistent Availability Required
Primary Focus: Candidate Outreach | Appointment Scheduling | Recruiting Support
Training: Scripts, Systems, Scheduling & Ongoing Coaching Provided

📞 Great on the Phone? Turn Your Communication Skills Into a Remote Career.

Do you enjoy talking with people, staying organized, and helping others take the next step toward an opportunity?

We're expanding our recruiting operations and looking for a motivated, dependable, and energetic Remote Phone Booker / Appointment Scheduler to help connect interested applicants with our hiring team.

This is not random cold calling.

You'll primarily contact warm candidates who have already applied, responded to a recruiting advertisement, or expressed interest in learning more about our career opportunities.

Your role is simple but important:

Connect → Confirm Interest → Schedule → Remind → Follow Up → Help Candidates Show Up

You'll help create a positive first impression while keeping our interview calendar and recruiting pipeline moving.

No previous recruiting or appointment-setting experience is required. Training is provided.

✓ 100% Remote / Work From Home
✓ Entry Level Welcome
✓ Warm Applicant Outreach
✓ No Random Cold Calling
✓ Training & Call Guidance Provided
✓ Flexible Scheduling Opportunities
✓ Recruiting & Candidate Support Experience
✓ Performance-Focused Environment
✓ Career Growth Opportunities

✨ What You'll Do

As a Remote Phone Booker / Appointment Scheduler, you'll be one of the first personal connections applicants have with our recruiting team.

Your goal is to provide a friendly, professional, efficient, and organized candidate experience while helping qualified applicants move through the interview process.

📲 Candidate Outreach & Appointment Setting

Your daily responsibilities may include:

  • Make outbound calls to candidates who have already applied or expressed interest

  • Introduce yourself professionally and create a positive first impression

  • Confirm the candidate's continued interest

  • Provide basic information regarding the next step in the hiring process

  • Schedule candidates for available career overviews and interviews

  • Help applicants select available appointment times

  • Send or confirm applicable scheduling information

  • Verify upcoming appointments

  • Follow up with candidates before scheduled interviews

  • Contact applicants who missed previous appointments

  • Help interested candidates reschedule

  • Answer basic questions regarding scheduling and interview logistics

  • Direct detailed position-specific questions to the appropriate recruiter or hiring manager

Your goal is to turn applicant interest into completed appointments.

📅 Keep the Recruiting Calendar Moving

Appointment setting isn't simply putting someone's name on a calendar.

Strong Phone Bookers help ensure candidates understand:

  • What they scheduled

  • When their appointment begins

  • How to attend

  • What they should expect

  • What their next step is

You'll help maintain an organized appointment pipeline by:

  • Monitoring upcoming appointments

  • Confirming scheduled candidates

  • Following up when appropriate

  • Rescheduling missed appointments

  • Identifying candidates who still need to schedule

  • Keeping candidate statuses current

  • Communicating important scheduling information to the recruiting team

Organization and consistent follow-up are a major part of success in this position.

🔥 Warm Candidate Leads – No Random Cold Calling

One of the biggest differences between this role and traditional telemarketing is who you're contacting.

You'll primarily speak with people who have already taken an action indicating interest, such as:

  • Submitting a job application

  • Responding to a recruiting advertisement

  • Requesting information

  • Beginning the interview process

  • Scheduling previously but needing to reschedule

  • Completing an earlier recruiting step

That gives your conversation a purpose from the beginning.

You're following up with interested applicants—not searching the internet for random people to call.

🎯 Your Mission: Get Candidates to the Next Step

A successful call doesn't need to be complicated.

Your focus is to:

Connect with the applicant
↓
Confirm they're still interested
↓
Explain the next scheduling step
↓
Book the appointment
↓
Confirm the details
↓
Follow up when needed
↓
Help improve appointment attendance

If you're someone who enjoys having a clear objective and measurable results, this may be an excellent fit.

🗂️ Candidate Follow-Up & Recruiting Support

You'll also help maintain accurate candidate information and organized follow-up.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Record call outcomes

  • Enter conversation notes

  • Update candidate statuses

  • Maintain appointment records

  • Track scheduled appointments

  • Track confirmed appointments

  • Track missed appointments

  • Track rescheduled candidates

  • Maintain follow-up lists

  • Update candidate contact information when appropriate

  • Communicate through phone, email, and text when applicable

  • Assist with reminder communications

  • Coordinate with recruiters and hiring managers

  • Escalate candidate questions when necessary

  • Help keep the recruiting pipeline organized

Attention to detail matters.

A great phone conversation isn't enough if the appointment, notes, or candidate status isn't documented correctly.

☎️ Comfortable With High-Volume Calling? Even Better.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys frequent phone communication.

Depending on recruiting volume, you'll need to be comfortable:

  • Making multiple outbound calls throughout your work period

  • Moving efficiently from one conversation to the next

  • Leaving professional voicemails

  • Following up consistently

  • Speaking with many different personalities

  • Handling unanswered calls without becoming discouraged

  • Staying positive when candidates decline

  • Maintaining energy throughout repetitive outreach

  • Working toward daily activity and appointment goals

Consistency is more important than having the “perfect” phone call.

🗣️ You Don't Need to Sound Like a Salesperson

We're looking for someone who sounds:

  • Friendly

  • Confident

  • Natural

  • Professional

  • Helpful

  • Clear

  • Positive

  • Organized

The best conversations often feel simple:

“Hi, I'm following up regarding the application you recently submitted. I wanted to see if you're still interested and help you schedule the next step.”

From there, your job is to listen, answer basic scheduling questions, and help the candidate move forward.

💻 100% Remote / Work From Home

This position is performed remotely.

You'll communicate with candidates and collaborate with the recruiting team using online systems and virtual technology.

Systems may include:

  • Online scheduling platforms

  • Calendly

  • Zoom

  • Email

  • Phone

  • Text messaging

  • Online calendars

  • Applicant tracking systems

  • Recruiting platforms

  • Candidate-management tools

  • Digital communication systems

Training is provided on our processes and applicable systems.

You'll need to be comfortable learning technology, switching between systems, and maintaining accurate records while working independently.

🏡 What You Need to Work From Home

Applicants should have:

  • Reliable computer or laptop

  • Reliable high-speed internet

  • Working microphone or professional headset

  • Reliable phone capability

  • Quiet environment for candidate calls

  • Professional communication skills

  • Ability to access online scheduling and recruiting systems

Your workspace doesn't need to be elaborate, but it should allow you to make calls without excessive noise or interruptions.

⏰ Flexible Scheduling + Consistency

Working remotely can provide flexibility, but appointment setting depends heavily on availability and consistent follow-up.

You'll need to organize your work time around periods when applicants can reasonably be reached.

Successful Phone Bookers are able to balance:

Flexibility + Structure + Follow-Up + Accountability

This role may be a strong fit if you enjoy working independently but still prefer:

  • Clear expectations

  • Daily objectives

  • Measurable results

  • Organized follow-up

  • A team to support

  • Opportunities to improve your performance

📊 Performance & Measurable Results

This is a results-oriented recruiting support position.

Depending on team needs, performance may be evaluated through metrics such as:

  • Outbound call activity

  • Candidate contacts

  • Conversations completed

  • Appointments scheduled

  • Appointment confirmations

  • Reschedules

  • Candidate follow-up

  • Appointment attendance

  • Accuracy of candidate records

  • Consistency and reliability

Your activity directly impacts how many interested candidates successfully connect with the hiring team.

📚 No Appointment-Setting Experience? We'll Train You.

Previous recruiting, call-center, or appointment-setting experience can be helpful—but it is not required.

Training may include:

  • Phone scripts

  • Conversation flow

  • Applicant outreach procedures

  • Appointment-setting techniques

  • Professional phone communication

  • Scheduling systems

  • Candidate follow-up

  • Appointment confirmations

  • Missed-interview follow-up

  • Rescheduling procedures

  • Recruiting-system navigation

  • Candidate documentation

  • Call tracking

  • Note-taking standards

  • Time management

  • Productivity strategies

  • Handling common candidate questions

We'll provide the process and guidance. You bring the energy, reliability, consistency, and willingness to learn.

🌟 Who We're Looking For

You may be a great fit if you're:

  • Friendly and confident on the phone

  • Comfortable starting conversations

  • A clear verbal communicator

  • A good listener

  • Professional and courteous

  • Organized and detail-oriented

  • Comfortable making frequent outbound calls

  • Persistent without being pushy

  • Positive when handling rejection or unanswered calls

  • Dependable

  • Personally accountable

  • Self-motivated

  • Comfortable working independently

  • Able to manage multiple follow-ups

  • Comfortable working toward measurable goals

  • Quick to learn technology

  • Consistent with documentation

  • Coachable and receptive to feedback

  • Interested in recruiting or talent acquisition

💼 Experience That Transfers Well

Previous experience in any of these areas may transfer especially well:

Appointment Setting • Customer Service • Recruiting • Call Centers • Reception • Administrative Support • Scheduling • Inside Sales • Lead Follow-Up • Client Services • Staffing • Talent Acquisition • Customer Support • Hospitality • Retail • Front Desk • Office Administration

No previous recruiting experience is required.

Strong communication, reliability, organization, professionalism, and work ethic can be more important than having a specific previous job title.

🔄 Returning to Work or Changing Careers?

This role may also appeal to individuals who are:

  • Returning to the workforce

  • Transitioning from retail or hospitality

  • Moving from an office environment to remote work

  • Looking to develop recruiting experience

  • Interested in talent acquisition

  • Experienced in customer service

  • Comfortable with phone-based work

  • Looking for an entry point into recruiting operations

The communication and organizational skills you've developed in another industry may transfer better than you think.

📈 Build Recruiting Experience & Grow

Strong performers who are interested in expanding their responsibilities may have opportunities to develop into additional recruiting functions.

A potential development path may include:

Phone Booker → Candidate Coordinator → Recruiting Support → Recruiter → Recruiting Team Leadership

As responsibilities expand, development opportunities may include:

  • Candidate pipeline management

  • Interview coordination

  • Recruiting systems

  • Candidate communication

  • Applicant screening support

  • Recruiting operations

  • Team training

  • New-booker mentorship

  • Recruiting analytics

  • Leadership

Growth opportunities depend on performance, reliability, consistency, professional development, business needs, and available positions.

🌟 Why This Role Matters

Every recruiting process begins with communication.

A candidate may be interested in an opportunity but never take the next step simply because:

  • They forgot to schedule

  • They missed an email

  • They weren't sure what to do next

  • Their original appointment no longer works

  • They have a simple question

  • They need someone to follow up

That's where you come in.

Your communication helps:

  • Connect interested applicants with opportunities

  • Improve candidate engagement

  • Increase completed appointments

  • Reduce missed interviews

  • Improve candidate follow-up

  • Keep recruiting pipelines organized

  • Support recruiters and hiring managers

  • Create a better applicant experience

Every appointment you book helps move someone one step closer to a potential new career.

Minimum Requirements

Applicants must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age

  • Be physically located within the United States

  • Be legally authorized to work in the United States

  • Have access to a reliable computer or laptop

  • Maintain reliable high-speed internet

  • Have working microphone or headset capability

  • Maintain a quiet environment for phone calls

  • Be comfortable making frequent outbound calls

  • Be comfortable learning web-based systems

  • Be able to maintain accurate candidate records

  • Communicate professionally with applicants

title: Supervising Financial Counselor
description:
About NYLAG:
Founded in 1990, NYLAG is a leading civil legal services organization combating economic, racial, and social injustice by advocating for people experiencing poverty or in crisis. Our services include comprehensive, free civil legal services, financial empowerment, impact litigation, policy advocacy, and community partnerships. NYLAG exists because wealth should not determine who has access to justice. We aim to disrupt systemic racism by serving individuals and families whose legal and financial crises are often rooted in racial inequality. NYLAG goes to where the need is, providing services in more than 150 community sites (e.g. courts, hospitals, libraries) and on our Mobile Legal Help Center. NYLAG’s staff of over 400 impacted the lives of nearly 129,000 people last year.

Job description
NYLAG is seeking a highly motivated Supervising Financial Counselor who is passionate about expanding access to financial empowerment services and advancing economic justice and financial stability for New Yorkers.

NYLAG's Financial Empowerment and Advocacy Unit (FEAU) was established in 2009 to help individuals and families build financial stability, overcome economic barriers, and achieve their financial goals. FEAU provides free, high-quality counseling, literacy and advocacy services to low-income New Yorkers through NYLAG’s offices, community-based sites across New York City, Long Island and Westchester. Using a client-centered and trauma-informed approach, FEAU works to strengthen financial literacy, increase access to economic opportunities and resources, and promote long-term financial well-being in the communities we serve.


The Supervising Financial counselor will work alongside the unit leadership team to oversee program operations including staff supervision and project management for initiatives in their portfolio. As a part of their role, they will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to support our work with communities, track performance metrics and assist with reporting, and lead strategic initiatives in response to community and unit need. The Supervising Financial counselor will also provide financial counseling and coaching as needed.

Duties and Responsibilities
  • Train, mentor, and supervise a team of financial counselors.
  • Serve as project manager for a portfolio of 4-6 financial empowerment initiatives, ensuring effective implementation, coordination, and achievement of program goals.
  • Lead communications and project management activities with project partners and stakeholders to meet performance goals; oversee reporting requirements, including data collection, narrative reporting, and performance tracking; and monitor deliverables and outcomes to ensure timely attainment of project goals and contractual obligations.
  • Build and maintain collaborative relationships with partner sites and key stakeholders to strengthen program implementation and advance financial empowerment outcomes.
  • In partnership with the Director, support staff in identifying professional development goals, creating growth opportunities, and strengthening skills through coaching, mentorship, and training.
  • Provide one-on-one financial counseling and coaching services to clients, supporting financial stability, asset building, and consumer protection goals.
  • Collaborate with internal and external partners to identify emerging client and community needs, strengthen service delivery, advocate for resources and opportunities that support clients and staff, and advance the unit's racial equity goals.
  • Collaborate with fellow supervisors and leadership to support unit-wide initiatives, provide operational coverage, and respond to emerging programmatic and organizational needs.
Qualifications

NYLAG seeks a highly motivated and organized financial counselor with either (i) a bachelor’s degree and a minimum of four (4) years of full-time work experience, with preferred background in finance, financial education, counseling/coaching, or social service delivery; or (ii) six (6) to ten (10) years of full-time work experience in financial education, counseling/coaching, or social or youth service delivery and an additional year of supervisory or management experience. A Counselor with an accreditation or designation and/or relevant graduate school education is preferred.

The successful candidate will possess excellent writing, speaking, communication, and organizational skills; experience with reporting, project management, and analysis; and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively with colleagues and other professionals. Candidates should demonstrate a commitment to advancing financial literacy and economic justice, have experience working with individuals experiencing crisis, and be able to manage multiple competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

A commitment to ongoing learning and growth, for themselves and for the members of their team is essential, including staying abreast of developments in the field and the political dynamics that affect our clients and communities.

Due to current program needs, preference will be given to applicants who are bilingual and able to read, write, and speak Spanish proficiently. Preference will be given to applicants who have taken the Personal and Consumer Finance course endorsed by the Office of Financial Empowerment.

NYLAG’s Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
NYLAG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. People of color, women, people with disabilities, immigrants, veterans, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer people, and those with lived experiences in the communities we serve are strongly encouraged to apply.

☒ Full-time

NYLAG is a unionized workplace, and salaries are set pursuant to a collective bargaining agreement. The current salary range for this position is between $73,718 - $79,857.

Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401k, life insurance, long term disability, commuter benefits, flexible spending accounts (FSA) for Medical and Dependent care.

title: R&D Biomedical Engineer (On-Site)
description:
About Myant Health

At Myant Health, we are defining the Internet of Humans, a new generation of healthcare technology that connects people, AI, and machines through the power of textile computing. Our vision is to transform everyday textiles into intelligent, connected interfaces that can sense, understand, and ultimately respond to the human body.

At the centre of this vision is HumanOS, our platform for creating a personal health digital twin and bringing together information from textile-based sensors, medical devices, wearables, and other connected technologies. By combining multimodal sensing, biometrics, AI, and clinical intelligence, we are building a more connected and continuous approach to understanding health.

Our SKIIN™ technology turns everyday clothing into a sophisticated health interface, designed to feel like normal clothing while capturing meaningful, clinical-grade health information. Our technology is being applied across major areas of health, including cardiovascular disease, sleep, hypertension, diabetes, musculoskeletal health, and other chronic conditions.

Our immediate focus is delivering a new standard of care through objective measurement, beginning with accessible diagnostic solutions such as 14-day cardiac monitoring, home sleep apnea testing, and ambulatory blood pressure monitoring. Through our broader ecosystem, including technologies such as FIGUR8, we are extending objective health measurement into additional areas of care.

But our ambition goes beyond diagnostics. We are building toward a future where everyday textiles can become continuous diagnostic and therapeutic interfaces, helping individuals, families, and healthcare professionals understand health earlier, manage it more proactively, and intervene when it matters most.

At Myant Health, you will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of textile computing, AI, software, hardware, biometrics, clinical science, and healthcare to help build technology that could fundamentally change how people experience and manage their health.

This is not simply a wearable technology company. We are building the infrastructure for a more connected human health ecosystem.

Role Overview:

As an R&D Biomedical Engineer, you will work at the intersection of biomedical engineering, electromechanical design, sensing, and healthcare. You will contribute across the full product development lifecycle, from early-stage concepts and prototyping through verification, validation, and manufacturing transfer.

This is a highly hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, working in the lab, building and testing physical systems, and collaborating across disciplines to bring new medical technologies to life.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop wearable electromechanical medical devices, including enclosures, docks, connectors, and textile-integrated hardware.
  • Integrate and evaluate biosignal sensing technologies such as ECG, EMG, PPG, IMU, EEG, bioimpedance, and pressure sensing within wearable form factors.
  • Translate product and system requirements into practical engineering designs, prototypes, and test methods.
  • Build and iterate prototypes using 3D printing, CNC machining, and other laboratory fabrication techniques.
  • Develop test fixtures, instrumentation, and experimental setups for mechanical, electrical, environmental, and durability characterization.
  • Plan, author, and execute verification and validation (V&V) protocols and reports, including applicable electrical and mechanical safety testing.
  • Support product development in accordance with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and IEC 60601 requirements.
  • Contribute to design controls and regulatory documentation, including design inputs, design outputs, risk assessments, FMEA, DHF documentation, and traceability.
  • Collect, analyze, and interpret experimental and sensor data to evaluate performance and guide design decisions using MATLAB and/or Python.
  • Work closely with electrical, mechanical, software, textile, clinical, regulatory, and manufacturing teams to deliver integrated products.
  • Support design transfer and manufacturing readiness, including collaboration with contract manufacturers and suppliers.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues, identify root causes, and drive solutions from investigation through implementation.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of product designs, engineering processes, testing methodologies, and development practices.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline; PhD is an asset.
  • 2+ years of experience developing electromechanical, wearable, or medical devices through multiple stages of the product development lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience taking products from concept and prototyping through verification/validation and, ideally, manufacturing transfer.
  • Strong proficiency with CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Onshape, CATIA, or equivalent.
  • Practical experience designing, building, testing, and iterating physical prototypes.
  • Working knowledge of medical device development and applicable standards, including ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and IEC 60601.
  • Experience developing and executing engineering tests and documenting results in a structured, traceable manner.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience working with experimental, mechanical, or sensor data.
  • Proficiency in MATLAB and/or Python for data analysis and engineering experimentation.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A hands-on, ownership-oriented mindset and the ability to move comfortably between the lab, engineering documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing wearable medical devices, biosignal sensing systems, or textile-integrated electronics.
  • Direct experience working with biosignals such as ECG, EMG, PPG, EEG, bioimpedance, or pressure.
  • Familiarity with biocompatibility and ISO 10993 requirements.
  • Familiarity with usability engineering and IEC 62366-1.
  • Experience with medical device risk management, design controls, and regulatory submissions.
  • Experience developing mechanical test fixtures and instrumentation.
  • Experience working with contract manufacturers, suppliers, or external engineering partners.
  • Experience working in a regulated medical device or healthcare technology environment.
  • Experience with wearable sensor validation, human-subject studies, or clinical product development.

What We Offer:

  • A unique opportunity to shape the future of connected healthcare.
  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.
  • A collaborative, fast-paced environment where innovation and impact go hand-in-hand.
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a mission-driven company poised for global expansion.
  • Exposure working in one of the most innovative and forward-thinking tech company

title: Dance - After-School Program Leader
description:

Pay Range: $20.50 - $24.15
Status: Part-time, Non-Exempt

Reports to: Site Coordinator
Program hours of operation: 8:00 AM – 5:00/6:00 PM (varies per location)

Locations: Moreno Valley Unified School District.


Are you passionate about giving back to your community and serving youth? Join us!


Who We Are:
In 1922, Woodcraft Rangers opened its doors in Los Angeles and began its mission of guiding young people as they explore pathways to purposeful lives. As a progressive organization, Woodcraft has always been responsive to the evolving needs of the communities served, and is notably inclusive, youth-led, and rooted in the Woodcraft Way, a holistic framework that develops body, mind, spirit, and service. Continuously at the forefront of expanded learning opportunities, Woodcraft Rangers has a rich history of making a significant impact in the greater Los Angeles area, believing that all youth is innately good, deserves the opportunity to realize their full potential, and should be an active participant in defining their own path.

What We Do:
Woodcraft Rangers provides TK-12 expanded learning programs, including before and after school, specialty enrichment, and summer learning. In the past few years, Woodcraft has expanded its menu of services beyond traditional afterschool programs and summer camps to include early learning, environmental and social justice, college access, and inclusion services for youth with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Additionally, we offer Lifecraft, a college and career advancement program to support the development of approximately 1,500 staff. Today, Woodcraft Rangers serves more than 30,000 youth ages 4 to 18 each year across 160 plus Title I schools in Los Angeles, San Bernardino, and Riverside counties, and continues to expand its reach.

Job Summary:
Club Leaders are responsible for ensuring a fun and positive learning environment for participants and will support clubs of approximately 20 children. Club leaders have the opportunity to grow, connect, play and have the greatest impact on each of their participants. Other members of the team include a site coordinator, who oversees the program and a community liaison who supports the site coordinator. All staff can choose between working in day camps, sleepaway camp, or both.

The Club Leader position is an on-site position, including attending training at the Woodcraft Rangers main office in Little Tokyo and school sites.

Role Overview:
  • Ensure students are in a safe environment (physically and emotionally). Promotes an inclusive, welcoming, and respectful environment that embraces diversity for all program participants, staff, and families.
  • Develops and leads age-appropriate program activities that are FUN, engaging and aligned with whole-child approach (social emotional learning, skill building, self-esteem, leadership, etc.). WR has an activity catalog to support the development of activity plans.
  • Monitors participant attendance and engagement to ensure participants are present and actively engaged in program activities.
  • Build positive relationships with program participants, colleagues, and all stakeholders.
  • Collaborates with colleagues and supervisor to develop culminating activities or events that showcase all participants work and accomplishments.
  • Requests required materials in a timely manner so Site Coordinator can ensure materials are available when needed and within budget.
  • Complies with all applicable safety requirements and emergency protocols, including, up to date on all trainings and required certifications.
  • May be required to attend off-site field trips.
  • Maintain and submit student attendance daily.
  • Participate in staff development trainings as required, approximately 15 hours spread out over multiple weekends/intersessional days throughout the spring.
  • Club Leaders are accountable to the Site Coordinator and Program Manager for assigned duties.
  • Other related duties as assigned.

Why work for Woodcraft Rangers:
  • Sick time
  • Lifecraft
  • Upward Mobility
  • Career development
  • The opportunity to create a lasting positive impact on youth within your community.
Ideal Candidate:
Ideally, we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, energetic, ambitious, proactive, and positive, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Multi-tasking and attention to detail must be strengths this individual possesses. Individuals need to be comfortable to present and speak in front of staff and peers during in-person training.

Requirements:
  • Knowledge and experience working in expanded learning programs or youth recreational facilities.
  • Minimum High School Diploma or GED (AA Degree in Child Development or a related field preferred); prior experience working with groups of K-12 students in an academic or recreational setting preferred.
  • Work well with young children and/or youth.
  • Good oral and written communication.
  • Computer literacy and willingness to learn.
  • Valid LIVE Scan, TB Clearance, and CPR Certification
  • Must successfully pass an assessment test evaluating skills in math, reading comprehension, and spelling.
